Parspec is SOC 2 Type II attested and markets itself to help distributors and rep agencies bid more, win more, and improve profitability. Backed by Threshold Ventures.

companies.name: Pelico
companies.description: Pelico is a manufacturing orchestration platform that bridges the execution gap between planning and real-world production. It unifies data from suppliers, production, inventory, quality, maintenance, and customers into a single operational view across multi-level BOMs and multi-plant networks. Domain-specific AI agents continuously monitor disruptions, determine upstream and downstream impact, simulate recovery options (alternates, stock transfers, resequencing), and keep cross-functional teams synchronized in real time. Pelico integrates with major ERP systems (SAP, Oracle, Infor) and cloud providers (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud), exposing APIs to ingest new data sources and push actions into existing enterprise systems. The company is SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001:2022 certified and GDPR compliant. This profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network; Pelico is a portfolio company of General Catalyst and does not publish a public developer API, portal, or OpenAPI at this time — its API surface is enterprise integration only.

companies.name: Dealer.com
companies.description: Dealer.com, a Cox Automotive brand, builds automotive dealership websites, digital advertising, and digital marketing technology used by thousands of franchise and independent dealers across North America. Its integration surface is partner-gated: third parties embed experiences on dealer sites through the Dealer.com Website Integration API and the Integrated Partner Program, while inventory, leads, deal, and digital-retail data flow through the broader Cox Automotive Integration Platform (developer.coxautoinc.com), which uses OAuth (Okta) and requires an approved partner agreement. Dealer.com does not publish an open, self-serve public API; the endpoints modeled here are logical groupings of the partner capabilities, not a documented public surface.

companies.name: American Axle and Manufacturing
companies.description: American Axle & Manufacturing (AAM), now operating as Dauch Corporation following the February 2026 acquisition of Dowlais Group (GKN Automotive and GKN Powder Metallurgy), is a global Tier 1 automotive supplier designing, engineering, and manufacturing driveline and metal forming technologies for electric, hybrid, and internal combustion vehicles. AAM operates an iSupplier Portal for supplier communication, EDI integration for forecasts and releases, and the Demand AAM aftermarket parts portal.

companies.name: AtoB
companies.description: AtoB is a fleet payments platform for the trucking and transportation industry, offering fuel cards, spend-management controls, driver payouts, and trip credit to fleets of every size. Its cards work across a nationwide fuel network with truck-stop discounts, granular purchase controls (fuel-only, category/MCC restrictions, per-transaction and daily limits), telematics-aware fraud prevention, and reporting that supports IFTA fuel-tax and expense compliance. AtoB also runs partner programs for factoring companies, freight brokers, and merchants, and exposes a private Partners API used by telematics and fleet-management integrations (for example Fleetio and Oxmaint) to sync cards, drivers, vehicles, and settled fuel transactions. AtoB was surfaced as a portfolio company of Bloomberg Beta and General Catalyst; this profile has been enriched from public web sources.

companies.name: MacroFab
companies.description: MacroFab is a US-based electronics manufacturing services (EMS) company operating a digital manufacturing platform for PCB assembly, from prototype to production. Its platform is powered by FabIQ, a manufacturing AI that automates instant quoting, component sourcing, and supply-chain intelligence: engineers upload design files (Gerbers, ODB++, native EDA formats) and receive itemized quotes with live BOM pricing against distributor inventory, component alternate suggestions, tariff impact analysis, consigned inventory management, and real-time order tracking. Founded in 2013 and headquartered in Houston, TX, MacroFab runs ITAR-registered, ISO 9001:2015 certified, DPAS-rated US manufacturing lines serving industrial, defense, autonomous systems, and test-and-measurement customers. The customer platform (factory.macrofab.com) is authenticated via OpenID Connect / OAuth2; MacroFab does not publish an open API specification.

companies.name: Brickanta
companies.description: Brickanta is a Stockholm-based agentic AI platform built for the construction industry, deploying specialized AI agents to automate pre-construction and project workflows including bid analysis, cost estimation, procurement package generation, document and contract review, compliance, and quality assurance. The platform reads drawings, specs, and contracts to surface risks and gaps, turns raw RFPs into discipline-specific procurement packages, and builds a searchable knowledge base from every finished project. Brickanta raised an $8M seed round led by Northzone in early 2026 and serves construction teams across eleven countries. The company exposes a customer application and a public trust portal but does not currently publish a public developer API, SDKs, or API reference; this profile captures its identity and security posture.

companies.name: Logility
companies.description: Logility is an AI-powered supply chain planning platform providing solutions for demand sensing, inventory optimization, supply planning, S&OP process management, and supply chain analytics. Part of Aptean, Logility serves 600+ clients across 80 countries with capabilities for demand planning, inventory optimization, scenario planning, manufacturing execution, and supplier management across 12+ industry verticals.

companies.name: Nowlun Holding Corp.
companies.description: Nowlun is a digital freight-forwarding platform serving the Middle East and North Africa that lets businesses compare instant ocean-freight quotes from 30+ shipping lines, book FCL and bulk sea shipments, arrange inland trucking to and from ports, track cargo through transit, and handle customs clearance. Beyond its shipper-facing web application, Nowlun operates a live, OAuth-protected Model Context Protocol (MCP) server at https://nowlun.com/mcp, secured with RFC 8414 authorization-server and RFC 9728 protected-resource discovery (Authorization Code + PKCE, "mcp" scope). Surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio company and enriched into the API Evangelist network.

companies.name: Platform Science
companies.description: Platform Science is an enterprise connected-vehicle and fleet management platform for commercial trucking and transportation. It combines ELD and telematics, driver applications (Hours of Service, DVIR, navigation, workflow, media management), back-office fleet management, and video safety intelligence on a single connected-vehicle platform. Its Virtual Vehicle Marketplace hosts 100+ partner integrations across 18 categories (asset tracking, compliance, fuel, navigation, sensors, TMS, and more), and a gated developer program (the Remote Platform Management system, an Android SDK, and a data-retrieval API governed by SPEED Certification) lets partners build edge and cloud integrations against the platform.

companies.name: SkySelect
companies.description: SkySelect is an AI-powered aircraft parts procurement platform for airlines, MROs (maintenance, repair and overhaul providers), and aircraft lessors. Founded in 2017 and headquartered in San Francisco, it operates an eProcurement-as-a-Service platform that automates sourcing, purchasing, and order tracking for aviation materials. Rather than a listings-based marketplace, buyers submit a demand list and SkySelect's specialised procurement AI automatically issues RFQs to a global network of 3,000+ verified suppliers, having processed more than US$6 billion in transactions. The platform exposes an integration API (inventory sync, RFQ reception, and quote submission) gated behind account login; partners such as Rotabull connect via API Key and Secret credentials generated in Developer Settings. SkySelect is backed by Initialized Capital and raised US$9M in 2026.

companies.name: Airbase
companies.description: Airbase is a modern spend management platform for finance teams that combines accounts-payable (AP) automation and bill pay, guided procurement and purchase orders, corporate cards, and expense reimbursements on a single system with real-time general-ledger sync. Airbase Inc. was acquired by Paylocity in a ~$325M deal announced September 4, 2024 and completed October 1, 2024, and now operates as "Airbase by Paylocity," extending Paylocity's HCM suite into the office of the CFO. Airbase exposes a developer platform at developer.airbase.io (REST API reference, OpenAPI/Swagger, Postman and Insomnia collections, a webhooks management API, an OAuth playground, and a sandbox) used to build custom connections for systems not covered by the pre-built integrations. API access is account-gated - credentials are generated inside the customer's Airbase/Paylocity tenant rather than through open self-serve signup - so the logical APIs below are honestly modeled from the documented product surface and developer portal, and the exact endpoint paths and base URL are not publicly reproduced here (endpointsModeled).

companies.name: Aumet
companies.description: Aumet is a MENA-based healthtech company building an AI-first procurement and pharmacy operating system for healthcare. Its platform connects pharmaceutical manufacturers, distributors, and pharmacies through a B2B marketplace and a suite of pharmacy software: Pulse (point-of-sale, inventory, and smart reordering for individual pharmacies), Chain (multi-branch pharmacy management), and Enterprise (solutions for government health systems and hospitals). The platform adds AI-powered demand forecasting, procurement automation, price transparency, and analytics, and reports serving 12,000+ pharmacies and 1,000+ suppliers across Jordan, Egypt, and Saudi Arabia with over $1B in gross merchandise value and millions of transactions annually. Aumet is backed by 500 Global and Techstars.

companies.name: Laserhub
companies.description: Laserhub is a Stuttgart-based digital procurement platform for custom-manufactured metal and plastic parts, founded to replace the traditional RFQ cycle for sheet metal, tube and machined components with instant online quoting. Buyers register at app.laserhub.com, upload CAD files, and receive an automated feasibility check plus an instant quote covering laser cutting, plasma and flame cutting, tube laser cutting, bending, CNC turning and milling, weldments, and secondary processes such as threading, deburring, galvanising, powder coating and engraving. Laserhub is itself the contracting party and allocates each order algorithmically across a network of roughly 100 ISO 9001:2015 certified producers in Germany, Austria and Switzerland, serving both SMEs and DAX40 manufacturers with framework agreements, a parts library, sample parts, inspection certificates and design guidelines. Laserhub publishes no public developer API, SDK, or API documentation as of this profile: api.laserhub.com is a private AWS API Gateway that rejects unauthenticated requests, and the only machine-adjacent ordering channel the company documents is an email-based ordering flow (anfrage@laserhub.com) that its own release notes describe as still in a test phase for a subset of customers.

companies.name: OrderCircle
companies.description: OrderCircle is a B2B wholesale order management software platform, founded in 2015 in San Francisco, that gives fast-growing brands one system to automate wholesale orders, track inventory in real time, generate invoices, and run a self-service B2B eCommerce portal for their buyers. It targets wholesale operations in apparel, coffee, jewelry, food and beverage, hemp, vape, and CBD, and connects to existing tools through pre-built integrations with Shopify, WooCommerce, QuickBooks, Xero, ShipStation, Stripe, Square, PayPal PayFlow, and Authorize.Net. OrderCircle does not currently publish a public developer API, developer portal, or API documentation; its programmatic surface is limited to its packaged third-party integrations. This profile was seeded as a 500 Global portfolio lead and enriched from the company's public web presence.

companies.name: Table22
companies.description: Table22 is a subscription commerce and growth platform built specifically for food & beverage businesses. It enables restaurants, wine shops, wineries, butchers, bakeries, specialty grocers, and retailers to launch and grow subscriptions, clubs, memberships, pre-orders, and product drops that generate predictable recurring revenue beyond their four walls. The full-service platform combines branded storefronts, an order management system, white-glove fulfillment coordination, automated lifecycle marketing and CRM, five-star consumer support, and AI tools for hospitality. Over 1,000 merchants across 40 U.S. states use Table22, representing $100M+ in revenue impact. Pricing is success-based (15% revenue share, no upfront or setup fees). Table22 is a sales-led SaaS with no public developer API; this profile captures its identity, website surface, and machine-readable llms.txt.

companies.name: Three UK
companies.description: Three UK (Hutchison 3G UK Limited, Reading, England) is a United Kingdom mobile network operator that launched in 2003 as the country's first 3G-only carrier and grew into a consumer and business mobile, 5G, and home broadband provider, also operating the SMARTY sub-brand. Since 31 May 2025 Three UK has been a wholly owned subsidiary of VodafoneThree, the merged Vodafone UK / Three UK joint venture that is 51% Vodafone Group and 49% CK Hutchison Holdings, serving roughly 27 million UK customers. In the telecom value chain Three UK is a network owner and access provider, not a developer platform: it sells connectivity, spectrum-backed coverage, wholesale and MVNO capacity, and business connectivity, while its group-level enterprise, IoT, private-network and wholesale propositions are marketed through CK Hutchison's CKH IOD and Three Group Solutions. Its API posture is partner-gated and sales-led. Three UK publishes no public developer portal, no self-serve signup, no downloadable OpenAPI, no SDKs, and no public Postman workspace; every candidate developer hostname (developer, developers, docs, apis, sandbox, opengateway) resolves only to a wildcard Akamai record whose certificate does not cover it, and the Wayback Machine holds no snapshot of a Three UK developer portal ever existing. Three UK is nonetheless a real participant in the sector's standards layer: it is named in the CAMARA Project's governance participants list, its parent CK Hutchison Holdings is listed as an Operator in the CAMARA landscape, and on 23 September 2025 CK Hutchison Group Telecom (Three) commercially launched CAMARA KYC Age Verification and KYC Tenure network APIs alongside BT/EE, Virgin Media O2, and Vodafone under GSMA Open Gateway, on top of an already-available SIM Swap API, with KYC Match committed. Those APIs are reachable only through channel partners and aggregators — JT Group and TMT.ID are named as processing UK operator network API traffic, and Three UK's majority owner Vodafone Group is a founding venture partner in Aduna — never through a Three UK developer surface.

companies.name: vAuto
companies.description: vAuto is a Cox Automotive brand providing new and used vehicle inventory management, appraisal, pricing, and merchandising software for automotive dealers (ProfitTime GPS, Provision, Conquest, Stockwave). vAuto exposes partner-gated APIs through the Cox Automotive Integration Platform (developer.coxautoinc.com) - notably the vAuto Inventory API and the vAuto Appraisal API - that let authorized integrators programmatically read vehicle inventory, update list price, and create and access appraisals in the vAuto ecosystem. Access is not open self-service; integrators must be approved partners, authenticate via Cox Automotive Bridge ID / OAuth with an issued API key, and endpoint-level reference documentation is behind the partner developer portal login. Per-path endpoints below are modeled from the published product summaries, not copied from public reference docs.

companies.name: VendorPM
companies.description: VendorPM is a PropTech procurement and vendor-lifecycle-management platform for the commercial real estate industry, unifying vendor credentialing, compliance screening, eTendering/eBidding, procurement, and contract management under a single login. Its marketplace connects property managers with a network of 50,000+ vendors to fulfill building services and contracts of all sizes, while an AI Procurement CoPilot surfaces recommendations and a Yardi Voyager ERP integration syncs vendor compliance and profile data. VendorPM serves 100+ property management groups and 6,000+ buildings across the US and Canada. This profile was surfaced as a Bessemer Venture Partners portfolio company; VendorPM exposes no public self-serve developer API — its Yardi/ERP integration is provisioned through a Customer Success Manager.

companies.name: AutoZone
companies.description: AutoZone is the nation's leading retailer and a leading distributor of automotive replacement parts and accessories with more than 7,000 stores across the Americas. AutoZone serves both do-it-yourself (DIY) customers and professional automotive service providers (DIFM) through retail stores, e-commerce, and electronic ordering integrations for commercial accounts via AutoZone Pro.

companies.name: Epicor
companies.description: Epicor Software Corporation provides industry-specific enterprise resource planning software for manufacturing, distribution, retail, and service industries. Epicor Kinetic, the flagship ERP platform, exposes an Open REST API built on OData v4 that gives developers service-based access to all business objects, processes, reports, BAQs, and Epicor Functions using standard HTTP methods and API key authentication.

companies.name: Faks
companies.description: Faks is a French SaaS platform that digitizes and streamlines the commercial relationships across the pharmacy ecosystem. It gives pharmacies, pharmacy groups (groupements), and laboratories a single place to manage supplier relationships, commercial claims and disputes (litiges), expired and returnable product handling, promotions, and sell-in / sell-out performance. Faks connects to pharmacy management systems (LGO), purchasing platforms, and accounting tools through its Konnect integrations to automate what has traditionally been manual, paper, and email-driven work between the ~18,000 pharmacies, ~100 groups, and ~500 laboratories it targets in France. The company is backed by Seedcamp. Faks does not currently publish a public developer API, OpenAPI, or developer portal; this profile captures its public identity and the enrichment surfaces that could be probed.

companies.name: FourKites
companies.description: FourKites is a real-time supply chain visibility platform that tracks shipments and assets across road, rail, ocean, and yard modes worldwide.

companies.name: DP World
companies.description: DP World is an Emirati global logistics company that specializes in port operations, maritime services, and supply chain solutions. It manages and operates marine and inland terminals across more than 40 countries and operates a portfolio of digital platforms - including the CARGOES suite (Flow, Runner, TOS+, PCS, Customs), Searates, and the Digital Freight Alliance - that expose APIs and integrations for shipment visibility, freight pricing, terminal operations, and trade workflows.

companies.name: Operation Support Equipment
companies.description: API for managing and accessing operation support equipment data, inventory, maintenance records, and deployment information for operational logistics and equipment lifecycle management.

companies.name: Pactum
companies.description: Pactum is an AI procurement negotiation platform that deploys autonomous agents to conduct commercial supplier negotiations at scale while enforcing buyer-defined policies and guardrails. Its agent suite spans requisition alignment and negotiation, tactical and post-sourcing sourcing, price-list, discount, payment-terms, and rebate negotiations, letting enterprise procurement teams reach agreements on long-tail spend that would otherwise go unnegotiated. Pactum is a venture-backed enterprise SaaS company; as of this profile it exposes no public developer API, so this record captures the company's identity plus its published security, trust, and disclosure surface.

companies.name: AMPAworks
companies.description: AMPAworks builds AI-powered smart-shelf inventory management for healthcare and defense supply chains. Its platform pairs computer-vision cameras and rolling kiosks that image inventory to auto-count stock in real time with software that tracks supplies 24/7, automates reordering, and gives teams live visibility to prevent stock-outs. The company reports outcomes such as $15M in cost reduction, 25,000 hours saved on hand counting, and 72% fewer stock-outs across more than 28 healthcare and operational organizations. Backed by 500 Global, AMPAworks operates from offices in Santa Monica CA, Buffalo NY, Hackensack NJ, and Ann Arbor MI.

companies.name: CF Industries Holdings
companies.description: CF Industries Holdings is a Fortune 500 American manufacturer and distributor of nitrogen-based fertilizers (ammonia, urea, ammonium nitrate, UAN) and clean-energy products serving agricultural and industrial customers worldwide. CF operates one of the largest global ammonia production networks and is scaling clean (blue and green) ammonia for low-carbon energy. CF does not publish a public developer API program; programmatic data access is limited to investor-relations SEC filings feeds, press/news RSS, and partner EDI/B2B integrations with agricultural distributors, rail, terminal, and industrial customers.

companies.name: Orolabs
companies.description: ORO Labs provides an agentic procurement orchestration platform for enterprise spend management. It coordinates people, processes, systems, and data so employees can get what they need without friction, unifying intake management, supplier onboarding and lifecycle, risk and compliance orchestration, and AI-driven workflow automation. The platform offers a no-code workflow builder, a purpose-built agent builder for custom procurement AI agents, and bring-your-own-LLM flexibility, with secure, semantically rich integrations across the procuretech landscape. ORO Labs is backed by Felicis and Norwest Venture Partners.

companies.name: Pango
companies.description: Pango is a Y Combinator (Summer 2026) startup building an AI-powered operating system for e-commerce post-purchase and logistics operations. The platform positions itself as an "agentic OS" — autonomous AI agents that handle back-office logistics tasks — and consolidates multi-carrier delivery management, checkout delivery options, branded order tracking, and returns processing into a single unified system. Pango advertises multi-carrier orchestration across 100+ shipping providers with AI-powered routing and rate optimization, self-service return portals with automated approvals, warehouse pick-and-pack automation, and AI agents that resolve exceptions and automate workflows. It integrates with major commerce platforms (Shopify, WooCommerce, BigCommerce, Magento, Salesforce Commerce, NetSuite) and 100+ carrier, WMS, marketing, and support partners. Added to the API Evangelist network as a Y Combinator portfolio lead; as of this enrichment pass the company markets an "API-first architecture" but publishes no public developer documentation, API reference, OpenAPI spec, or SDK.

companies.name: Vetcove
companies.description: Vetcove is a free purchasing and procurement platform for veterinary clinics and animal-health organizations that lets a practice shop every distributor and manufacturer at once. It consolidates accounts from suppliers such as Henry Schein, Patterson Vet, MWI, and Midwest Veterinary into one interface where staff compare live pricing and availability, place and track orders, and manage inventory across vendors without changing existing supplier relationships. The service is delivered as a web application and mobile app and is free to veterinary clinics and nonprofits. No public developer API, OpenAPI, or developer portal was found during enrichment; this profile captures the company identity and a probed domain-security posture.

companies.name: Optimal Dynamics
companies.description: Optimal Dynamics is the Decision Company for trucking. Its Transportation Decision System (TDS), CORE.ai, applies Artificial Decision Intelligence — born from 40 years of research at Princeton University — to automate and optimize strategic, tactical, and real-time planning for enterprise truckload carriers. The platform spans dispatch management, network management, bid analysis, and network simulation, using dynamic forecasting to simulate downstream impacts and drive highly automated operations that increase revenue per truck and reduce manual planning. Surfaced as a portfolio company of bessemer-venture-partners.

companies.name: Huice
companies.description: Huice (慧策) is a Chinese enterprise software company whose flagship product, Wangdiantong (旺店通) ERP, is a tailor-made e-commerce management system for merchants operating across multiple online channels. It provides order management, warehouse and inventory management (WMS), goods and product-archive management, procurement, after-sales/returns processing, and financial operations (慧经营). Huice runs a public Open Platform (open.wangdian.cn) exposing an HTTP API (openapi2) for third-party integrators to synchronize shops, goods, orders, stock, purchasing, and logistics. The API uses a sid + appkey + timestamp + MD5 signature (sign) authentication scheme, page_no/page_size pagination, and a code/message response envelope, with separate sandbox and production hosts.

companies.name: Wholesail
companies.description: Wholesail is an all-in-one accounts receivable and B2B payments platform for food & beverage wholesalers, distributors, and service vendors. It helps vendors onboard customers, manage credit risk, automate collections, accept ACH and card payments, and drive autopay — all connected to the vendor's ERP or accounting system. Wholesail is a fintech company backed by Foundry Group. As of enrichment it publishes no public developer API; it integrates with ERP systems using their native API protocols, scheduled file exchange, and robotic process automation, and it partners with Stripe, Plaid, Modern Treasury, JP Morgan, and SVB for payment processing. This profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network.

companies.name: Entelo
companies.description: Entelo is an AI-powered talent-sourcing and recruiting-automation platform for finding, engaging, and hiring candidates using predictive analytics, diversity-aware search, and candidate-engagement tooling. Entelo was acquired and is now delivered as "Entelo Recruit" within Rival (rival-hr.com), an AI-powered HR orchestration suite spanning recruiting, workflow, learning, and performance. Its former domain entelo.com now 301-redirects to Rival. No public developer portal, API reference, or OpenAPI is currently published for the Entelo/Rival Recruit product.

companies.name: A-Mark Precious Metals
companies.description: A-Mark Precious Metals is a full-service precious metals trading company that wholesales gold, silver, platinum, and palladium bullion and coins to dealers, financial institutions, and investors. They operate trading desks 17 hours daily across global locations (US, Asia, Vienna) and offer wholesale sales, direct-to-consumer, logistics and storage, minting, and collateralized loans services.

companies.name: Continuum
companies.description: Continuum (gocontinuum.ai) is an AI-powered platform that automates B2B returns, warranties, and repairs for distributors and manufacturers. It handles the post-sales workflow end to end through four solution hubs: a Customer Hub with self-service warranty and return portals, a Warehouse Hub for one-click receiving, inspection and dispute processing, a Vendor & Finance Hub for automated vendor engagement and accounts-receivable management, and a Manufacturer Warranty Hub for warranty claim automation. The company reports outcomes such as a 70% reduction in returns labor cost, a 30% increase in profitability, and an 8% reduction in customer churn. Continuum integrates with major distribution ERP systems (Infor, NetSuite, Epicor, Oracle, Acumatica). Based in Chicago, it is seed-funded and backed by Cowboy Ventures. Continuum is SOC 2 audited and publishes a public trust center. No public developer API or documentation is available at this time.

companies.name: Traba
companies.description: Traba is a New York City-based staffing marketplace and AI operating layer for the industrial supply chain, founded in 2021 and backed by Founders Fund. Traba connects vetted, high-reliability light-industrial workers with production plants, warehouses, and distribution centers, and pairs that staffing marketplace with Neo, an AI intelligence layer that unifies live operational data across WMS, ERP, HRIS, TMS, and payroll systems, surfaces root causes, and automates approved supply chain workflows. Traba publishes no public developer API.

companies.name: Valdera
companies.description: Valdera is the AI-powered sourcing and procurement platform for chemicals, ingredients, and raw materials, matching buyers with vetted global suppliers across a database of 400K+ suppliers and 1.7M+ unique chemistries. Buyers get supplier discovery, RFQs, and negotiation in one place; suppliers receive relevant inbound RFQs and fulfill orders on the platform. Valdera is a web platform, not an API provider — it publishes no public developer portal, API documentation, or SDKs.

companies.name: Zone & Company
companies.description: Zone & Co (Zone & Company) is a NetSuite-native financial operations software vendor whose SuiteApp suite automates the back office across five product families - Quote to Cash (ZoneBilling billing and revenue recognition, ZonePayments Stripe integration), Procure to Pay (ZoneProcure, ZoneCapture, ZoneApprovals), Treasury (ZoneLiquidity cash forecasting, ZoneReconcile), Payroll Management (ZonePayroll, Employee Portal), and Record to Report (ZoneReporting on Power BI, Data Warehouse, ZoneExtract, Solution 7). The products are delivered as native Oracle NetSuite SuiteApps distributed through the SuiteApp Marketplace rather than as a standalone public developer API. Backed by Insight Partners.

companies.name: BT Group
companies.description: BT Group plc (British Telecommunications) is the United Kingdom's largest fixed-line, broadband, and mobile communications provider, headquartered in London with operations spanning consumer, business, wholesale, and global enterprise markets. The group is organised around three customer-facing brands — BT, EE, and Plusnet — and a wholesale division that sells capacity and access to other communications providers. BT Group operates the UK's largest mobile network (EE), runs fibre and copper access through Openreach (a legally separate group company), and provides networked IT and security services to multinational enterprises and the UK public sector. The group publishes a public developer programme at developer.bt.com that exposes a growing catalogue of REST APIs across two main domains: charging and crediting (Direct Carrier Billing, Crediting, Premium SMS) and digital identity / fraud prevention (SIM Swap, Network Identity, Call Divert Protection), alongside wholesale and operational APIs (Broadband One, Quote Management, Address Management, Appointment Management, Product and Network Availability, HubCo Voice, Global Voice Services, IMEI Lookup, Home Network, Rail Insights, Location Insights for London, and a Travel Journey API Platform). The portal supports sandbox onboarding with Client ID / Client Secret OAuth 2.0 credentials and progression to production under a commercial agreement with an account team. In April 2025 BT announced a federated API management partnership with Kong (Kong Konnect) to consolidate its previously fragmented API estate, strengthen governance, and offer a self-service developer experience across the group.

companies.name: Govini
companies.description: Govini (rebranded to Air, air.ai, in 2026) is a defense-technology and decision-analytics company whose Ark platform combines proprietary defense acquisition data with AI-enabled applications to close the national-security "Readiness Gap" across supply chain, science and technology, production, sustainment, logistics, and modernization missions. Ark holds FedRAMP High authorization and a DISA Impact Level 5 (IL5) Provisional Authorization plus service-level IL5 ATOs, making it a closed, government-authorized SaaS platform rather than a public developer API. Led by CEO Tara Murphy Dougherty and backed by investors including Accel and Bain Capital. This profile entered the API Evangelist network as a portfolio-lead stub and has been enriched with the provider's real public identity, security posture, and published compliance authorizations.

companies.name: AlphaLoops FMCSA Carrier Data API
companies.description: The carrier data layer for freight — FMCSA motor-carrier intelligence covering carrier profiles, authority & insurance history, VIN-level fleet data, roadside inspections, crashes, corporate connections, decision-maker contacts, and risk/watchlist monitoring. Exposes a REST API, a live OpenAPI 3.1 contract, a hosted MCP server with 30+ tools, and published Python/TypeScript SDKs plus a CLI.

companies.name: Foundation Building Materials
companies.description: Foundation Building Materials (FBM) is a leading North American distributor of interior building products — drywall, steel framing, acoustic ceilings, insulation, and complementary construction supplies — serving commercial and residential contractors across the United States and Canada. Headquartered in Santa Ana, California, FBM operates a national branch network and a unified customer ordering platform at myfbm.com (consolidating the legacy fbmsales.com, MyRIS, and MyFBM portals) along with iOS/Android mobile apps for contractors. In April 2025, FBM acquired KCG/Rew Materials, adding 800 employees and 45 distribution branches across 23 states. In August 2025, Lowe's announced an agreement to acquire FBM. Brand families operating under FBM include FBM, RIS, Pacific Source, and Unified Door. FBM does not currently expose any public developer APIs, OpenAPI documentation, partner integration program, SDK, or GitHub organization — its digital surface is limited to buyer-facing e-commerce (search, ordering, order tracking, quick-order PDF/photo ingestion via "Quick Order Entry") rather than a developer/integration product.

companies.name: Mienvío
companies.description: Mienvío is a Mexican logistics control-tower platform that unifies multiple parcel carriers behind a single multi-carrier shipping API and dashboard for e-commerce, retail, marketplace, and fintech shippers across Latin America. It compares carrier rates, automates routing by cost, SLA, and coverage zone, generates shipping labels, and provides real-time tracking, delivery-incident management, and post-purchase customer notifications. Merchants integrate through the REST API (api.mienvio.mx/v2) or prebuilt Shopify and WooCommerce connectors, shipping nationally, internationally, and locally across Mexico, Colombia, Chile, Costa Rica, Peru, Guatemala, and El Salvador.

companies.name: Sybilion
companies.description: Sybilion is a decision layer for industrial companies, providing economic and causal forecasting that connects external market dynamics to internal exposure for procurement, trading and risk teams. It exposes forecasts, their drivers, and alerts via a REST API and a hosted MCP server.

companies.name: Finkargo
companies.description: Finkargo is a Latin American foreign-trade commerce platform that helps importers overcome the operational and financial barriers to growing their import businesses. Its product suite spans Paga (alternative supplier financing with revolving USD credit lines and 30-150 day terms), Analiza (market-intelligence dashboards that turn trade data into strategic decisions), Verifica (global supplier verification for product quality and legitimacy), and Protege (warehouse-to-warehouse cargo insurance). Operating across Colombia and Mexico and backed by QED Investors, Finkargo digitizes the full import-operations lifecycle from evaluating suppliers and planning imports to financing, transport, and arrival. Finkargo does not currently publish a public developer API or OpenAPI specification; this profile captures the company's public product, legal, and security surfaces.

companies.name: Max Retail
companies.description: Max Retail is a Techstars-backed platform that helps brick-and-mortar boutiques and multi-location retailers turn unsold and aged inventory into cash. Retailers connect their point-of-sale or e-commerce system — Shopify, RICS, or Square — or upload a CSV, and Max Retail lists, markets, and sells the items to a network of shoppers across multiple channels, handles customer service, and pays out through Stripe when a prepaid shipping label is scanned. The retailer only ships; Max Retail charges a flat 15% fee plus shipping. Max Retail integrates inbound with third-party commerce platforms and payment processors but does not publish a public developer API, SDKs, or a webhook surface of its own.

companies.name: ACV
companies.description: ACV Auctions (NASDAQ: ACVA) operates the nation's largest online wholesale marketplace and daily auto auction platform, connecting franchise and independent dealers to buy and sell used vehicles. Founded in 2014 and headquartered in Buffalo, New York, ACV pairs a mobile-first bidding app with third-party vehicle inspections and condition reports, real-time market data (ACV MAX and market insights), transportation logistics, and dealer floor-plan financing through ACV Capital. This is a company profile in the API Evangelist network; ACV does not publish a public developer API surface.

companies.name: Beatport
companies.description: Beatport is the leading online music store and streaming platform for electronic dance music DJs and producers, founded in 2004 and headquartered in Denver, Colorado. Beatport sells high-quality downloads (lossless WAV, AIFF, and FLAC, plus AAC) of tracks, releases, and DJ tools across more than 150 electronic genres, and operates a subscription streaming tier — Beatport Streaming — that delivers catalog tracks directly into supported DJ applications and hardware including Pioneer DJ rekordbox, Serato DJ Pro, Denon DJ Engine DJ, Algoriddim djay, Virtual DJ, Traktor, and others through integration partners. The Beatport Group also operates Beatsource (open- format DJ streaming and download store), DJCity (open-format record pool), Beatport LINK and Beatsource LINK (in-app streaming for DJ software), BeatportAmp (distribution and rights management for labels, formerly Ampsuite), Plugin Boutique (audio software and plugin marketplace), Loopcloud (sample subscription for producers), Label Radar (demo submission), Beatport Live (live events and streaming), Beatportal (editorial and media), and the International Music Summit (IMS) industry conference. The company reports ten million registered users, eighty thousand labels, four hundred thousand artists, and four hundred million USD paid out to rights holders since launch. Beatport operates a v4 REST API at api.beatport.com governed by OAuth 2.0 (authorization-code grant) with an interactive Swagger-UI developer portal at /v4/docs/; access is gated to approved partners through the Beatport Partner Portal, and there is no public client-credentials tier for general developers. The API exposes the Beatport catalog (tracks, releases, artists, labels, genres, sub-genres, charts, playlists, my-beatport collections, holds, and DJ-oriented search filters such as BPM, key, and released-date) and is the same surface that powers the public beatport.com applications and third-party DJ-software integrations. Beatport does not publish a downloadable OpenAPI document, an official SDK, or a CLI; partner integration is brokered case-by-case through the Partner Portal and the business-development team.

companies.name: BevSpot
companies.description: BevSpot is a Boston-based food and beverage inventory management platform for restaurants, bars, and hospitality groups. The web application streamlines back-of-house operations including inventory counting, ordering, invoice management, recipe and menu costing, and sales-driven analytics. BevSpot ingests point-of-sale data through integrations with more than a dozen POS systems (Toast, Square, Clover, Lightspeed, SpotOn, NCR Aloha, Upserve, Brink, Lavu, and others), plus accounting and vendor connections (QuickBooks, Microsoft Dynamics GP, Ottimate, Fintech, US Foods, Sysco). It is a portfolio company of Bain Capital Ventures. BevSpot does not currently publish a public developer API, SDK, or developer portal; this profile captures its public web, commercial, and security surface.

companies.name: DeepStream Technologies
companies.description: DeepStream Technologies (deep.stream) is a London-based AI-enhanced eSourcing and source-to-contract platform for mid-market procurement teams. It digitalizes buyer-to-supplier sourcing with best-of-breed eRFx, supplier discovery, supplier pre-qualification, eAuctions, contract management, management reporting, and AI-driven RFP generation and conversational analytics, aiming to help procurement teams work faster, reduce risk, and gain visibility while keeping implementation simple. Customers include Walkers Shortbread, BrewDog, Abbott, and Free Now. DeepStream does not currently publish a public developer API, OpenAPI specification, or developer documentation; integrations with ERP and PO systems are delivered as a service. This profile was surfaced as a Techstars portfolio company and enriched with public company and infrastructure signals.

companies.name: Finaloop
companies.description: Finaloop is a real-time, ecommerce-native bookkeeping and accounting platform for direct-to-consumer (DTC) and multichannel brands. It replaces QuickBooks/Xero, human bookkeepers, and integration tooling with automation plus a team of ecommerce accounting experts, delivering always-current financials. Finaloop continuously syncs sales, returns, fees, reimbursements, inventory movements, COGS, and banking across 60+ ecommerce, marketplace, payment, banking, lending, and 3PL integrations (Shopify, Amazon, TikTok Shop, Walmart, PayPal, Stripe, Chase, ShipBob, and more) to produce real-time P&L, balance sheet, and cash-flow statements, inventory analytics, and tax services. Finaloop exposes no public developer API; its APIs are internal connectors to source platforms, so this profile is identity- and posture-focused rather than spec-bearing.

companies.name: xChange
companies.description: Container xChange is a Hamburg-founded B2B online marketplace and operating platform for shipping containers, where container owners, users, traders, and lessors buy, sell, and lease standard and special containers worldwide. The platform covers container trading, one-way and long-term leasing, payment handling via the xChange Wallet, insurance, container tracking, and market-price insights, plus a live North America container inventory storefront. xChange publishes no public developer API; its xChange Connect integrations (customer supply-listing feeds and depot container-movement reporting) accept data via API or spreadsheet but are onboarded privately through an account manager.

companies.name: CO2 AI
companies.description: CO2 AI is an enterprise sustainability platform that helps organizations measure, reduce, and report carbon emissions across their entire value chain. It combines trustworthy emissions data, AI-powered workflows, and supply-chain collaboration to baseline and track Scope 1, 2, and 3 corporate footprints, compute audit-ready product carbon footprints (PCF) at scale across thousands of SKUs (PACT, TfS, PEF, ISO aligned), engage suppliers for primary data, and build decarbonization plans ranked by Marginal Abatement Cost. Backed by Partech and surfaced to the API Evangelist network as a climate-sector company profile. No public developer API is published as of this enrichment pass; the profile captures the company's security, trust, and legal surface.

companies.name: Fictiv
companies.description: Fictiv is a digital manufacturing and supply chain platform that connects engineering and hardware teams with a vetted global network of manufacturers to source custom mechanical parts. It provides instant online quoting, automated design-for-manufacturability (DFM) analysis, and end-to-end order visibility across CNC machining, injection molding, 3D printing, sheet metal, urethane casting, and compression molding — from rapid prototyping through full-scale production. Now part of MISUMI, Fictiv operates a quote-to-order web platform at app.fictiv.com; it does not currently publish a public developer API.

companies.name: Rapyd
companies.description: Rapyd is a global Fintech-as-a-Service network offering collect, disburse, hold, and issue capabilities across 100+ countries with local payment methods, cards, and bank transfers.

companies.name: Approve.com
companies.description: Approve.com is a cloud-based procurement platform founded in 2019 in Israel that lets businesses stand up a proper purchase-order process quickly, streamlining purchase requisitions, multi-step approvals, real-time budgets, and vendor onboarding with real-time spend controls and insights. Tipalti acquired Approve.com in April 2021 and now operates it as Tipalti Procurement (Tipalti Approve). Its Procurement REST API is still served from the approve.com domain (production https://triggers.approve.com, sandbox https://triggers.sandbox.approve.com), authenticating with an x-api-key header and exchanging JSON with ISO 8601 dates; the purchase-orders API exposes GET and Update purchase-order operations so an external system can stay in sync with Tipalti.

companies.name: Anvyl
companies.description: Anvyl is a supply chain and production management platform (a "Production Hub") for consumer-brand and e-commerce companies, connecting brands with their suppliers to manage the purchase-order and manufacturing lifecycle in one place: issuing and tracking purchase orders, coordinating production milestones and tasks, managing suppliers and SKUs/products, and monitoring inbound shipments and logistics. Anvyl was acquired by Sage and now operates under the Sage umbrella. It exposes a token-authenticated REST API (api.anvyl.com/api/v1) documented via Stoplight, with resources such as purchase orders. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of Redpoint Ventures and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline from Anvyl's live public developer surface.

companies.name: Oracle NetSuite
companies.description: Oracle NetSuite is a cloud-based ERP suite covering financials, accounting, order management, inventory, CRM, ecommerce, HR, and professional services automation for businesses of all sizes worldwide. As Oracle's flagship SaaS ERP, NetSuite powers core back-office operations and global subsidiaries. Oracle NetSuite exposes its SuiteTalk REST Web Services API for record access and SuiteQL queries, secured via OAuth 2.0 issued by each customer account-specific suitetalk.api.netsuite.com endpoint.

companies.name: Web Methods
companies.description: Web Methods (webMethods) is an enterprise integration platform pioneer, founded in 1996 by Phillip and Caren Merrick in Fairfax, Virginia to connect software applications in real time using web standards such as HTTP and XML. Its 2000 IPO was one of the largest first-day pops of the dot-com era. webMethods was acquired by Software AG in 2007 for $546 million, and its integration portfolio - now including webMethods.io Integration (iPaaS), API Gateway and API Management, the Developer Portal, B2B/EDI, messaging, managed file transfer, and event-driven integration - was acquired by IBM in July 2024 as IBM webMethods Hybrid Integration. Mayfield was an early venture backer of the company.

companies.name: Choco
companies.description: Choco is an AI-powered digital ordering platform that simplifies how restaurants order from their food suppliers and distributors. Serving tens of thousands of distributors and over one hundred thousand buyers across the US, UK, Europe, and the GCC, Choco lets restaurateurs place orders and chat with all their suppliers in one app while converting orders into a supplier's preferred format (email, WhatsApp, text, fax, or direct ERP integration). Choco connects to supplier ERP systems such as Entree, NetSuite, QuickBooks, Microsoft Dynamics, Target Data System, NCR, Sage, and Odoo, and uses AI — including OrderAgent for multimodal order capture and VoiceAgent built on OpenAI's Realtime API — to turn emails, texts, images, and documents into structured, ERP-ready orders. Choco does not publish a public developer API; integration is delivered through managed ERP connections, and its public GitHub organization (chocoapp) hosts only internal data-engineering and infrastructure tooling rather than client SDKs or API specifications.

companies.name: Grove Health
companies.description: Grove Health (Grove Medical Inc.) is a North American B2B healthcare supplies distributor operating an online catalog covering medical equipment and consumables, including nursing supplies, diagnostics, wound care, incontinence products, examination gloves, respiratory equipment, and related healthcare items. The company serves healthcare facilities and providers through a self-service e-commerce storefront. It has been backed by General Catalyst since 2021. No public API, developer program, or machine-readable interface was found during enrichment; this profile captures the company identity and its public web surface.

companies.name: Pavilion
companies.description: Pavilion is a government purchasing platform that helps public-sector buyers find vendors, get quotes, and buy what they need without the guesswork. It connects procurement teams at 3,500+ SLED (state, local, and education) agencies with qualified vendors, surfaces the most direct compliant route to purchase based on each agency's rules and existing cooperative contracts, and lets vendors claim a free supplier profile to get discovered. The product is 100% free for public agencies. Pavilion is a SaaS marketplace backed by Forerunner Ventures.

companies.name: Workrise
companies.description: Workrise - which returned to its original RigUp brand in September 2024 - is an Austin-based source-to-pay platform for the energy industry, combining vendor management, contingent workforce staffing, bid management, capital management, and field-service payments for upstream and midstream oil and gas operators. Backed by a16z and Founders Fund. The company publishes no public developer portal or API documentation; platform access is through accounts.rigup.com (OpenID Connect via Auth0), and its engineering org open-sources utilities at github.com/rigup.

companies.name: Glife
companies.description: Glife Technologies Pte Ltd is a Singapore-based food-tech company on a mission to grow a better food future across Southeast Asia. Glife operates a farm-to-table commerce and supply-chain platform that connects farmers and suppliers with restaurants, retailers, and consumers — spanning sourcing, pricing, ordering, inventory, warehousing, and delivery. Its web and mobile applications are backed by a GraphQL API (api-sg.glifeware.com) exposing commerce, content, and supply-chain operations. Glife is backed by 500 Global.

companies.name: Lineage
companies.description: Lineage, Inc. (Nasdaq: LINE) is the world's largest temperature-controlled warehousing and logistics REIT, operating a global cold-chain network of more than 480 facilities across North America, Europe and Asia-Pacific. It provides cold storage and automated warehousing, blast freezing, food manufacturing and processing support, direct-to-consumer fulfillment, and an integrated transportation arm spanning freight forwarding, customs brokerage, drayage, temperature-controlled rail, managed transportation and multi-vendor consolidation. Its customer-facing technology is Lineage Link, a supply chain platform providing real-time visibility into inventory, orders, appointments and shipment status across the facility network, supported by proprietary systems including the Sybil warehouse-optimization algorithm and the Lineage Eye computer-vision receiving system. Lineage publishes no public API, developer portal or API documentation as of 2026-07-19; customer integration runs through Lineage Link and account teams rather than a self-service developer program. This profile therefore captures the verified identity, discovery and domain-security surface rather than an API contract.

companies.name: Meal Ticket
companies.description: Meal Ticket is a Boise, Idaho-based SaaS company (founded 2011) delivering profitability management software for the foodservice supply chain. Its TrackMax+ platform helps food distributors and suppliers manage rebates, allowances, trade programs, payments, and operator-level intelligence at line-item detail, while its MarketMan platform provides AI-powered inventory and food-cost management to 15,000+ restaurant locations across 55+ countries. Meal Ticket serves 100+ distributors and suppliers and processes $40B+ in annual sales and rebate volume. The company operates as a customer-facing SaaS with a single-sign-on login surface (OpenID Connect) but does not publish a public developer API, developer portal, or API documentation.

companies.name: CloudTrucks
companies.description: CloudTrucks (operated by Cloud Technologies, Inc.) is a San Francisco-based virtual trucking carrier and business-management platform for owner-operators and small trucking fleets. The platform aggregates freight loads from more than fifty brokers and shippers into a single app, and layers on load booking, dispatching, real-time tracking, instant pay on proof of delivery, invoicing, factoring, fuel discounts (FuelApp), insurance, and back-office financial tooling so independent drivers can run their business from a phone. CloudTrucks also operates Exchange for shippers and brokers plus a freight-agent program, and is backed by Craft Ventures, Kindred Ventures and Menlo Ventures. CloudTrucks does not publish a public developer API or documentation portal; this profile captures its public web, legal, support and mobile-app surface plus a domain-security probe.

companies.name: Food Market Hub
companies.description: Food Market Hub is a cloud-based procurement, inventory, and supply-chain management platform for food-and-beverage businesses, founded in Malaysia and headquartered in Petaling Jaya, Selangor. It automates back-end operations for restaurants, cafes, and central kitchens — connecting F&B outlets with their suppliers and central kitchens to handle purchase-order creation, smart ordering, inventory tracking, food-cost and wastage control, supplier management, and real-time reporting. The platform serves brands such as KFC, Pizza Hut, Salad Atelier, and Kenny Hills alongside thousands of independent restaurants across Southeast Asia (Malaysia, Indonesia, and China), and is delivered through web and iOS/Android mobile apps. Food Market Hub is a 500 Global portfolio company. As of this profile the company exposes no public developer API, developer portal, or API documentation; integrations (including POS sales-data connections) are handled directly by the company.

companies.name: Kaman Corporation
companies.description: Kaman Corporation is a major US corporation and Fortune 1000 company. The Kaman Corporation API provides programmatic access to its platform services, data, and integrations for enterprise customers and partners.

companies.name: Nium
companies.description: Nium is a global payments infrastructure platform for cross-border payouts, collections, FX, and card issuing. Serves financial institutions, fintechs, and corporates with a single API.

companies.name: Panjiva
companies.description: Panjiva is a supply chain intelligence platform owned by S&P Global Market Intelligence that delivers data-driven insights for the global trade community. It combines global import/export shipment records with machine learning analytics to profile companies, map supply chains, benchmark competitors, surface sales leads, and assess counterparty and supply-chain risk. Panjiva covers roughly 9 million companies and more than 2 billion shipment records spanning an estimated 35% of global trade flows. Trade data is also delivered programmatically to CRM systems, quantitative models, and research workflows through S&P Global's XpressFeed data-feed service and is surfaced inside S&P Capital IQ Pro. Access is enterprise and subscription based; Panjiva does not publish a public self-serve developer API portal.

companies.name: Pietra
companies.description: Pietra is an AI-powered commerce platform for fast-growing consumer brands and creators. It unifies sourcing, production, fulfillment, logistics, marketing, and operations in a single platform — giving brands access to a network of 40,000+ global suppliers and factories, integrated third-party (3PL) fulfillment infrastructure, AI assistants that automate content creation and affiliate/influencer campaigns, competitive intelligence and social listening, and e-commerce software to run a direct-to-consumer business. Founded in 2019 and backed by Andreessen Horowitz (a16z). As of this profile, Pietra does not publish a public developer API or developer portal.

companies.name: Resourcify
companies.description: Resourcify (Resourcify GmbH) is a Hamburg, Germany based digital platform for waste management and circular-economy operations, describing itself as "the operating system for a circular future." Its cloud software helps enterprises digitize and optimize their waste streams end to end - automating waste and recycling operations, optimizing cost, CO2 and recycling rates, tracking compliance, and running take-back systems - across manufacturing, construction, retail, healthcare, and airports. The platform connects waste producers with a network of recyclers and haulers, captures waste data and documentation, and reports on sustainability and material recovery. Resourcify is backed by Speedinvest. As of this profile the company exposes no public developer API, API documentation, or developer portal; integrations are delivered as managed connections rather than a self-serve API.

companies.name: Shopventory
companies.description: Thrive by Shopventory is inventory management, catalog control, and reporting software for small and medium-sized retail, restaurant, and hospitality businesses. Founded in 2012 out of a San Diego boutique and a graduate of the Techstars Boulder accelerator, Shopventory syncs stock, sales, and cost-of-goods data across multiple locations and sales channels, and integrates with Square, Shopify, Clover, BigCommerce, WooCommerce, and QuickBooks Online. The platform offers barcode scanning, purchase-order automation, demand forecasting, bundles and component-level tracking, price-tag printing, and advanced custom reporting. The company operates as Thrive by Shopventory (thrivemetrics.com). Its former public developer API (apidocs.shopventory.com) is no longer resolvable, so this profile captures the company's live web, support, and integration surface plus probed domain-security posture rather than a public API specification.

companies.name: Souco
companies.description: Souco (株式会社souco / souco Co., Ltd.) operates a warehouse-sharing marketplace and logistics resource optimization platform in Japan, connecting cargo owners with available space across a nationwide network of 3,000+ warehouses spanning all 47 prefectures. Businesses can secure short- or long-term storage on demand for a wide range of cargo — food ingredients, apparel, machinery, and documents — under ambient, refrigerated, frozen, or temperature-controlled conditions, with pickup and delivery coordination handled by the platform. Alongside the sharing marketplace, souco offers a rental-warehouse search portal, transportation services, and the Optis engine for optimizing logistics networks, plus consulting and DX support for the logistics industry. The company is backed by 500 Global and Sumitomo Corporation's corporate venture arm. souco is a customer-facing logistics platform and does not currently publish a public developer API, SDKs, or developer documentation; its digital surface is a login-gated web application at app.souco.space.

companies.name: Trendsi
companies.description: Trendsi is a wholesale clothing supplier and dropshipping platform for online fashion retailers, boutiques, and social-commerce creators. Delivered primarily as a Shopify app and a TikTok Shop integration, Trendsi lets sellers source trendy apparel — dresses, tops, and activewear — and offer dropshipping, open-pack wholesale, private labeling, and made-to-order fulfillment with no upfront inventory. The platform handles sourcing, warehousing, packing, and shipping under the retailer's own brand, with competitive wholesale pricing and fast US shipping. Sellers manage their catalog, orders, and fulfillment from the Trendsi seller portal at app.trendsi.com. Trendsi does not currently publish a public developer API or developer portal; integration with a merchant's store is delivered through its Shopify and TikTok Shop apps.

companies.name: Flock Freight
companies.description: Flock Freight is a freight technology company and licensed freight brokerage that pioneered shared truckload (STL) shipping through its FlockDirect service. Its AI-powered pooling technology algorithmically combines multiple partial shipments from different businesses into a single multi-stop full truckload, giving shippers truckload-level service, damage rates, and speed without paying for a full trailer, while cutting empty miles and carbon emissions. The platform provides automated spot rating via API, TMS integrations, and EDI connectivity (204/210/211/214/990/997) for shippers and carriers. Backed by GV and the SoftBank Vision Fund, the company is a certified B Corporation.

companies.name: Noosh
companies.description: Noosh is a marketing execution and print/procurement management platform that gives enterprise marketing teams visibility and control over campaigns spanning direct mail, print, and point-of-sale (POS) materials. The software coordinates collaborative marketing workflows, agency and supplier performance tracking, vendor diversity management, and cost, quality, time, and sustainability data, and integrates with procurement and other enterprise systems. Noosh was surfaced as a portfolio company of Accel and profiled in the API Evangelist network. Noosh operates a customer-facing web application (Procurement Portal and Administration Portal) but does not publish a public developer API, SDK, or developer portal.

companies.name: Brightfield
companies.description: Brightfield is an extended-workforce intelligence company whose TDX (Talent Data Exchange) and TDX AI platform give enterprises data, automation, and precision over contingent-labor and statement-of-work (SOW) spending across 100+ countries. Products include Rate Intelligence, Rate Card Manager, SOW Rate Insights, SOW Quality and Risk Analytics, Supplier Scorecard, and an ROI Dashboard, built on transaction-level data from 700+ companies and $500B+ of global spend. Founded and led by CEO Jason Ezratty and headquartered in Washington, DC, Brightfield is backed by Sapphire Ventures. The product is delivered as a login-gated SaaS application; no public developer API or documentation surface is published at this time.

companies.name: CADDi
companies.description: CADDi is a Tokyo-headquartered manufacturing-technology company that builds an AI Data Platform for industrial manufacturers. Its two products, CADDi Drawer and CADDi Quote, aggregate scattered 2D engineering drawings and supply-chain data into a single searchable asset, offering keyword and drawing-similarity search, automatic extraction of dimensions, text and shapes, and AI-assisted quotation and sourcing. The platform serves procurement, engineering, sales, production, quality, and leadership teams across automotive, robotics, and precision-machinery sectors, and connects to ERP, CAM, CAD, and quality systems via batch and CSV imports. CADDi was surfaced as a portfolio company of Atomico and DCM Ventures and added to the API Evangelist network. It does not currently publish a public developer API or SDK.

companies.name: Flecto
companies.description: Flecto is a SaaS platform for rental businesses, providing tools to manage bookings, inventory, payments, and customer verification across both online and in-store channels. Backed by Techstars, the company offers "The Flecto Link" for flexible checkout, ID and face-scan verification, item protection and insurance, a hosted online store builder, and the Flecto Market marketplace. It supports payment methods including MB Way, PayPal, Mastercard, and Apple Pay. Flecto does not currently publish a public API or developer platform; this profile tracks its public web and business surface.

companies.name: InventoryQuant
companies.description: InventoryQuant automates inventory and contents documentation for the insurance claims industry. Public adjusters, restoration firms, and insurance claim handlers record video or audio walkthroughs of a loss, and the platform transcribes each spoken line item, detects and describes the contents, matches replacement pricing from major retailers, and generates a submission-ready report in XactContents or PDF format. It supports smart glasses, photos, multiple speakers, self-corrections, background noise, and 100+ languages, turning days of manual contents-claim work into minutes. Founded in the Y Combinator Winter 2026 batch by Sander Schulhoff.

companies.name: Makersite
companies.description: Makersite is an AI-powered Product Lifecycle Intelligence platform that helps manufacturers manage product sustainability, cost, and compliance by connecting products to deep-tier supply chain, material, and chemical data. The platform automates lifecycle assessments (LCA) and product carbon footprint (PCF) calculations, supports eco-design and cost optimization, and produces regulatory reporting such as EU Taxonomy and CBAM. It integrates with enterprise CAD, ERP, and PLM systems (PTC Windchill, Siemens Teamcenter, Autodesk, ANSYS). Makersite is a portfolio company of Partech. As of this enrichment pass it publishes no public developer API or developer portal.

companies.name: Omnitracs
companies.description: Omnitracs is a commercial fleet management, telematics, and transportation-management provider, now part of Solera Inc. (acquired 2021, operating under Solera Fleet Solutions). Its Omnitracs One platform and the Omnitracs Roadnet routing platform serve roughly 15,000 fleet customers with ELD / Hours-of-Service compliance, telematics and GPS positioning, driver workflow and messaging, routing and dispatch, and video safety. Omnitracs exposes real integration APIs and web services (Roadnet Web Services, the Services Portal Entity Management web services, and the SOAP/XML Event Subscription Service that streams positions, messages, HOS, and critical events), but access is partner- and customer-account gated - there is no open, self-service public developer portal. API credentials (a username/password with API access) and the integration developer wiki are provisioned to contracted customers and integration partners. Endpoints documented here for gated surfaces are honestly modeled from public integration notes, not from an open reference.

companies.name: Clutter
companies.description: Clutter is a full-service, on-demand storage and moving company (clutter.com) that picks up, professionally packs and photo-catalogs customers' belongings, stores them in secure 24/7-monitored warehouses, and redelivers individual items on demand. Founded in 2013 and once a SoftBank-backed unicorn, Clutter merged with MakeSpace and was acquired by Iron Mountain in 2023; it now operates as "Clutter by Iron Mountain" serving major US metros and Toronto. This is a consumer-facing services company with a customer account portal and booking flow but no public developer program or API; the record is maintained in the API Evangelist network for company/portfolio tracking.

companies.name: Jala
companies.description: JALA is an Indonesian aquaculture technology company providing end-to-end solutions for the shrimp farming industry, describing itself as a fully connected system powered by data farmers can trust. It connects farmers, processors, and buyers through the JALA App for real-time pond monitoring and data analytics, the Baruni technology platform, farming supplies (post-larvae, feed, technical assistance), harvest and cold-chain logistics services, and traceable certified supply chains for processors and buyers. Backed by 500 Global, JALA operates a consumer/operator SaaS platform (app.jala.tech) rather than a public developer API program. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio-company lead and enriched by the pipeline.

companies.name: Odeko
companies.description: Odeko is a cafe operations platform that keeps independent coffee shops and cafes stocked by combining predictive ordering, overnight supply delivery, and mobile ordering plus rewards management through a single dashboard. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of GGV Capital and Y Combinator and added to the API Evangelist network. Odeko publishes no first-party developer API; its public odeko.com storefront runs on Shopify, which provisions agentic-commerce surfaces (llms.txt, UCP profile, and a UCP shopping MCP endpoint) on the domain. This profile captures those real domain artifacts.

companies.name: Route
companies.description: Route is a post-purchase platform for e-commerce brands that helps merchants own the customer experience after checkout. Its core products are package protection (shipping insurance covering lost, stolen, or damaged orders), AI-driven returns that reduce refunds and returns fraud, and real-time order and package tracking for shoppers. Route serves both merchants and their customers through storefront widgets, a mobile app, and a developer API documented on Stoplight. The company is backed by Craft Ventures.

companies.name: SmartHop
companies.description: SmartHop is a fleet and trip management platform for small trucking companies, owner-operators, and independent dispatchers. It aggregates real-time loads from multiple freight sources into a single load board and provides load booking, trip creation and management, dispatch management, payroll, profit optimization, market analysis, and performance reporting. SmartHop consumes third-party freight APIs from partners including DAT Freight & Analytics, C.H. Robinson, Loadsmart, Redwood Logistics, Newtrul, and Parade, but does not publish a public developer API of its own; its api.smarthop.co host backs the SmartHop web and mobile apps rather than a documented external API.

companies.name: Aily Labs
companies.description: Aily Labs is a Munich-based enterprise AI company that builds an AI Decision Intelligence Suite — a platform that connects siloed internal and external data to deliver real-time, explainable predictions and recommendations across Finance, R&D, Supply Chain, Manufacturing, Quality, Go-To-Market, Procurement, and People functions. The suite ships with 300+ validated predictive models and an iOS app, and is deployed across Healthcare & Life Sciences, Consumer Goods, Luxury & Fashion, Media & Tech, Retail, and Services (clients include Sanofi). Aily Labs is a portfolio company of Insight Partners. It exposes no public developer API; this profile captures the company's corporate, security, and compliance surface.

companies.name: Betterleap
companies.description: Betterleap is an AI-powered healthcare recruiting platform that automates candidate sourcing, credential verification, and multi-step outreach for talent acquisition teams. Its agentic search lets recruiters describe an ideal candidate conversationally and surfaces qualified matches from a database of 35M+ verified healthcare professionals, with licensing verified through 25+ state board partnerships. The platform autonomously drafts and sends personalized email sequences with follow-ups, integrates with ATS platforms such as Workday, Oracle, and UKG for talent rediscovery and data refresh, and reports recruiting performance and ROI through an insights dashboard. Betterleap is a venture-backed company (a16z portfolio) added to the API Evangelist network; it operates as a SaaS web application and does not currently publish a public developer API.

companies.name: Forward Air
companies.description: Forward Air is a major US corporation and Fortune 1000 company. The Forward Air API provides programmatic access to its platform services, data, and integrations for enterprise customers and partners.

companies.name: Heartland Express
companies.description: Heartland Express is a major US corporation and Fortune 1000 company. The Heartland Express API provides programmatic access to its platform services, data, and integrations for enterprise customers and partners.

companies.name: Knight-Swift Transportation
companies.description: Knight-Swift Transportation is a major US corporation and Fortune 1000 company. The Knight-Swift Transportation API provides programmatic access to its platform services, data, and integrations for enterprise customers and partners.

companies.name: Metalshub
companies.description: Metalshub (Metals Hub GmbH) is a Berlin-based digital platform for the metals, mining, and recycling industries, enabling over 2,800 industry participants to buy, sell, and trade raw materials online. Its procurement, sales, and tolling solutions help companies source ferroalloys, minor metals, noble alloys, and recycled materials, discover new suppliers and customers, run digital tenders and auctions, and manage the full transaction lifecycle from negotiation to contract. Backed by Point Nine and other investors, Metalshub operates a login-gated trading application at trade.metals-hub.com. No public API or developer program was found during enrichment.

companies.name: Partsimony
companies.description: Partsimony is an intelligent supply chain platform that helps hardware companies turn engineering designs into manufactured products with less time, cost, and friction. Its software analyzes component designs to recommend manufacturing methods, materials, price estimates, and lead times, then matches each part to the optimal manufacturers inside and outside a company's network — batching components for volume leverage across processes like 3D printing, CNC machining, injection molding, castings, electronics, and assemblies. The platform also coordinates RFPs, proposals, orders, messaging, and payment terms between OEMs and their manufacturing partners. Partsimony operates a web application and product documentation but does not currently publish a public developer API. Founded in 2015 and based in Brooklyn, NY; backed by Techstars.

companies.name: Vallor
companies.description: Vallor (Board AI, Inc.) is an AI coworker for procurement, legal, and sales teams that puts contracts on autopilot. Val reads every contract across the existing stack, drafts redlines against a playbook, flags risks, monitors obligations, renewals, SLAs, and rebates against live ERP and AP data, and answers plain-English questions with citations back to the source clause. It connects to 1,000+ systems including SAP, NetSuite, Snowflake, Salesforce, Ironclad, Icertis, DocuSign, and Slack, and ships a first-party Claude Code / Cowork plugin marketplace with 32 agent skills and 9 background agents for contract management and strategic sourcing. SOC 2 Type II audited and GDPR compliant, with customer data staying in the customer tenant. Backed by Bloomberg Beta.

companies.name: Deposco
companies.description: Deposco is a cloud supply chain execution platform combining order management (OMS) and warehouse management (WMS) for retailers, brands, 3PLs, and DTC ecommerce sellers. Its Bright Suite gives real-time visibility into inventory, orders, and shipments across the fulfillment lifecycle - receiving, putaway, picking, packing, and shipping. Deposco integrates through a REST API exposed on its Developer Portal (developer.deposco.com) using resource paths under /integration/{code}/, secured with OAuth 2.0 / per-merchant API credentials and scoped by tenant code and business unit. API access is provisioned per customer through a Deposco account manager rather than through open self-service signup, and Deposco also ships 150+ pre-built connectors and EDI integrations.

companies.name: Tillpoint
companies.description: Tillpoint is a modular, cloud-based EPOS (electronic point of sale) and business management platform for retail, hospitality, and services. A single subscription bundles 25+ modules - Point of Sale, Inventory, Customers/CRM, Staff, Accounting, Purchase Orders, Reporting, and more - across one terminal or thousands of locations. As of this review Tillpoint does not publish a documented public or partner developer API - there is no developer portal, no API reference, and no OpenAPI. Connectivity is delivered through pre-built integrations (QuickBooks Online, Xero, WooCommerce, PayPal, Worldpay, Mailchimp). The API surfaces catalogued here (Point of Sale, Inventory, Customers, Accounting) are logical capability areas of the platform and are honestly marked as endpointsModeled - no endpoints are fabricated. Direct/programmatic access requires contacting Tillpoint.

companies.name: AfterShip
companies.description: AfterShip is an e-commerce shipment tracking and post-purchase platform. APIs cover trackings, couriers, notifications, returns, and email.

companies.name: CMA CGM
companies.description: CMA CGM is a Marseille-headquartered French container shipping, logistics, and port operator and the third-largest ocean carrier in the world. Founded in 1978 by Jacques Saadé and led today by Chairman & CEO Rodolphe Saadé, the CMA CGM Group operates a fleet of 593 vessels with 4.5 million TEU of capacity calling 420 ports across 160 countries on 257 maritime services. The group includes maritime brands ANL, APL, CNC Line, Containerships, Comanav, and Mercosul Line; terminal operator CMA Terminals and Terminal Link; the CEVA Logistics contract logistics and freight forwarding business (acquired 2019); CMA CGM Air Cargo; Brittany Ferries and La Méridionale passenger ferries; and the CMA Média portfolio (La Provence, La Tribune, BFM-RMC, Brut).
