Through api-portal.cma-cgm.com the group exposes a DCSA-aligned REST API surface — Track and Trace v1 (DCSA v2.2.0), Schedules, Booking Request, Quotation, and Invoice — plus a parallel EDI catalog (EDIFACT IFTSAI, IFTMBF, IFTSTA, INVOIC) and group-level digital initiatives including ZEBOX (startup accelerator), Traxens-based IoT smart containers, and a strategic AI partnership with Mistral.

companies.name: Regrello
companies.description: Regrello is an AI operating system for manufacturing and supply chain operations, giving teams that are stuck in email and stifled by decades-old ERPs an agentic AI platform to accelerate innovation and productivity. Its product, Agentforce Operations, orchestrates enterprise manufacturing and supply chain workflows with generative AI. Regrello was acquired by Salesforce and is backed by a16z and Bloomberg Beta. This profile currently exposes no public API, developer portal, or documentation surface; it is tracked in the API Evangelist network for its identity, security posture, and published compliance program.

companies.name: Sunlight
companies.description: Sunlight is an educational-spending platform that lets organizations fund learning for their people. Administrators create groups, invite registered or unregistered members, allocate a per-user education budget ("sunlight"), and let members place orders for courses, books and subscriptions from providers such as Amazon and Platzi, while an activity feed tracks what members join and buy. Its REST API is built on the JSON:API specification (media type application/vnd.api+json) with Bearer-token authentication, and exposes groups, group membership and invitations, per-user credit/budget transactions, orders, and activities. Sunlight was backed by Seedcamp and Speedinvest.

companies.name: Olive Technologies
companies.description: Olive is an AI-native vendor evaluation and technology procurement platform that runs the full RFP lifecycle in a single workspace — from requirements management and stakeholder collaboration through AI-powered comparative vendor scoring and final selection. It maintains vendor intelligence across more than 12,000 vendors and 380+ categories, and is built for IT leaders, procurement teams, and consultancies who need unbiased, structured software sourcing. Olive is a Techstars-backed company; by design it takes no fees from vendors, funding the platform through buyer subscriptions instead. Olive has no public developer API surface — no documentation, SDKs, or API reference are published at this time; this profile captures the company's public web and security posture.

companies.name: SVT Robotics
companies.description: SVT Robotics builds the SOFTBOT Platform, a software integration and orchestration foundation for warehouse automation and the supply chain. Founded in 2018 and headquartered in Norfolk, Virginia, the company lets enterprises connect industrial systems, robotics, AMRs, and warehouse management software through standardized, prebuilt SOFTBOT Connectors — reducing integration complexity and enabling real-time visibility, faster automation deployments, and a resilient data backbone for automation and AI. Customers include DHL Supply Chain, Barrett Distribution Centers, and the Hagen Group. The provider operates a developer documentation hub for the SOFTBOT integration API (docs.svtrobotics.com, currently password-protected) and a public status page; no public OpenAPI, SDK, or open API surface was discoverable at enrichment time.

companies.name: Certa
companies.description: Certa (operated by Opinr, Inc. d/b/a Certa) is an AI-native third-party risk management (TPRM) and compliance platform that unifies the full third-party lifecycle — onboarding, due diligence, contract management, continuous compliance monitoring, and offboarding — in a single no-code system. Founded by Jag Lamba and headquartered in Saratoga, CA, Certa serves Fortune 500 companies (Honeywell, Uber, Mars, Box, Quantcast) across 120+ countries and 17 languages. The platform covers all risk domains — operational and resilience, infosec and cyber, compliance and legal, financial and credit, reputational, geopolitical, and ESG and ethical risk — via its Studio no-code process designer, Certa Connect (130+ native integrations), and embedded AI agents. Certa was named a Leader in the inaugural 2026 Gartner Magic Quadrant for Third-Party Risk Management Tools. External integration is available through an enterprise external API surfaced from the platform; no public OpenAPI or developer portal is published as of this profile.

companies.name: Djust
companies.description: DJUST is a French all-in-one, modular B2B commerce platform that helps distributors, wholesalers, manufacturers and retailers launch and automate their B2B eCommerce and eProcurement operations. The platform covers automated order management (24/7 online ordering), AI-assisted quoting with automatic pricing and discounts, integrated online payments with deadline tracking, a conversational AI sales assistant, real-time sales analytics, and prebuilt ERP/CRM integrations. Customers include Eiffage, Auchan Retail and Lesaffre; DJUST reports EUR 1.5B GMV and 2M orders processed in 2025. Backed by Speedinvest.

companies.name: Faire
companies.description: Faire is a wholesale marketplace connecting independent retailers with brands. The Faire External API v2 supports both sides of the marketplace: brand-side endpoints for products, orders, inventory, and shipments, and retailer-side endpoints for browsing and ordering.

companies.name: Lyric
companies.description: Lyric is an AI-powered supply chain software company, founded in 2022 and backed by Insight Partners. Its Lyric Studio platform lets enterprises model, plan, and optimize their supply chains across four composable layers — Data (enterprise-grade data management and integrations), Algorithms (advanced supply chain science), Workflows (flexible, composable processes), and Models & Apps (ready-to-use applications). The platform spans network modeling, transportation optimization, inventory management, forecasting, routing, and scheduling. Lyric does not publish a public developer API surface; its product documentation at docs.lyric.tech is gated behind a Lyric Studio login. It does operate a public SafeBase security and trust portal documenting SOC 2, SOC 3, ISO/IEC 27001, GDPR, CCPA, CPRA, and CSA STAR Level 1 posture plus a responsible disclosure program.

companies.name: Greenwork
companies.description: Greenwork builds software for the HVAC (heating, ventilation, and air conditioning) industry and is backed by GV (Google Ventures). Its flagship product, Onsite Pro, is a digital pricebook and proposal platform for HVAC distributors and their dealers: it replaces Excel and PDF catalogs with searchable product data, automated AHRI equipment matchups, incentive and rebate application, and one-click proposal generation, while giving distributors visibility into dealer catalog performance, win rates, and share of wallet. Greenwork does not currently publish a public developer API, SDKs, or API documentation; this profile captures the company identity and its public web and security posture for the API Evangelist network.

companies.name: Mercanto
companies.description: Mercanto (mercanto.mx) is a Mexican B2B wholesale marketplace that supplies restaurants, cafeterias, and food-service businesses with ingredients, groceries, cleaning supplies, and packaging bought at wholesale from vetted suppliers, with negotiated pricing and next-day delivery. Buyers order across categories including produce, groceries and pantry, dairy and eggs, proteins and cold cuts, bakery and desserts, beverages, frozen foods, and non-food items, while Mercanto handles supplier selection, negotiation, and fulfillment. The company is backed by Bain Capital Ventures. Its customer-facing storefront runs on a private backend (api.mercanto.mx) that is not publicly documented for third-party developers, so there is no public API product, developer portal, or SDK surface at this time.

companies.name: Nowports
companies.description: Nowports is a digital freight forwarder for Latin America, offering technology-enabled international logistics across ocean, air, and ground freight. Its Centraliza platform centralizes shipment tracking, document management, and alerts, while adjacent services cover cargo insurance and GPS tracking (Protege) and inventory financing and factoring (Financia). Backed by Partech and Y Combinator, Nowports serves importers and exporters on major trade routes through its authenticated web app at app.nowports.com. As of this profile Nowports exposes no public developer API, SDK, or developer portal; access is via its authenticated web platform.

companies.name: Alcove
companies.description: Alcove is an AI-powered procurement and project management platform built for interior designers, contractors, event planners, and purchasing agents. It consolidates product details, quotes, financials, and order tracking into a single hub, automatically tracking orders across vendors and projects, managing tasks and timelines, calculating profitability and markups, and offering a purchasing service with Designer Net discounts. An AI assistant surfaces financial insights, suggests markups, reviews approvals, and powers filtering. Alcove is a Menlo Ventures portfolio company. As of this enrichment pass it publishes a marketing site and web application but no public API, developer documentation, or SDKs.

companies.name: Dollar Tree
companies.description: Dollar Tree is a leading operator of discount variety stores in North America, operating more than 16,000 stores under the Dollar Tree and Family Dollar banners. Vendor and supplier integration is primarily handled through EDI, SAP, and ERP systems via the Dollar Tree Vendor Portal. No public REST API is currently available.

companies.name: Relay Payments
companies.description: Relay Payments operates a secure digital payment network purpose-built for the freight and trucking industry. Its mobile app and platform let carriers, owner-operators, brokers, and merchants transact contactlessly for diesel fuel, lumper (dock unloading) fees, scales, parking, truck repairs, and freight payments between brokers and carriers, replacing cash, fleet checks, and legacy fuel cards while reducing fraud and streamlining back-office reconciliation. Relay is backed by Ribbit Capital. Partner/system integration is offered under a Relay System Integration Agreement, with developer documentation gated behind partner authentication at docs.relaypayments.com; no public API specification is currently published.

companies.name: ACV Auctions
companies.description: ACV Auctions is a digital wholesale marketplace for the automotive industry, operating the leading online platform for dealer-to-dealer used-vehicle auctions across the United States. Franchise and independent dealers source and sell inventory through daily online auctions backed by third-party vehicle inspections, detailed condition reports, and the company's data and analytics products. ACV also offers complementary services including vehicle transportation, dealer floor-plan financing through ACV Capital, and inventory-management and pricing tools. The company is publicly traded and headquartered in Buffalo, New York. It does not currently publish a public developer API or developer portal; this profile captures its public identity and security posture.

companies.name: Cogoport
companies.description: Cogoport is a global logistics and supply chain platform offering freight booking, customs, trade finance, and supply chain visibility for businesses across ocean, air, and inland transport. It provides ocean (FCL and LCL) and air freight booking with real-time rate discovery, customs clearance and compliance support, trade finance including invoice financing and pay-later solutions, end-to-end shipment tracking, and logistics tools such as an HS Code Finder, container trackers, and shipping cost calculators. Cogoport is backed by Accel and headquartered in India, serving importers and exporters worldwide.

companies.name: Deep Rooted
companies.description: Deep Rooted.Co is a direct-to-consumer fresh produce brand operated by Clover Ventures Pvt. Ltd, a Bengaluru-based agritech company founded in 2018 that launched the Deep Rooted consumer brand in 2020. The company works with a network of small-scale farmers using greenhouse and hydroponic techniques within roughly 150km of Bengaluru and Hyderabad, providing agronomy support from seed to harvest and delivering fruits, vegetables, Indian staples and greens, exotic produce and an easy-cook range direct to households the morning after ordering. Deep Rooted is backed by Accel. It sells through a consumer web storefront and mobile apps; it publishes no public developer portal, API documentation, or machine-readable API specification, so this profile captures company identity and web properties only.

companies.name: Ontruck
companies.description: Ontruck is a Spanish road-freight technology platform that connects shippers (cargadores) with a network of professional carriers (transportistas) for full-truckload and less-than-truckload pallet, package, and parcel transport across Spain, France, and wider Europe. Shippers get instant AI-driven pricing, automated carrier assignment, real-time traceability, and digital documentation through service tiers (Economy, Flex, Express); carriers get access to freight loads with dynamic pricing and 24/7 support. Ontruck also packages its stack as "Ontruck AI Tech" — an AI pricing engine, AI routing engine, a predictive incident system, and a forecast/capacity planner — offered as transport-management software. The company operates a marketing and customer web surface plus an in-product shipper/carrier application; it publishes no public developer/API portal, OpenAPI, or SDKs at this time.

companies.name: Produce Pay
companies.description: ProducePay is an agtech fintech platform for the global fresh-produce supply chain, giving growers, distributors, and buyers a combination of trade financing and operational tooling. Its offerings include Pre-Season Financing (working capital ahead of the growing season), Quick-Pay (converting produce shipments into immediate cash during peak season), Visibility (real-time shipment tracking, quality control, and data-driven insights), Sourcing (connecting buyers and sellers for long-term partnerships), and Predictable Commerce programs that bundle capital, visibility, and partnerships for year-round supply stability. The company operates a marketplace for its members but publishes no public developer API, developer portal, or API documentation as of this enrichment pass.

companies.name: Replenysh
companies.description: Replenysh is an enterprise circularity platform that runs circular supply chains for brands and recovery facilities. It routes, recovers, verifies, and optimizes material recovery flows across a network of 5,000+ partners, giving enterprises a single control layer for reverse logistics with audit-ready chain-of-custody, pricing, settlement, and compliance documentation. Customers include PepsiCo, Disney, Marriott, and Live Nation. Backed by Kindred Ventures and M13. Surfaced as a portfolio-lead stub and enriched via the API Evangelist pipeline.

companies.name: Spoiler Alert
companies.description: Spoiler Alert is a Boston-based software company (a Techstars portfolio company) that helps consumer packaged goods (CPG) manufacturers, wholesalers, and retailers manage and sell excess, short-dated, and obsolete inventory. Its purpose-built platform digitizes discounting and liquidation processes, matching surplus inventory with the right buyers at the right price through a secondary marketplace, with automated listing generation, dynamic pricing optimization, freight cost management, and performance analytics to recover margin and reduce food and product waste. The platform is delivered as a closed SaaS application (app.spoileralert.com); no public developer API, SDK, or developer portal is currently published.

companies.name: Vector.ai
companies.description: Vector.ai, now operating as Raft (raft.ai), is an AI-powered logistics automation platform for freight forwarders, customs brokers, and trade finance teams. The Raft Intelligence Engine layers organization data, contextual LLMs, orchestration, and specialized governed agents to automate document processing, invoice matching, data extraction, and exception handling across supply chain operations, reporting 20M+ tasks completed by AI agents and 5M+ shipments processed annually. Raft publishes no public developer API; the platform is an enterprise application that integrates with customers' TMS and ERP systems.

companies.name: EAS Innovations Inc
companies.description: EAS Innovations Inc operates ELEV8, an end-to-end, cloud-based dealer management system (DMS) built for independent auto dealers and automotive finance companies. The platform unifies real-time accounting, inventory management, CRM and desking, loan servicing, payments and collections into a single fully-integrated system. It offers per-seat pricing, user-based access rights, user-level audit logs, whitelisted IP addresses, multi-rooftop access and department-level restrictions, and is delivered as a SaaS web application at app.elev8dms.com. EAS Innovations is a 500 Global portfolio company. No public developer API is currently published.

companies.name: Nabu
companies.description: Nabu is an AI-powered customs clearance platform that automates international trade compliance end to end. It collects shipment data from emails, PDFs, Excel files, databases, and TMS records via API, EDI, SFTP, or email, prepares complete compliant customs files, and generates pre-filled import/export declarations ready for submission in standard customs software. Nabu targets customs brokers and declaration teams, offering autonomous processing, workload flexibility to absorb staffing gaps, and full auditability across multiple regions and local regulatory regimes. Backed by Techstars. No public developer API, documentation, or SDKs are published at this time.

companies.name: Ordana
companies.description: Ordana provides AI agents that run wholesale order-desk operations for distributors, reading every order across email, fax, PDF, EDI, voice, SMS and chat, resolving exceptions, communicating with retailers, and closing orders directly into the customer's ERP. Four agents cover the surface: Desk (end-to-end order automation), Voice (inbound/outbound phone ordering), Predict (cart prediction and AOV optimization), and Chat (text/SMS ordering). Ordana sits as an intelligence layer on top of existing ERP and commerce systems via pre-built connectors, and exposes its capabilities through a gated REST API, Webhooks, an MCP (Model Context Protocol) server over HTTP/SSE with OAuth 2.0, and the A2A agent-to-agent protocol. Surfaced as a Techstars portfolio company and enriched into the API Evangelist network.

companies.name: EXIGER
companies.description: Exiger is an AI-native supply chain, third-party, and software supply chain risk and compliance company. Its 1Exiger platform unifies supplier, product, part, component, and risk data into a single system to help organizations map and orchestrate compliant, resilient physical and software supply chains. Product areas span supply chain visibility and optimization, trade and third-party risk and compliance, due diligence intelligence (DDIQ), and software supply chain security (SBOM analysis, from its Ion Channel acquisition). Exiger serves government and commercial customers and is FedRAMP authorized. This profile was surfaced as an Insight Partners portfolio company and enriched from Exiger's public corporate, trust, and legal surfaces; Exiger does not publish a public developer portal, API reference, or client SDKs.

companies.name: Leah
companies.description: Leah, formerly ContractPodAi and legally ContractPod Technologies Limited, is a London-headquartered enterprise agentic AI company that unifies contract lifecycle management, legal transformation, procurement, and finance operations into a single autonomous system. Its Leah Agentic OS platform provides skills-based orchestration, agentic workflows, a natural-language app builder, a library of domain-specific legal, contracting, procurement, and finance agents, and the Leah Maestro enterprise orchestrator. Leah is a five-time Gartner CLM Visionary, is SOC 2 Type II and ISO/IEC 27001:2022 certified, and is used by enterprises including PwC, KPMG, Philips, Alaska Airlines, MUFG, and Cushman & Wakefield. Leah ships pre-built connectors and describes open REST APIs for enterprise integration, but maintains no public developer portal or published API reference — API access is unlocked through the enterprise contract.

companies.name: Minoan
companies.description: Minoan is a hospitality procurement and shoppable-stays platform. Short-term-rental hosts, property managers, hotels, and interior designers source furniture, decor, and home goods at insider/trade pricing through Minoan's purchasing platform, and earn revenue share when guests buy the items they experienced during a stay. Founded to turn every hosted space into a shoppable showroom, Minoan connects properties to hundreds of home-and-lifestyle brands and handles sourcing, checkout, and fulfillment. Backed by Accel. As of this profile Minoan exposes no public developer API; this record captures its public web, security, and llms.txt surface.

companies.name: Tacto
companies.description: Tacto (Tacto Technology GmbH) is a Munich-based AI procurement intelligence platform for manufacturing companies. It unifies internal ERP and engineering data with external market intelligence to power AI agents that automate procurement work across four areas: Supplier Intelligence (centralized supplier management with documents, evaluations and performance data), Spend & Cost Intelligence (spend analysis and savings identification), Sourcing Intelligence (AI-optimized RFQ and price inquiries) and Compliance Intelligence (automated regulatory and supply-chain due-diligence detection). Tacto is ISO/IEC 27001:2022 certified and GDPR compliant with EU-only hosting and an audit log of every AI action. It does not publish a public API or developer program; this profile captures the company's corporate, security and compliance surface.

companies.name: Saia Inc
companies.description: Saia Inc is a major US corporation and Fortune 1000 company. The Saia Inc API provides programmatic access to its platform services, data, and integrations for enterprise customers and partners.

companies.name: WestRock
companies.description: WestRock (now Smurfit Westrock following its 2024 merger with Smurfit Kappa) is one of the world's largest paper and packaging companies. The company provides differentiated paper and packaging solutions including corrugated containers, consumer packaging, displays, and specialty packaging. WestRock serves consumer and industrial markets with an integrated supply chain connecting mills, converting operations, and customers globally.

companies.name: Zageno
companies.description: ZAGENO is a multi-supplier e-commerce marketplace and procurement platform for pharma and life-science R&D labs. It lets scientists search, compare, and order more than 50 million SKUs from over 6,000 global suppliers through a single consolidated catalog and checkout, with real-time availability, spend visibility, and automated approval workflows. ZAGENO connects into enterprise procure-to-pay and ERP systems (Coupa, SAP Ariba, Jaggaer, Procurify, NetSuite, QuickBooks and more) through a single PunchOut/cXML catalog integration rather than a public developer API. Founded in 2015 and headquartered in Cambridge, Massachusetts, it is backed by General Catalyst, Grazia Equity, and Capnamic Ventures.

companies.name: Comstruct
companies.description: Comstruct is a Munich-based construction technology company that provides AI-powered agents to automate the procurement of construction materials. Its platform runs the full procurement workflow from the bill of materials (Leistungsverzeichnis) through supplier inquiry, offer comparison, contract negotiation, digital delivery notes, AI-based invoice verification, and sustainability reporting. Customers include HOCHTIEF, Implenia, Marti, and Leonhard Weiss. Comstruct is backed by GV (Google Ventures). As of enrichment the company publishes no public developer portal, API reference, or OpenAPI definition; this profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network from its public web presence.

companies.name: Riff
companies.description: Riff is an Oslo, Norway based enterprise software company building AI agents for supply chain, procurement, planning, and logistics operations. Its agents automate repetitive back-office work such as chasing supplier order confirmations, updating order and delivery status, matching invoices, and monitoring deliveries, while keeping actions deterministic, auditable, and team-controlled rather than purely generative. Riff integrates non-disruptively with existing ERP systems including SAP, Oracle, Infor, and Microsoft, is EU-based with SOC 2 and ISO 27001 aligned and GDPR compliant data handling, and was founded by veterans of Cognite. The company raised a $16M Series A backed by Northzone and other investors. Riff has no public developer or API program at this time; this profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network as a company record.

companies.name: Partender
companies.description: Partender is a bar and beverage inventory management platform that lets hospitality operators complete a full physical liquor, wine, beer, and keg inventory in roughly fifteen minutes by tap-and-swipe estimating how full each bottle is, at up to 99.2% accuracy. The subscription SaaS spans iOS, Android, and web apps and adds online ordering, purchase orders auto-sorted by distributor, pour-cost and variance reporting, and lightweight accounting so venues can cut time, labor, and inventory loss. Founded in 2012 and backed by 500 Global, Partender serves bars, restaurants, hotels, and stadiums. This profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network; Partender exposes a consumer mobile/web product rather than a publicly documented developer API.

companies.name: IgniteTech
companies.description: IgniteTech is a global, AI-first enterprise software company (headquartered in Austin, Texas, and operating remote-first across 30+ countries) that acquires, revitalizes, and supports mission-critical enterprise software and embeds AI-powered capabilities across its portfolio — an operating model the company brands "AI-DNA." Its Native AI products include Eloquens AI (automated, context-aware email response), MyPersonas (AI digital clones of key employees that answer repetitive questions via a video chat-style interface), and Adminio AI (meeting scheduling through intelligent email orchestration). The IgniteTech Unlimited software library spans acquired enterprise brands such as GFI Software, Khoros (Communities and Care), Jive, DNN, Gensym, Computron, GRID (supply chain, via the Suuchi acquisition), Knova, AnswerHub, ACORN, TradeBeam, and SalesBuilder. Led by CEO Eric Vaughan, the company positions itself as an AI enterprise software company rather than only a software holding company.

companies.name: Leaner Technologies
companies.description: Leaner Technologies (株式会社Leaner Technologies) is a Tokyo-based B2B SaaS company founded on February 22, 2019 by CEO Yusuke Ohira, operating under the mission "調達のスタンダードを刷新し続ける" (continuously renew the standard of procurement). It builds the "Leaner" (リーナー) cloud suite for corporate procurement and purchasing departments: Leaner購買 (purchasing), a purchase-to-pay system covering quotation, approval workflow, ordering, receiving and payment; Leaner sourcing, a quotation and sourcing workspace; Leaner Connect, an SRM supplier-relationship platform; plus procurement BPO and consulting services. The platform aggregates supplier and EC catalogs (including Amazon Business and MonotaRO) into cross-catalog search, and applies AI to classify purchasing data for indirect-spend visibility and cost optimization. The company holds ISMS ISO/IEC 27001:2013 / JIS Q 27001:2014 certification (registration JP21/080659, February 2021). Leaner publishes no public developer portal, API reference, or client SDKs as of this enrichment pass — its integration surface is delivered through partner catalog connections rather than a self-serve API program.

companies.name: Office Luv
companies.description: OfficeLuv is office management and purchasing software that centralizes all of a workplace's ordering into a single platform. It aggregates dozens of vendors and thousands of products (supplies, snacks, cleaning supplies, groceries, and more) into one unified marketplace with consolidated invoicing, spend analytics and reporting, multi-user approval workflows, employee stipends for remote and in-office staff, and optional on-site service for program design, pricing negotiation, and restocking. Customers include Wayfair, Braze, Glassdoor, Hulu, and Upwork. Office Luv was surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network. The product is delivered as a private SaaS web application (app.officeluv.com); no public developer API, OpenAPI, or SDK surface is published at this time.

companies.name: Scimplify
companies.description: Scimplify is a Bengaluru-based advanced specialty chemicals company that combines deep chemical expertise, software, and global manufacturing capacity to make complex chemical supply predictable at scale. Founded in 2023, it operates as a contract research (CRO) and contract manufacturing (CMO) organization across the specialty-chemicals lifecycle, serving pharmaceutical, agrochemical, flavors & fragrances, industrial, beauty & personal care, food & nutrition, dyes & pigments, oleochemicals, flame retardants, and critical-metals industries. Its integrated Scinode platform, IONS R&D and ATOMS manufacturing ecosystems, and Scira AI agentic layer coordinate discovery, sourcing, and production. Scimplify publishes no public developer API; this profile captures its web, content, and domain-security surface.

companies.name: USPS
companies.description: The United States Postal Service (USPS) provides a modern suite of RESTful APIs for address validation, domestic and international pricing, shipping label creation and cancellation, tracking, and service standards through its developer portal. The APIs replace the legacy Web Tools platform and use OAuth 2.0 Client Credentials for authentication. The platform supports both production and TEM (Testing Environment for Mailers) endpoints for developing and validating shipping integrations.

bands.label: Minimal
bands.blurb: Index entry only; little beyond a description and a link.

companies.name: BRKZ
companies.description: BRKZ is a Saudi Arabian construction-technology company operating a B2B online marketplace for building materials and construction equipment. Positioned as a top online building materials store in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia (KSA), the platform connects contractors and construction businesses with material suppliers, streamlining procurement and offering nationwide delivery across Saudi Arabia. The bilingual (Arabic and English) storefront lets buyers source construction supplies online, and the company is backed by 500 Global among its investors. This profile was enriched from BRKZ's public web presence; the company runs a private, authenticated API host (api.brkz.com) but does not publish a public developer program, SDKs, or API documentation.

companies.name: CNC24
companies.description: CNC24 is a German online manufacturing platform for ordering custom CNC parts and precision components. Customers upload CAD files (STEP, STP, DWG, DXF, PDF and 3D data) and receive a binding quote within 48 hours, with production routed through a vetted network of 500+ manufacturers across 21 countries and roughly 5,500 machines. An AI-powered matching algorithm assigns each request to partners with the right expertise and production environment. Supported processes include CNC milling, turning, laser and waterjet cutting, sheet metal bending, punching, EDM, 3D printing, injection molding and die casting, serving aerospace, automotive, medical, robotics, construction and energy customers. The platform runs a fully digital workflow from quoting to delivery with order tracking, ISO 9001:2015 quality assurance, AES-256 encryption and anonymized drawings shared with partners. CNC24 is a Seedcamp portfolio company. No public developer API, SDKs or API documentation are published.

companies.name: Diagon
companies.description: Diagon is a California-based industrial equipment sourcing company building Albus, an equipment intelligence platform for manufacturing buyers and sellers. Buyers search across millions of industrial equipment listings, compare models, specifications, pricing and availability, and connect directly with sellers; sellers publish AI-powered catalogs, reach qualified buyer demand, and see live equipment searches in real time. Diagon indexes manufacturing equipment products, suppliers and service providers, bringing hardware, services and financing into a consolidated procurement experience. Founded by a team out of Tesla, Bright Machines, Rivian and Snackpass, and backed by Anthemis under its data, tech and infrastructure thesis. Diagon publishes no public developer API today; its /api surface is an authenticated first-party application API (Clerk-based session auth) and is disallowed in robots.txt.

companies.name: Diagon Technologies
companies.description: Diagon Technologies operates Albus, an industrial equipment intelligence and procurement platform for North American manufacturing. Albus aggregates millions of industrial equipment listings so buyers can search by make, model, or specification, compare equipment specs, pricing, and availability side by side, and connect directly with sellers to request quotes. Sellers publish AI-powered catalogs, reach qualified buyer demand, and see live equipment searches in real time across categories such as subtractive manufacturing, forming, joining, surface treatment, and polymer processing, and OEMs including DMG Mori, Trumpf, Okuma, FANUC, and Mazak. Diagon is a Techstars portfolio company; this profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network.

companies.name: Fashinza
companies.description: Fashinza is a tech-enabled apparel manufacturing and supply-chain platform that connects fashion brands and retailers with a vetted global network of garment manufacturers. It streamlines end-to-end production: sourcing designs and fabrics, AI-powered supplier matching, tech-pack and sample creation, real-time production tracking, quality control, and merchandising and forecasting support so brands can move from design to delivery in shortened 30-45 day cycles. Backed by Accel and Prosus Ventures, the company operates a buyer login and a supplier onboarding surface but publishes no public developer API, documentation, or SDKs at this time.

companies.name: FIFOplus
companies.description: FIFOplus is a B2B smart-procurement marketplace for the HORECA sector (hotels, restaurants, cafes, and catering) in Saudi Arabia, connecting food-service buyers with suppliers across a webstore and mobile app that lists more than 5,000 food and non-food items spanning meat, seafood, dairy, produce, frozen goods, condiments, beverages, packaging, and cleaning supplies. The platform layers ordering, real-time order tracking, inventory, menu, and finance optimization with AI and integrates with point-of-sale systems and credit-terms payment. Founded in 2021 and headquartered in Jeddah, FIFOplus operates across Jeddah, Makkah, Riyadh, and Taif and is backed by the Sanabil 500 MENA Seed Accelerator (500 Global) and Palm Ventures. This profile is maintained by the API Evangelist network; FIFOplus publishes no public developer API, OpenAPI, or developer portal at this time.

companies.name: Fleek
companies.description: Fleek is a B2B wholesale marketplace for vintage and secondhand clothing that connects resellers with a global network of verified suppliers, letting new resellers, full-time resellers, and retail businesses source pre-owned inventory in bulk at wholesale margins. The platform aggregates more than a thousand secondhand suppliers worldwide, handles discovery, ordering, and logistics through its website and mobile apps, and is backed by HV Capital. Fleek operates a consumer/reseller storefront (built on Shopify) and a separate vendor onboarding flow for suppliers; it does not currently publish a public developer API, SDKs, or API documentation. This profile was surfaced from the HV Capital portfolio and enriched from Fleek's public web surface.

companies.name: Freshket
companies.description: Freshket is a Thai agri-food supply chain technology company that operates a B2B online marketplace connecting farmers and food producers directly with restaurants, hotels, catering operations, and food manufacturers. The platform uses technology to manage the fresh-produce and ingredient supply chain more efficiently and transparently, giving buyers quality ingredients at fair prices with reliable next-day delivery while giving growers better market access and pricing. Founded in Bangkok and backed by 500 Global, Freshket covers ordering, sourcing, cold-chain logistics, and account management for foodservice businesses across Thailand. It was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio-company lead; as of this enrichment pass Freshket publishes a customer-facing web and mobile ordering platform but no public developer API, SDKs, or documented API surface.

companies.name: Freterium
companies.description: Freterium is a cloud-native AI Transport Management System (TMS) and unified logistics operating system that connects shippers, carriers, and fleets on a single intelligent layer. It spans first-mile, middle-mile, and last-mile operations across eight integrated modules — order management, AI-powered route planning, collaborative shipper and carrier portals, real-time GPS tracking with predictive ETAs, fleet management, freight billing and costing, intelligent document control, and analytics and reporting — and exposes a documented REST API for ERP/WMS integration alongside 50+ off-the-shelf telematics and hardware integrations. Surfaced to the API Evangelist network as a Partech portfolio company.

companies.name: Harbor Lab
companies.description: Harbor Lab is an AI-powered port cost and disbursement account (DA) management platform for the maritime industry, headquartered in Athens, Greece. Its cloud software helps shipowners, ship managers, charterers, and port agents manage port calls, validate and approve disbursement accounts, benchmark and negotiate port service pricing across a marketplace of thousands of port service providers, and automate payment and settlement — improving operational efficiency, digitizing the process, and delivering cost transparency across port cost management. The company is backed by Speedinvest, VentureFriends, Atomico, and others. As of this profile Harbor Lab exposes a web dashboard product only; no public API, developer portal, or documentation surface was found.

companies.name: Highstock
companies.description: Highstock is a private, AI-native wholesale marketplace that connects consumer brands holding excess or unsold inventory with a vetted network of global business buyers. Focused initially on beauty and personal care, the platform lets brands convert surplus stock into cash while protecting brand value and channel privacy, and gives buyers access to authentic inventory directly from brands at exclusive pricing, with centralized order management and flexible payment terms. The company reports 50+ beauty and personal care brands, 100+ wholesale buyers, $100M+ in listed inventory, and more than 1M pounds of product diverted from landfill, with offices in New York (US) and Gurgaon (India). Highstock does not currently publish a public API or developer program; this profile captures its public web identity and domain-security posture. Added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio lead for enrichment.

companies.name: Leta
companies.description: Leta is a pan-African logistics technology company founded in 2022 and headquartered in Westlands, Nairobi, Kenya, with operations across Kenya, Nigeria and South Africa. Leta builds an AI-driven delivery management platform that helps businesses move goods cheaper and faster while minimising climate impact: route optimization, automated dispatch and broadcast, live GPS track-and-trace, payment on delivery, fleet management, and delivery analytics. The platform is delivered as logistics SaaS plus on-demand and dedicated rider services, including an M-PESA business mini-app, and serves e-commerce, third-party logistics and courier, food and beverage, retail and consumer goods, and pharmacy and healthcare delivery operators. Leta is backed by Speedinvest.

companies.name: Melonn
companies.description: Melonn is a third-party logistics (3PL) and multichannel fulfillment operator for e-commerce businesses across Colombia and Mexico. Through its proprietary Órbita platform it centralizes inventory, processes and packs orders, manages returns, and offers same/next-day delivery, unifying multiple sales channels into a single operation. Melonn connects to platforms such as Shopify, VTEX, WooCommerce, Magento, PrestaShop, MercadoLibre, Amazon, Walmart, Rappi, TikTok Shop, Liverpool, and Coppel, and exposes a REST API with real-time webhooks so any external platform can drive order management, inventory queries, shipment tracking, and returns. Melonn was surfaced as a portfolio company of QED Investors. Public developer documentation and a sandbox are provided on request via the Melonn advisory/contact form rather than an open developer portal.

companies.name: NuORDER
companies.description: NuORDER by Lightspeed is a global B2B commerce platform for wholesale buying and selling between brands and retailers. It combines a fully-branded wholesale eCommerce storefront with account-specific pricing and discounts, an Assortments planning tool for data-driven buying and reduced markdowns, and a Marketplace that connects buyers to 3,000+ brands across fashion, footwear, and apparel. NuORDER exposes a partner-gated REST API at api.nuorder.com for syncing products, orders, catalogs, and customer data with ERP, PIM, and other commerce systems. Acquired by Lightspeed in 2021, it is used by brands including Arc'teryx, Kendra Scott, TOMS, Barbour, and Canada Goose.

companies.name: Pillar
companies.description: Pillar is an Italian construction-technology company, founded in 2025 and headquartered in Milan, building what it calls the operating system for the construction industry (il sistema operativo per l'edilizia). Its cloud platform unifies the back office of building firms (imprese edili) — invoicing (fatturazione), cash-flow management (flussi di cassa), bank reconciliation, quotes and estimates (preventivi), procurement, job and project cost control (gestione commessa), and delivery notes and site work reports (DDT e rapportini) — alongside on-site safety (Pillar Sicurezza) and an AI layer (Pillar AI) that automates data entry in real time, including inputs captured from the job site over WhatsApp. Pillar is backed by Earlybird Venture Capital and today reaches customers through a book-a-demo model rather than a public self-serve signup or a developer-facing API; no public API, SDK, or developer documentation surface was found during enrichment.

companies.name: Planet FWD
companies.description: Planet FWD is a decarbonization software platform that helps consumer brands measure, reduce, and report their carbon emissions. It provides AI-powered product life cycle assessments (LCAs), corporate greenhouse-gas inventories across Scope 1, 2, and 3, and supply-chain decarbonization scenario planning for food & beverage, retail, and apparel companies. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Cowboy Ventures and profiled in the API Evangelist network; no public developer API surface was found at enrichment time.

companies.name: Provi
companies.description: Provi is a B2B beverage alcohol marketplace that digitizes procurement across the three-tier distribution system, connecting buyers (bars, restaurants, and retail stores) with distributors, sales representatives, and suppliers/brands. The platform consolidates product discovery across distributor catalogs, direct messaging with sales reps, order management and processing, and brand showcase tools into a single ordering experience. Provi was surfaced as a portfolio company of Bessemer Venture Partners and added to the API Evangelist network. As of this enrichment pass the company publishes no public developer API, OpenAPI, or developer portal; this profile captures its identity, web properties, and domain-security posture.

companies.name: Rheaply
companies.description: Rheaply is a circular-economy platform for enterprise asset lifecycle management. It gives organizations real-time inventory visibility, an internal reuse marketplace with approval workflows for reallocating surplus furniture, equipment, IT assets, and lab supplies, and sustainable disposition through a network of 3,400+ verified nonprofit and commercial partners. Rheaply helps companies, universities, and governments cut procurement costs, divert waste from landfill, track embodied-carbon savings, and run decommissioning and office move-outs. Backed by Techstars, the company operates a web application at app.rheaply.com. As of this enrichment pass Rheaply publishes no public developer/API program, SDKs, or OpenAPI surface.

companies.name: Sciket
companies.description: Sciket (科研市集, operated by STAREK Scientific / 勢得科研股份有限公司) is Taiwan's specialized online marketplace for scientific research and technology procurement. The platform integrates thousands of global suppliers and millions of products — laboratory consumables and glassware, instruments and equipment, chemical reagents and materials, and industrial tools and hardware — into a single digitized purchasing, sourcing, and fast-shipment service for research labs, academic institutions, quality-control teams, and manufacturers. It offers enterprise purchasing, global sourcing, PunchOut system integration, monthly invoicing, and laboratory-construction services. Sciket runs an internal storefront/API host (api.sciket.com) but does not publish a public developer API program, documentation, or SDKs. This profile was surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio company and enriched with verified identity and domain-security data.

companies.name: Scoutbee
companies.description: Scoutbee is an AI-powered supplier discovery and procurement intelligence platform that helps enterprise buyers instantly find, vet, and connect with trusted suppliers. Founded in 2015 in Berlin, Germany, Scoutbee uses large language models, knowledge-graph technology, and a global supplier network to power supplier discovery, sourcing project execution (Streamline), and a centralized supplier data foundation (DeepSee), surfaced through the Scoutbee Intelligence Platform. Its AI gives procurement, sourcing, and category-management teams recommendations for suppliers matched on qualifications, risk, certifications, sustainability, diversity, cost, and experience. Scoutbee integrates with SAP Ariba guided sourcing and, following its October 2025 acquisition by Coupa, is being embedded into the Coupa Supplier Portal. Scoutbee does not currently publish a public developer API or documentation portal; this profile captures its public identity and web surface.

companies.name: Sourceday
companies.description: SourceDay is an AI-driven supplier collaboration and purchase order (PO) management platform for manufacturers and distributors. It synchronizes buyers, suppliers, and ERP systems in real time to prevent supply chain disruptions, automating PO change management, shipment visibility, supplier scorecards, and request-for-quote (RFQ) workflows. SourceDay reports managing more than $5B in quarterly direct spend across 100K+ activated suppliers, with 500+ certified ERP integrations spanning Acumatica, Epicor (Kinetic and Prophet 21), Infor, and NetSuite. Integration is delivered through certified ERP connectors rather than a public self-serve developer API; there is no public API documentation, developer portal, or published OpenAPI at this time.

companies.name: Sunyur
companies.description: Sunyur (商越科技 / Beijing Sunyur Network Technology Co., Ltd, 北京商越网络科技有限公司) is a Chinese enterprise procurement digitalization company providing AI-driven procurement solutions for large and medium enterprises. Its products include an intelligent procurement middle-platform (采购中台), an SRM supplier relationship management system, an e-procurement SaaS platform, and a procurement mall (采购商城), helping each customer build a dedicated online, digital, and intelligent enterprise procurement platform to raise efficiency and lower cost. Sunyur operates an open integration platform ("聚贤阁", open.sunyur.com) that connects enterprises to 30+ mainstream e-commerce platforms and 10+ third-party applications through a single accessToken-authenticated API surface. Sunyur is backed by Qiming Venture Partners.

companies.name: SyncOnSet Technologies
companies.description: SyncOnSet Technologies is an Emmy Award-winning digital continuity, inventory, and money-tracking platform for film and television production, now part of Entertainment Partners. It replaces paper continuity binders with a collaborative online/offline web and mobile app that manages automatic script breakdowns and revisions, continuity photos, costume and wardrobe pieces, hair and makeup looks, props, set decoration, and locations, alongside per-character and per-scene budgeting and asset reports from prep through wrap. SyncOnSet is a login-gated SaaS application (production teams access it by account) and exposes no public developer API, OpenAPI, or self-serve developer program, so this profile captures its identity, published web properties, and a domain-security probe rather than API artifacts.

companies.name: Tapstitch
companies.description: Tapstitch is a premium, fashion-focused print-on-demand (POD) and dropshipping platform that lets creators and brands design, produce, and sell custom apparel with no inventory, no minimums, and no subscription fees. It provides heavyweight streetwear blanks (250-400+ GSM), DTG and DTF printing, white-label fulfillment, and fashion collection development, with native integrations into Shopify, WooCommerce, Etsy, Wix, Squarespace, and TikTok Shop for automatic product syncing, order routing, and fulfillment tracking. Founded to empower self-expression through clothing, Tapstitch has served 60,000+ creators, shipped over one million garments, and raised a $24.8M Series A led by Forerunner Ventures. Tapstitch does not currently publish a public developer/REST API for headless or custom storefronts; integration is delivered through its e-commerce platform apps and connectors.

companies.name: Tealet
companies.description: Tealet is a wholesale tea marketplace that connects independent tea growers and family farms directly with retailers and businesses. Buyers browse, trace, and order specialty teas sourced from family farms and cooperatives across 8 countries and 15 growing regions, with grower profiles, farm videos, subscription ordering, and a wholesale request flow that emphasize transparency and direct trade from source to cup. Tealet originated in Hawaii and is backed by 500 Startups and Blue Startups. The company operates a consumer/B2B web storefront with account sign-up, newsletter, and blog; it does not currently publish a public developer API, documentation, SDKs, or an MCP server.

companies.name: Tenkara
companies.description: Tenkara is an AI-powered operations and supply chain platform for material manufacturers across food, supplements, cosmetics, chemicals, beverages, and OTC products. The platform automates 75+ workflows spanning supplier sourcing and qualification, procurement, freight and logistics booking, order tracking, and compliance documentation (COA, SDS, and audit records), helping manufacturers find better suppliers faster, prevent delays, and run more efficient operations. Tenkara is backed by True Ventures.

companies.name: Timberhub
companies.description: Timberhub is a European B2B timber trading platform that connects buyers with more than 70 sawmills across 28 countries. It offers timber sourcing with 24-hour quotes, built-in EUDR (EU Deforestation Regulation) compliance automation, and AI-powered workflow automation spanning product matching, logistics, and compliance documentation. The company operates a login-gated web application at app.timberhub.com and, as of this enrichment pass, publishes no public developer API, developer portal, OpenAPI, or machine-readable API documentation. Backed by Creandum, HV Capital, and Speedinvest.

companies.name: VOO (now SideUp)
companies.description: VOO was an Egyptian logistics marketplace that rebranded as SideUp in December 2022, relocating its headquarters to Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. SideUp is a fully integrated courier marketplace that lets e-commerce businesses ship locally and globally from one dashboard, connecting merchants with multiple courier services alongside payment gateways, shipping API integration, warehousing, and fulfillment, with plugins for Shopify, Salla, and OpenCart. Backed by 500 Global, Launch Africa VC, Riyadh Angels, and Alex Angels ($1.2M seed). No public developer portal or API documentation is published as of July 2026.

companies.name: YQN
companies.description: YQN is a global digital logistics platform and NVOCC / digital freight forwarder founded in 2015 and headquartered in Shanghai, China. It lets shippers compare rates, book, and manage international sea freight, air freight, and rail freight, multimodal transport, trucking, customs clearance, cargo insurance, and overseas warehousing online. YQN operates 25+ global branches across North America, Latin America, Southeast Asia, and the Middle East with 1,500+ employees, 300+ shipping and airline partners, and 3,500+ supplier resources. It integrates directly with carriers such as Lufthansa Cargo via carrier APIs for rate-checking, allotment booking, and digital bill-of-lading generation. YQN holds FIATA, IATA, and NVOCC certifications, but publishes no public developer API portal or documentation.

companies.name: Berkshire Grey
companies.description: Berkshire Grey is a Bedford, Massachusetts-based AI and robotics company that builds integrated pick-and-place, parcel sortation, trailer-unloading, and shuttle-sortation systems for eCommerce fulfillment, retail replenishment, and parcel logistics operations. Its product portfolio is organized around four flagship robotic systems — Core robotic picking system, Dispatch parcel sorter, Scoop trailer unloader, and Stride shuttle sorter — supported by the BG Flex mobile robotic platform and a centralized operating environment that orchestrates fleets of industrial-grade mobile robots for induct, transport, sort, sequence, and fulfill workflows including buy-online-pickup-in-store, curbside, and store replenishment. The company holds 700+ awarded patents (300+ pending) and has deployed solutions with Global-100 retailers and logistics service providers including Walmart, Target, and FedEx, with FedEx expanding from small-parcel sortation into broader AI robotic package-handling capabilities. Berkshire Grey originally went public via SPAC merger with Revolution Acceleration Acquisition Corp in 2021, then entered into a definitive merger agreement with SoftBank Group in 2023 (approximately $375M / $1.40 per share) and is now operated as a private SoftBank portfolio company. Integration with warehouse-management systems is delivered through a proprietary RESTful API surfaced via professional services and a 24/7 remote monitoring and predictive-maintenance support model; the API, BG-OS platform, and any associated SDKs are not publicly documented, and Berkshire Grey does not operate a public developer portal, downloadable SDK, or open-source release for its robotic operating environment.

companies.name: Expedock
companies.description: Expedock is a digital business process outsourcing (BPO) and document-automation company for the logistics and freight-forwarding industry. It pairs AI-powered document automation products (FCL/LCL accounts-payable automation, monthly statement automation, and commercial invoice and packing-list data entry) with tech-enabled remote teams supported by operations managers and QA specialists. Freight forwarders, 3PLs, and supply-chain operators use Expedock to digitize shipping documents, automate back-office workflows, and scale operations without scaling headcount. Customers include Maersk, Gebrueder Weiss, and large shippers such as Nike, Adidas, Coca-Cola, and Shell. Expedock is backed by Insight Partners. The company operates a Digital BPO offering and document-automation product suite; it does not currently publish a public developer API, SDKs, or API reference documentation.

companies.name: GoodShip
companies.description: GoodShip is a freight orchestration and procurement platform for shippers, brokers, and asset-based carriers. It unifies TMS tender, contract-award, and location data, enriches it with real-time market rates, and layers AI-assisted bid analysis (via its Laney AI transportation analyst), lane- and carrier-level performance analytics, carrier scorecards, and in-app collaboration on top. Teams run mini-bids and full-network RFPs, benchmark spend against the market, and take corrective action without dedicated developer resources. Plug-and-play with major transportation management systems; backed by Bessemer Venture Partners and serving US and Canadian operations.

companies.name: ShipEngine
companies.description: ShipEngine (an Auctane / ShipStation company) is a shipping API for rate shopping, label generation, tracking, and address validation across major carriers.

companies.name: Stere
companies.description: Stere is a New York-based insurance infrastructure company (founded 2021) that lets insurers, MGAs, and distribution partners build and launch digital insurance products - rating, quoting, binding, policy issuance, claims, and premium payments - in weeks rather than years. Its core offering is a "Stere API-as-a-Service" underwriting API (insurers can bring their own API or have Stere build one) plus a separate Stere Unified API and Stere Distribution layer that let brokers, wholesalers, fintechs, and embedded partners reach multiple carriers/products through a single connection (API, SDK, and webhooks). Stere Claims handles FNOL and claims workflow (portions of claims assessment and resolution are marketed as in-development/coming soon), and Stere Pay / Stere Pay Later provides a buy-now-pay-later gateway for insurance premiums. There is no self-serve public developer portal, published API reference, OpenAPI/Swagger document, or sandbox signup on stere.io; the marketing site references a "Stere Docs," "API Changelog," and "API Status" area under /developer/, but those paths return 404 publicly and integration is provisioned per customer after a sales-led partner/insurer onboarding engagement. The APIs below are honestly modeled from Stere's own product marketing pages, not from a published API reference.

companies.name: Solvo.ai
companies.description: Solvo.ai is a revenue-orchestration company building the decision layer for revenue management in container logistics. Its live pricing engine ingests market rates, capacity manifests, booking history, port congestion, customer behaviour and contract terms, then uses models trained on tens of millions of historical bookings to produce a ranked, capacity-aware rate recommendation per lane, equipment type and segment. Trade managers accept, adjust or override these recommendations on Solvo's Decision HUB, and every decision feeds back as training signal through a bidirectional integration with the carrier's commercial stack. Founded in 2021 and backed by Speedinvest, Solvo positions itself as the only proven, live pricing engine built specifically for container shipping, with one of the world's top carriers in production. This profile was added to the API Evangelist network as a Speedinvest portfolio company; Solvo currently publishes a marketing and insights site only, with no public API, developer documentation, SDKs or specifications.

companies.name: Asseta
companies.description: Asseta is a San Francisco-based online marketplace for the secondary market in semiconductor manufacturing equipment and parts. Founded in 2013, the platform lets fabs, refurbishers, and dealers list and discover used, refurbished, and new components, ranging from chamber assemblies and power supplies to smaller parts like o-rings, with more than 450,000 listings from suppliers around the world. Buyers request quotes from global suppliers with a single click and typically save 50-60% versus OEM pricing. Asseta is a portfolio company of a16z and Y Combinator. It publishes no public API, developer portal, SDK, or documentation surface at this time; this profile captures the company identity and its published web properties.

companies.name: Backlotcars
companies.description: BacklotCars, Inc. is a dealer-to-dealer wholesale used-vehicle marketplace, founded in Kansas City and acquired by KAR Global (now OPENLANE, Inc.), whose technology was consolidated into the OPENLANE US marketplace. It connects thousands of franchise and independent dealers through a 24/7 bid-ask marketplace, "Buy It Now" listings, and timed auctions scheduled throughout each week, backed by native mobile apps, in-lane vehicle inspections with AI-analyzed engine recordings, transportation, and floor-plan financing. Commercial sellers and dealer groups can push inventory straight from their own systems into OPENLANE Sell via OPENLANE Connect, a lightweight dealer integration API with a dedicated test environment. This profile began as a 500 Global portfolio lead surfaced into the API Evangelist network and was enriched from OPENLANE's public marketing and product surface; the platform publishes no public OpenAPI or open developer portal.

companies.name: Beeline Bikes
companies.description: Beeline Bikes (now operating as Beeline Connect) is a B2B software platform for the bicycle industry that links riders, retailers, and brands across North America, with roughly 3,300 participating retailers. The platform provides real-time service scheduling and 24/7 appointment booking, live market inventory management, test-ride booking, local bicycle assembly coordination, warranty submission and reimbursement tracking, an affiliate e-commerce sales channel with revenue sharing to local dealers, and a dynamic dealer locator. It supports both mobile and in-shop retail operations and serves established brands such as Aventon, Priority, Lectric, and Pedego. The company was surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and added to the API Evangelist network. No public developer API, documentation, or integration surface has been found at this time.

companies.name: NICKL
companies.description: NICKL (Nicklpass) is a subscription management platform that bills itself as "the operating system for subscriptions." It helps organizations govern the digital tools, SaaS subscriptions, and data services their teams use by connecting identity, usage, and procurement data in one place. Capabilities include role-based governance and provisioning, usage intelligence to surface adoption and redundant spend, and coordinated procurement that aggregates demand to negotiate from real usage data. The platform integrates with Google Workspace, Microsoft 365, and Plaid, and applies AI models for insights and pricing optimization. NICKL participated in the Comcast NBCUniversal LIFT Labs Accelerator powered by Techstars. As of this enrichment pass the company publishes a marketing site and hosted control panel but no public API, developer portal, OpenAPI, SDK, or other machine-readable API surface.

companies.name: Packmatic
companies.description: Packmatic is a Berlin-based packaging procurement platform that helps companies source flexible and paper-based packaging at lower cost. It combines a proprietary supplier database and a smart-matching engine spanning 350+ suppliers with expert packaging engineers and a cloud-based platform for managing quotes, orders, and supplier communication. Customers pay no upfront fees; Packmatic earns a commission when they source through its network, reporting average savings around 16% and reducing supplier search time by roughly 70%. Packmatic does not currently publish a public developer API, SDKs, or developer documentation; this profile captures its company identity and domain-security posture for the API Evangelist network.

companies.name: Shipium
companies.description: Shipium is a shipping platform for high-volume e-commerce, optimizing carrier selection, multi-warehouse delivery promises, and parcel routing.

companies.name: Storyboard
companies.description: Storyboard is a fleet-operations AI platform that gives trucking and logistics companies voice-first, hands-free AI workers for their drivers. The system automates dispatch updates, driver coaching, safety alerts, and compliance monitoring (including hours-of-service and idling) so back-office teams field fewer phone calls and drivers stay hands-free on the road. Founded in 2017 and headquartered in Santa Monica, California, Storyboard began as an enterprise podcast and internal-audio communication platform (a $4.5M seed round led by CRV in 2020) before pivoting to AI-powered fleet operations. It is distributed through in-cab telematics marketplaces such as Platform Science and ISAAC Instruments. Storyboard exposes no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface; access is via its web and mobile apps at app.storyboard.com. This profile was surfaced as a CRV portfolio company and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline.

companies.name: TikTok Shop API
companies.description: TikTok Shop is TikTok's integrated e-commerce platform that lets sellers, creators, and partners list products, manage inventory and fulfillment, and sell directly within TikTok's live streams, short videos, and shop tabs. The TikTok Shop Open API (open-api.tiktokglobalshop.com) is a RESTful API that uses OAuth 2.0 authentication and enables developers to programmatically manage products, orders, fulfillment, returns, finance, promotions, and seller authorization across TikTok Shop's global marketplaces.

companies.name: Gatekeeper
companies.description: Gatekeeper is a SaaS contract lifecycle management (CLM) and vendor management platform that helps procurement, legal, and finance teams capture, approve, store, and renew supplier contracts with workflow automation, e-signature, spend analytics, and risk monitoring. The Gatekeeper REST API exposes vendors, contracts, employees, custom data records, files, workflows, and events so customers can integrate Gatekeeper with ERP, HRIS, and finance systems. API access is per-tenant and authenticated with a tenant-specific API key.

companies.name: Groover
companies.description: Groover is a music promotion platform that connects independent artists and their representatives with a network of more than 3,000 vetted music-industry professionals — playlist curators, bloggers, journalists, radio stations, record labels, and managers. Artists submit a track and spend credits ("Grooviz", roughly €2 each) to reach individual curators, and Groover guarantees personalized feedback within seven days or refunds the credit. Founded in Paris in 2018, the company also operates Temple by Groover, a fanbase-growth toolset. Groover runs a consumer web application on a credit-based, pay-per-submission model and publishes no public developer API.

companies.name: Kabal
companies.description: Kabal is the energy industry's leading logistics management SaaS platform. Founded in Norway in 2011 (formerly Wellit), Kabal provides an integrated, cloud-native platform that manages cargo, marine, transport, personnel, warehouse, rig and installation logistics across both offshore and onshore operations for oil & gas operators. The platform spans planning, execution and optimization, plus cost and emissions tracking and KPI reporting, connecting operators with their suppliers and vessels to share business-critical logistics data. Kabal is trusted by energy supermajors including ExxonMobil, Shell, Chevron, BP, TotalEnergies, Equinor, Petronas, Repsol, Eni and ADNOC, with tens of thousands of users across dozens of countries. Kabal received a growth investment from Insight Partners in 2023.

companies.name: trawa
companies.description: trawa (operated by Future Energy Services GmbH) is a Berlin-based energy management company that helps mid-sized businesses procure and manage electricity. It pairs AI-optimized green-electricity sourcing on the wholesale market with cloud energy-management software that gives customers real-time visibility into consumption, costs, and CO2 emissions, alongside battery storage and smart control of energy-consuming assets such as CHP plants and charging stations. Founded in 2022, trawa is backed by Balderton Capital and Speedinvest. The platform is delivered through a customer web portal and a trust center; no public developer API was found as of this enrichment pass.

companies.name: DeHaat
companies.description: DeHaat (Green Agrevolution Private Limited) is one of India's largest full-stack agritech platforms, connecting smallholder farmers from "seed to market" through a phygital network of 11,000+ DeHaat Centres and 503 Farmer Producer Organisations across 12+ agrarian states. Founded in 2012 by IIT/IIM alumni, the platform serves 1.8 million+ farmers with agri-inputs (seeds, fertilizers, crop protection), AI-enabled crop advisory in multiple regional languages for 30+ crops, soil analysis, crop-health monitoring, market linkage for harvested produce, and agri-financing. Backed by Prosus Ventures and others, DeHaat operates a franchisee micro-entrepreneur model that raises farmer net incomes 30-50% while making procurement more predictable for buyers. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of prosus-ventures; the company publishes no public developer API portal or OpenAPI at this time, so enrichment is limited to identity, corporate link-properties, and security posture.

companies.name: igloo
companies.description: Igloo is a full-stack insurtech firm headquartered in Singapore and operating across six Southeast Asian markets (Singapore, Indonesia, the Philippines, Thailand, Malaysia, and Vietnam). It makes insurance simple, accessible, and affordable by embedding coverage into the platforms consumers already use, working with 100+ partners across e-commerce, telecommunications, banking, logistics, and lifestyle (including Shopee, Foodpanda, GCash, AIS, and Siam Commercial Bank). Its product line spans motor, mobile phone, travel, pet, personal accident, cyber, loan protection, e-commerce purchase protection, and blockchain-powered weather-index insurance. Igloo also ships technology platforms for the insurance value chain: Igloo Agent (agency management), Igloo Consumer (direct-to-consumer marketplace), Igloo Partner (affinity distribution), Ignite (digital agent platform), and the Turbo Core insurance operations system. Integration is offered through a partner-facing API program rather than a public self-serve developer portal.

companies.name: Remedial Health
companies.description: Remedial Health is a Nigeria-based healthtech company digitizing pharmaceutical procurement and pharmacy operations across Africa. Its platform connects retail pharmacies, hospitals, clinics, health insurers/HMOs, and pharmaceutical manufacturers through a set of products: Remedial Store (a digital marketplace for pharmacies to procure inventory), Remedial RX (daily pharmacy operations and inventory tooling), Remedial Buy Now-Pay Later (inventory financing), the Remedial Benefits Manager (clinical pharmacy services and medication delivery for insurers), Remedial Market Access (distribution reach for manufacturers), and Remedial Intelligence (supply-chain data insights). The company is backed by QED Investors and reaches its customers primarily through Android and iOS mobile apps. As of this enrichment pass Remedial Health publishes no public API, developer portal, or documentation host; this profile captures its identity, legal, and domain-security posture.

companies.name: Root Global
companies.description: Root Global is a Berlin-based climate technology company building decarbonization infrastructure for the food and beverage supply chain. Founded in 2022 and backed by Point Nine, its carbon operating system lets food processors, manufacturers, and retailers collect farm-level emissions data at scale, calculate corporate and product carbon footprints, and launch tailored reduction plans with their farming partners. Results are GUTcert certified and SBTi compliant, with the platform supporting operations across 11+ European countries. Root Global exposes no public developer API surface; this profile captures its corporate identity and domain-security posture.

companies.name: Terminal Logistics
companies.description: Terminal Industries (Terminal Logistics) is the company behind the Terminal Yard Operating System (YOS), an AI-native, fully-integrated platform for yard operations across logistics and supply chain. It unifies gate management, carrier risk assessment and driver ID, dispatch and spotter orchestration, yard visibility, load verification, carrier appointments, and end-to-end yard security from the gate to the dock, using computer vision and agentic AI. It serves third-party logistics, retail and grocery, consumer packaged goods, refrigerated warehousing, contract carriers, manufacturing facilities, and drop lots. Backed by 8vc. No public developer API is currently published; this profile captures the company's public web, security, and status surface.

companies.name: Oracle NetSuite
companies.description: Oracle NetSuite is a cloud-based business management suite that combines ERP, financials, CRM, inventory, supply chain, ecommerce, and human capital management into a single platform for mid-market and enterprise companies. NetSuite's SuiteCloud platform exposes both REST web services (SuiteTalk REST, with OpenAPI 3.0 metadata, SuiteQL queries, and CRUD on standard and custom records) and SOAP web services (SuiteTalk SOAP), plus the RESTlets framework for exposing custom server-side SuiteScript as REST endpoints.

companies.name: Packhelp
companies.description: Packhelp is a European custom and wholesale packaging platform that lets businesses design, order, and warehouse branded packaging — boxes, mailers, bags, tubes, and accessories — through online design tools and a curated catalog of EU-based producers. Packhelp also markets "the first-ever API for packaging," a sales-gated set of web services that let 3PL, fulfillment, marketplace, logistics, and food-delivery platforms embed packaging quoting, ordering, and a drag-and-drop packaging editor directly into their own applications and whitelabel storefronts.

companies.name: XPO
companies.description: XPO, Inc. (NYSE: XPO) is a Fortune 500 transportation company and one of the largest providers of less-than-truckload (LTL) freight transportation in North America. Following the spin-offs of GXO Logistics (contract logistics, 2021) and RXO (brokerage, 2022), XPO is now a pure-play LTL trucking company operating a network of service centers across the United States and Mexico. XPO does not publish a public developer API or developer portal; customer integrations (rate quotes, shipment tracking, EDI) are arranged through enterprise account managers and standard EDI exchanges.

companies.name: XPO Logistics
companies.description: XPO Logistics, Inc. is a leading provider of less-than-truckload (LTL) transportation in North America. The company offers freight transportation through a proprietary network of service centers and uses technology to drive efficiency for more than 50,000 customers. XPO Logistics historically operated as part of XPO, Inc. (NYSE: XPO), the publicly traded company that spun off GXO Logistics (contract logistics) in 2021 and RXO (brokerage) in 2022, leaving XPO focused on LTL trucking. XPO Logistics does not currently publish a public developer API or developer portal; integrations are arranged through enterprise account managers.

companies.name: Rohirrim
companies.description: Rohirrim is an AI-native Unified Acquisition Platform that automates and accelerates government procurement for both agencies and contractors. Its UnifiedAcquire product helps government agencies manage procurements from market research through award by automating acquisition documents and centralizing institutional knowledge, while UnifiedRespond (RohanRFP) helps companies identify, match, and draft RFP responses faster and at lower cost. The company targets federal agencies, government contractors, Fortune 500 firms, and healthcare organizations, and is backed by Bessemer Venture Partners and Insight Partners. Rohirrim publishes no public developer API surface today; this profile captures its public web, content, and security-posture footprint.

companies.name: Walter
companies.description: Walter is a San Francisco-based Y Combinator (Spring 2026) startup building an AI employee for the manufacturing back office. Founded in 2026 by Nikolas Keller (CEO) and Lukas Postulka (CTO), Walter logs into the enterprise systems a company already runs on — SAP, Oracle NetSuite, Microsoft Dynamics 365, Teams, Outlook and Gmail — the way a new hire would, and takes over manual paperwork: reading sales orders and purchase orders from emails and PDFs, capturing and validating the data, cross-checking it against the ERP, ordering from suppliers and catching pricing errors before they ship. It uses a purpose-built document-understanding model (rather than legacy template OCR) that supports 270+ languages and reaches 90%+ accuracy after minimal training, cutting an order that used to take 15 minutes down to about one. Walter requires no integration project and no rip-and-replace, operating the same screens the team already uses. It is an early-stage company with no public API, developer program, SDKs or documentation; this profile captures its public identity and security posture for the API Evangelist network.

companies.name: Brain Corp
companies.description: Brain Corp builds BrainOS, an autonomy platform that powers commercial service robots for floor care, inventory scanning, and remote site management across retail, warehouses, education, airports, malls, healthcare, and hospitality. The product portfolio includes the BrainOS Sense Suite, Clean Suite, ShelfOptix scanning-as-a-service, RFID localization, and remote site management tools. Brain Corp integrates with OEM partners and operators rather than offering a public developer portal, and does not publish open APIs.

companies.name: Branddu
