companies.description: Branddu (Branddu Colombia / Branddu AI) is a B2B MerchTech platform that digitizes corporate merchandising and promotional-product procurement across Latin America. Operating in Colombia and Mexico, it centralizes the full purchasing workflow - product discovery, inventory, quotations, customization, online design, and checkout - through a single online catalog of more than 15,000 fully customizable products across 46+ categories. Branddu AI (formed via a merger with Reno) combines AI, proprietary software, and a regional supplier network to simplify how companies source branded merchandise. The public storefront runs on Shopify. The company is backed by a US$300K pre-seed from 500 Global, bringing total capital raised to roughly US$800K.

companies.name: FreightRoll
companies.description: FreightRoll is a logistics technology company whose flagship product, YardOS, is a customizable Yard Operating / Management System (YMS) that turns shipping and receiving yards into driver-friendly, self-service hubs. YardOS reduces truck-driver wait times, improves yard throughput, and streamlines gate and dock operations, with the company citing up to a 50% reduction in truck turnaround time, 95%+ fewer human-to-driver interactions, and $100K+ annual savings per facility across a network of 150,000+ registered drivers. FreightRoll integrates with existing systems across API, EDI, and SFTP mechanisms and deploys remotely in under an hour. The company is backed by 500 Global. FreightRoll does not currently publish a public developer portal, API reference, or OpenAPI definition; its public website is Wix-hosted and exposes a Wix Site MCP endpoint for agentic AI access to public site content.

companies.name: Kyrok
companies.description: Kyrok GmbH is a Berlin-based software company building an AI operating system for mid-sized pharmaceutical and chemical manufacturers in Europe. The platform layers over a company's existing ERP (SAP S/4HANA, SAP R/3, Microsoft Dynamics 365, Infor, Applus) and connects the systems supply chain teams currently hold together by hand into intelligent operations across customer service, production planning, material planning and procurement. Kyrok positions itself on an "AI assists, people decide" model, running on European infrastructure in Frankfurt am Main, GDPR-compliant, with ISO 27001 and ISO 42001 certifications in progress. The company announced a EUR 3.1M round in June 2026 and names AnalytiChem and Konapharma as customers. Kyrok connects to ERP systems via API but publishes no public developer API, API reference, or SDKs as of this enrichment pass.

companies.name: Mubit
companies.description: Mubit is a temporary storage and logistics service based in Guadalajara, Mexico, offering on-demand collection, climate-controlled warehousing, digital photo inventory, and delivery for both individuals and businesses. Customers pay only for the space they use, with free pickup and drop-off, optional professional packing, and 24/7 CCTV-monitored facilities across three warehouses (Colli, Tijera, and Casuarina). Backed by 500 Global and Techstars, the company reports 4,000+ customers and a 4.9-star Google rating, and operates a mobile/web customer portal at clientes.mubit.co for scheduling pickups and deliveries and viewing stored items. Mubit publishes no public developer API.

companies.name: Pallet
companies.description: Pallet builds an AI-powered logistics workforce: autonomous AI agents that automate supply chain operations for freight brokerages, freight forwarders, FTL and LTL carriers, warehouses, and shippers. Its agents handle end-to-end workflows from quoting through order entry, track-and-trace, billing, and customer service, integrating with existing TMS, WMS, email, and legacy applications. The Atlas product surfaces revenue opportunities across freight operations. Pallet is backed by Bain Capital Ventures and General Catalyst. No public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface was found during enrichment.

companies.name: Portex
companies.description: Portex is a freight procurement and management platform that replaces the emails, spreadsheets, and PDFs of traditional freight quoting with a single collaborative workspace. Shippers, brokers, carriers, and forwarders use Portex to create, send, receive, compare, and award freight quotes up to 90% faster, centralize shipment documents and tracking, chat with carriers, and analyze freight spend for cost-saving recommendations. Founded by Brittany Ennix (previously Uber and Flexport) and backed by Cowboy Ventures, Portex is a seed-stage logistics technology company. As of this profile the platform is delivered as a hosted web application at portexpro.com and does not publish a public developer API, SDKs, or developer portal.

companies.name: Shippingbo
companies.description: Shippingbo is a Toulouse, France-based e-commerce logistics SaaS founded in 2016 by Marc Hericher and Romain Parent. The platform unifies an Order Management System (OMS), Warehouse Management System (WMS), and Transport Management System (TMS) behind a single REST API so that merchants, DNVBs, 3PLs, wholesalers, manufacturers, and marketplaces can centralize multi-channel orders, pilot warehouse picking and packing, and execute multi-carrier shipments from one back office. Shippingbo claims 5,000+ active users, 80 million orders, and EUR 5 billion in merchandise handled in 2024, with 2,500+ warehouses equipped across France and Europe. The Shippingbo Developer Portal (powered by Stoplight) exposes a public REST/JSON API covering orders, products, stocks, shipments, customers, pickings, and source connectors, secured by OAuth 2.0 through the oauth.shippingbo.com authorization server. Shippingbo additionally offers a dedicated TMS API for multi-carrier label generation and a webhook channel for order state changes, stock changes, and shipment events. Reported developer-facing scale includes 500+ developers, 10+ million orders processed through the APIs, 500+ million webhook deliveries, and 40+ pre-integrated carriers. Shippingbo is a French Tech company backed by IRDI Capital Investissement and GSO Innovation.

companies.name: Silq
companies.description: Silq (OneSilq) is a digital freight forwarder delivering fast, transparent global shipping and supply-chain services. Offerings span ocean freight (full container load, less-than-container load and shared container load), air freight, buyer's consolidation, cargo value protection, customs brokerage and trucking/drayage, plus quality-control inspections across China, India, Vietnam, Indonesia and Bangladesh. The platform layers real-time shipment visibility, live ocean-carrier freight rates, expert trade advisory and built-in risk protection for importers and small shippers.

companies.name: Donkey
companies.description: Donkey is an AI-native trading company (Y Combinator, Summer 2026) that buys directly from Chinese factories and sells delivered duty-paid to US importers. Donkey mines public US customs records to identify the factory that actually makes a product, returns a landed DDP quote within 72 hours, runs its own on-the-floor quality inspections before the factory is paid, clears customs, moves the money, and offers credit-insured net-45 terms to qualified buyers. Founded by Benjamin Martindale (CEO) and Minghao Tan (CTO), the company runs small teams in San Francisco and China. Donkey publishes no public API, SDK, or developer platform today; this profile tracks its company identity in the API Evangelist network.

companies.name: Arvist
companies.description: Arvist AI is a Chicago-based computer-vision platform for warehouse and supply-chain operations that turns existing cameras, scanners, and WMS/ERP data into automated quality control, safety and compliance monitoring, load verification, inbound shipment inspection, and freight-claims management. The system deploys on-premise edge servers, integrates with 80+ leading WMS and ERP platforms without new hardware, and detects damage, defects, unsafe behavior, and outbound shipping errors in real time. Backed by Techstars, Arvist is ISO 27001 certified and SOC 2 Type I compliant. This profile was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio lead and enriched from Arvist's public web surface; the company currently publishes no public developer API or OpenAPI.

companies.name: Parlevel
companies.description: Parlevel Systems is a San Antonio-based vending technology company (founded 2012, now part of 365 Retail Markets) providing a Vending Management System (VMS) and related tools for unattended retail operators across vending, micro markets, and office coffee service. The platform covers real-time machine telemetry, dynamic route optimization, cashless payments (PayPlus), inventory and warehouse management, and cash accountability. No public developer API, developer portal, OpenAPI/AsyncAPI specification, SDK, or documented webhook surface was found during enrichment; this profile captures the company's public identity and probed domain security only.

companies.name: Xpedeon
companies.description: Xpedeon is a construction-specific ERP platform from Algorithms Software Pvt Ltd (30+ years in construction software), serving general contractors, specialist contractors, housebuilders and developers, engineer-to-order manufacturers, and off-site manufacturers across the UK, India, the GCC, and the US. The cloud platform covers construction finance and accounting, job costing and CVR, contract and subcontractor management, procurement, inventory and supply chain, plant and equipment, warehouse management, HR and payroll, CRM, and a mobile app for site teams, and is ISO 27001, 27017, 27018, 27701 and SOC 2 certified. Xpedeon publishes no public API, developer portal, or integration documentation, but does publish an llms.txt. Backed by Norwest Venture Partners.

companies.name: Another
companies.description: Another is an AI-native software platform that modernizes off-channel and off-price inventory operations for fashion, beauty, and retail brands. Founded in 2024 by Corina Marshall, the platform connects to a retailer's existing systems - including returns management - to create a single source of truth for excess, returned, and pre-loved goods, then automates how brands identify, manage, and monetize that inventory across downstream channels. Teams can invite and connect with secondary merchandise recipients, send inventory proposals to buyers, request payment from partners, and let partners request inventory, replacing fragmented manual workflows spread across teams, buyers, channels, and partners. Another closed a $2.5M seed round in January 2026 co-led by Anthemis and Westbound. As of this profile the company operates a private, invite-based web application and publishes no public API, developer portal, or technical documentation.

companies.name: Dianxiaomi
companies.description: Dianxiaomi (店小秘) is a free cross-border e-commerce ERP platform operated by Shenzhen Meiyunji Network Technology Co., Ltd., serving more than 1.8 million cross-border sellers worldwide. It unifies product listing and data collection, multi-platform order processing, warehouse and inventory management, procurement, financial and profit analytics, and customer service across 70+ marketplaces including AliExpress, Amazon, Shopee, Lazada, and TikTok Shop, with integrations to 1,700+ logistics providers and 130+ overseas warehouses. The platform is user-facing SaaS; no public developer/API open platform is currently published.

companies.name: EcomExperts
companies.description: EcomExperts is a Latin American ecommerce ERP and technology platform that helps online sellers manage, synchronize, and automate their stores from a single screen. It centralizes omnichannel operations across marketplaces and sales channels (including multi-account Mercado Libre management), synchronizes prices and stock in real time, and issues electronic invoices automatically in bulk. Delivered as a SaaS application with a hosted dashboard and a 7-day free trial, EcomExperts operates across Argentina, Chile, Mexico, Uruguay, Colombia, and Peru. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and added to the API Evangelist network. EcomExperts does not currently publish a public developer platform, API reference, SDKs, or OpenAPI, so this profile captures company identity and public-surface signals only.

companies.name: Fleetline
companies.description: Fleetline is an all-in-one AI dispatch and fleet-optimization platform for trucking fleets. Its AI-based dispatch engine ingests load, driver, and ELD data, simulates billions of scenarios, and recommends the best assignment plan so operators maximize revenue, productivity, and fleet utilization. The platform aggregates major load boards into a unified workspace, identifies schedule gaps and fills them with spot loads, composes complex trips with tradeoff analysis, forecasts delays, breakdowns, and HOS violations, and includes an AI assistant trained on fleet history and TMS data. Fleetline is a Bloomberg Beta portfolio company; it exposes a marketing site, a customer login/auth portal, and an internal API host, but publishes no public developer API, documentation, or SDKs at this time.

companies.name: Forterro
companies.description: Forterro is a pan-European industrial software company, founded in 2012 and headquartered in London, that provides enterprise resource planning (ERP) and specialised business software to the industrial mid-market. Built through a series of acquisitions, Forterro operates a portfolio of regional and vertical ERP brands - including Abas, Jeeves, Garp, Proconcept, Sylob, Silog, Myfactory, Orderwise, Clipper, 123Insight, BPSC, Helios, Proffix, Prodaso and its cloud-native Fortee product - alongside best-in-class point solutions such as warehouse management (WMS), point of sale (POS), material requirements planning (MRP) and business intelligence. The company serves more than 13,000 industrial businesses across manufacturing, warehousing, wholesale and retail from 40+ offices worldwide.

companies.name: Moonhub
companies.description: Moonhub is an AI recruiting platform that deploys proprietary AI agents to source, qualify, engage, and vet candidates across millions of profiles, helping companies hire faster and more cost-effectively. Its agent products (Qualify AI, Engage AI, and Monitor AI) automatically identify qualified candidates, run outreach to convert them into interview-ready applicants, and analyze candidate intent to manage recruiter handoffs. Moonhub is backed by Khosla Ventures, GV, Greycroft, Time Ventures, and AIX Ventures; the Moonhub team joined Salesforce in 2026. The company ships a recruiter web application (recruiter.moonhub.ai) and publishes no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface as of this profiling.

companies.name: Perfectly
companies.description: Perfectly is an AI-native recruiting platform (Y Combinator W2026) that automates the hiring process end to end, from candidate sourcing and outreach through screening and qualification. Its employer-facing AI recruiting agent, Paul, sources, engages, and qualifies candidates to help startups fill roles in days rather than weeks, delivered as an AI-native recruiting agency paired with a forward-deployed recruiter for onboarding and configuration. Its job-seeker agent, Parker, is an AI career super-connector on iMessage and WhatsApp that helps candidates find relevant industry contacts and craft personalized outreach before roles are publicly posted. Founded by former ML scientists and engineers from Meta and TikTok, Perfectly operates as a chat- and agent-delivered hiring service rather than a public developer API; no public API, developer portal, SDK, or specification surface was found during enrichment.

companies.name: Reframe
companies.description: Reframe (usereframe.ai) is a San Francisco-based Y Combinator Winter 2026 company, founded in 2025 by Bryan Zin (previously a Product Design Engineer on the iPhone team at Apple) and Eric Wiener, building an AI-native hardware procurement platform. Reframe automates the manual procurement process in hardware supply chains: instead of emails and spreadsheets, AI agents handle purchase orders, supplier follow-ups, and part tracking for both COTS and custom-manufactured components, with Slack and Gmail integrations for team workflows. This API Evangelist profile tracks Reframe as a company in the network; the company does not currently publish a public developer API.

companies.name: Spotlock
companies.description: Spotlock is a commodity risk management platform that helps organizations monitor, manage, and mitigate exposure to raw-material price volatility. It lets businesses track material exposures across inventory, customer contracts, and supplier commitments, set company-wide risk policies, and execute optimized hedging strategies — enabling fixed-price long-term contracts, profit margin protection, hedge accounting treatment, framework/agreement pricing, and global price intelligence for sectors such as construction and infrastructure, metal service centers and distribution, manufacturing and fabrication, automotive, energy, and transportation.

companies.name: Tezbor, Inc.
companies.description: Tezbor is a Tashkent, Uzbekistan based courier and last-mile logistics company that automates the delivery of documents, parcels, and cargo across Uzbekistan. Beyond its consumer and business courier service, Tezbor operates a technology platform that exposes delivery ordering and tracking through an integration API, ready-made e-commerce plugins (WooCommerce, OpenCart, Magento), mobile apps, dashboards, and Telegram bots, so that any online store can automatically generate a Tezbor delivery order from each purchase. The company is backed by 500 Global, Activat, and StartupBase, and counts brands such as Beeline, Ozon, and OQ among its delivery clients.

companies.name: Nuvocargo
companies.description: Nuvocargo is an AI-powered freight-management platform for North American truckload logistics, focused on the US-Mexico-Canada cross-border corridor. Its "Nuvo AI" system coordinates a network of specialized agents (quoting, negotiation, booking, dispatch, tracking, exception handling, audit, and payment) to automate the freight load lifecycle, and it pairs that software with licensed freight brokerage, managed transportation, and customs-brokerage services. The company was surfaced through the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of Homebrew and QED Investors. As of this enrichment pass Nuvocargo publishes no public developer API, OpenAPI specification, or developer portal; onboarding is contact-gated ("zero-integration" pilots), so this profile captures the company identity, legal/resource surface, and domain-security posture rather than API artifacts.

companies.name: Sensefinity
companies.description: Sensefinity is a supply-chain IoT company ("The IoT Transformation Company") delivering real-time tracking, monitoring, and analytics for global cargo and logistics operations. Its platform combines GPS/NB-IoT tracking devices for maritime containers, pallets, and vehicles with temperature and condition (cold-chain) sensors, indoor location tracking, a cloud analytics and machine learning layer, and digital product passport / blockchain integrations. The operational platform is delivered as a hosted web application (uiadmin.sensefinity.com) and mobile asset-management apps, serving enterprise customers across food, pharma, automotive, and manufacturing supply chains. No public developer portal, OpenAPI specification, or SDK surface is published as of this profile; a private API host (api.sensefinity.com) backs the platform.

companies.name: Trackonomy
companies.description: Trackonomy is a supply chain visibility company that digitizes real-world operations with barely-there smart label sensors. Its SmartTape and THL Tape products provide item-level tracking, monitoring location, temperature, humidity, and light in real time, while its platform connects, automates, controls, and remediates operations processes at global scale for logistics, industrial, utilities, healthcare, government, and airline customers. Trackonomy is backed by 8VC. It advertises a customizable RESTful API and webhook-based real-time data exchange for platform customers, but publishes no public developer portal, API documentation, or SDKs.

companies.name: Clarium
companies.description: Clarium is a healthcare supply chain resiliency company founded in early 2020 during the COVID-19 pandemic and headquartered in New York City. Its AI-powered platform, Astra OS, unifies real-time data from hospitals and their suppliers across systems of record, then layers data-enabled workflow apps on top: Disruption Monitoring to detect and resolve supply chain disruptions faster, Substitute Management to automate product approvals, and Procedure Card Optimization to standardize and cut cost. Clarium has raised $43M+ (including a $27M Series A led by General Catalyst, with Northzone among its backers) and works with leading health systems such as Mount Sinai, Ochsner Health, Allina Health, and Yale New Haven.

companies.name: Juleb
companies.description: Juleb is a Saudi Arabia-based pharma-tech and retail software company providing an integrated cloud platform for the health, retail, and distribution sectors. Its suite spans accounting and financial management, inventory and warehouse management, sales force automation (SFA), point of sale (POS), Rx e-prescription, e-commerce, and DSCSA regulatory compliance. Juleb connects to Saudi compliance systems (ZATCA/Fatoora, RSD, GS1, Wasfaty), e-commerce channels (Salla, Shopify, HungerStation), payment providers (Geidea, Alhamrani), and ERPs (Microsoft Dynamics). Founded by Yousuf Jamjoom and backed by 500 Global, Juleb exposes a REST API (documented at docs.juleb.com) covering inventory, point of sale, prescriptions, and partner/company resources.

companies.name: Tengo
companies.description: Tengo is an AI-powered public procurement platform that helps companies find, evaluate, and respond to public tenders in one place. Founded in 2023 in France by Hugues Renou and Yoann Gauthier, Tengo covers the full tender lifecycle — sourcing and targeting relevant opportunities, drafting and writing proposals with AI, and managing responses and performance analytics — serving SMEs, mid-sized companies, and large corporations. Tengo raised a €3M round led by Point Nine in 2024. It operates a business-user SaaS with a request-a-demo onboarding and no public developer API surface.

companies.name: Reindeer AI
companies.description: Reindeer AI is an enterprise agentic AI platform that automates back-office business operations across finance, banking, insurance, supply chain, procurement, legal compliance, and global business services. Founded in 2024 with offices in New York and Tel Aviv, Reindeer deploys custom AI agents that learn from operational workflows using its Fast Track Training approach (functional models in roughly two weeks from a small number of samples), with human-in-the-loop escalation, continuous learning, and Model Reality Grounding safeguards against hallucination. It ships 200+ pre-trained skills and 200+ out-of-the-box integrations into systems such as SAP, Oracle, NetSuite, Workday, ServiceNow, and Salesforce, is model-agnostic (Claude, GPT, Gemini, Bedrock, DeepSeek, GLM), and emphasizes customer data ownership and enterprise security (ISO 27001, SOC 2 Type 2, GDPR, HIPAA, CCPA). Reindeer is backed by Lightspeed Venture Partners, TEAM8, and Vesey Ventures. Reindeer does not publish a public developer API, OpenAPI, SDKs, or a developer portal; the product is delivered as an enterprise engagement, so this profile captures company identity and security posture rather than an API surface.

companies.name: Tile (thetileapp)
companies.description: Tile is a consumer Bluetooth-tracker company whose Tile Mate, Pro, Slim, and Sticker devices help people find everyday items such as keys, wallets, bags, and phones, backed by the crowd-sourced Tile "Find" network that anonymously relays location when another Tile user passes a lost item. Founded in 2012, Tile was acquired by Life360 in 2021 and now operates as part of the Life360 family-safety platform. Tile publishes consumer apps for iOS and Android and a support and legal surface, but does not offer an official public developer API, developer portal, or SDK; only third-party community libraries wrap its private app API. This API Evangelist profile captures the company's public web and security-program surface. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Slow Ventures.

companies.name: Universal Forest Products
companies.description: UFP Industries (formerly Universal Forest Products) is a leading global manufacturer and distributor of wood and wood-alternative products serving retail, industrial, and construction markets. UFP operates over 200 facilities globally supplying lumber, engineered wood products, packaging, and building materials. The company has integrated OnBase-based business system integration for document management and workflow automation across its supply chain operations.

companies.name: Atlas Air Worldwide Holdings
companies.description: Atlas Air Worldwide Holdings is a global airfreight, charter, and aircraft leasing group headquartered in Purchase, New York and operating across more than 80 countries and 330+ airports. The holding company positions itself as the "Leader in Aviation Outsourcing" and runs three operating businesses: Atlas Air (ACMI, CMI, charter, and military/government cargo and passenger operations on Boeing 747-400F, 747-8F, 777F, 767, and 737-800BCF freighters), Polar Air Cargo (scheduled airport-to-airport cargo network, historically a joint venture with DHL), and Titan Aviation Leasing (commercial aircraft acquisition, leasing, and sale-leaseback services). Atlas is the largest operator of the Boeing 747 freighter, the Dreamlifter operator for Boeing, and one of the principal lift providers for Amazon Air's middle-mile network. In August 2022 a consortium led by Apollo Global Management with J.F. Lehman & Company and Hill City Capital agreed to take the company private in an all-cash transaction valued at approximately US$5.2 billion; the deal closed in March 2023, delisting the company (formerly Nasdaq: AAWW). As a freight carrier the group does not publish a public developer portal or open APIs — integrations with shippers, forwarders, and customers are delivered through private B2B channels (EDI, Cargo-IMP/XML messaging, airwaybill tracking on polaraircargo.com, and account-managed connectivity). A "Track Shipment" tool and a Special Loads request form (specialloads.atlasair.com) are the principal self-service surfaces; an internal-facing GitHub organization (Atlas-Air-Data-Platform) exists but publishes no public repos.

companies.name: Chord
companies.description: Chord is a New York / Santa Barbara-based commerce data and AI platform founded in 2021 by Bryan Mahoney (CEO) and Henry Davis (President & Chairman), both former Glossier executives. Chord began as a headless commerce backbone built on top of Solidus — the open-source Spree Commerce fork written in Ruby on Rails — and has since evolved into an AI-native commerce data platform with three layers: a Data Foundation that unifies sources such as Shopify, ad platforms, and CDPs; a Context Stack that grounds AI in store-specific business context; and a set of Agents that take action across the commerce stack. Its current product surface includes Chord OMS (a Solidus-based order management system covering orders, products, promotions, subscriptions, affiliates, gift cards, returns, shipping, tax, and digital products documented at chord.stoplight.io), Chord CDP (customer data platform with identity resolution, RFM scoring, customer lifetime revenue, and destination activations), Chord Event Tracking (client- and server-side eventing with Shopify Web Pixel integration and consent management via OneTrust and Shopify Customer Privacy API), Chord Data Platform (analytics, predictive modeling, attribution, recommendations, Fivetran ingestion, GA4 compatibility), and Chord AI / Copilot Chat, powered by Anthropic Claude (Opus 4.5 for SQL generation, Haiku 4.5 for response generation and classification) with charts, monitors, context modeling, and natural-language data querying. Chord's GitHub org (github.com/chordcommerce) maintains a fleet of Solidus extensions (solidus_stripe, solidus_braintree, solidus_paypal_braintree, solidus_subscriptions, solidus_virtual_gift_card, solidus_importer, solidus_avatax_certified), a consent-manager TypeScript library, a Jitsu fork for event ingestion, and example repos for eventing and analytics. Notable customers include Sonos, Blue Bottle Coffee, Rodan + Fields, MrBeast, and Ritual. Funding has come from M13 Ventures, Equal Ventures, Act One Ventures, Chingona Ventures, and CEAS Investments, with an $18M Series A reported by TechCrunch in 2021. The commercial model is sales-led with custom enterprise pricing gated behind a demo request.

companies.name: Focal Systems
companies.description: Focal Systems is a San Francisco-based deep-learning company building the operating system for brick-and-mortar retail. Its platform combines proprietary shelf-mounted computer-vision cameras, real-time AI, and streaming data to digitize physical stores hourly — tracking on-shelf availability, out-of-stocks, planogram and price-tag compliance, shrink, and inventory. Products include Computer Vision cameras, Shelf AI, the Action Tool associate mobile app, and the Impact analytics dashboard, used by leading grocery and retail chains such as Walmart Canada to reduce waste, redeploy labor, and recover lost sales. Focal Systems is a Y Combinator and Uncork Capital-backed company and operates as an enterprise SaaS vendor; it does not publish a public self-serve developer API or SDK.

companies.name: Indrive
companies.description: inDrive is a global ride-hailing, delivery, and urban-services platform built around a peer-to-peer, name-your-price model in which passengers propose a fare and nearby drivers accept, counter, or decline it directly. Founded in 2012 by Arsen Tomsky in Yakutsk, Russia and now headquartered in Mountain View, California, the company operates across roughly 48 countries and more than 1,000 cities, with over 400 million app downloads. Beyond city rides it offers intercity transport, courier and freight delivery, on-demand task services, and driver lending. inDrive was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of Bond Capital and General Catalyst. inDrive does not publish a public developer API, OpenAPI specification, SDKs, or a developer portal; its GitHub organization hosts internal engineering frameworks and an engineering handbook rather than external API definitions.

companies.name: Kodiak AI
companies.description: Kodiak AI, Inc. (formerly Kodiak Robotics) is a Mountain View, California company building the Kodiak Driver, an AI-powered ground autonomy system for driverless trucking and defense vehicles. Founded in April 2018 by Don Burnette, Kodiak develops a purpose-built autonomous driving stack — sensor pods, 4D radar, sparse maps, and fallback systems — that integrates into third-party driving platforms rather than shipping a vehicle of its own. The company runs commercial driverless freight lanes in Texas, Oklahoma, Ohio and Indiana with partners including Atlas Energy Solutions, Maersk, Martin Brower, Roehl Transport, JB Hunt and Werner, and it adapts the same driver to defense and industrial missions with General Dynamics Land Systems, Textron Systems and the US Army. Kodiak raised a $125M Series B in 2021 with Lightspeed Venture Partners, Battery Ventures, CRV, SIP Global Partners and others participating, and became a public company through a business combination with Ares Acquisition Corporation II. Kodiak publishes a corporate web presence, a news/RSS feed and an llms.txt for agents, but does not currently operate a public developer program, API, or SDK surface.

companies.name: Kodiak AI
companies.description: Kodiak AI, Inc. (formerly Kodiak Robotics) is a Mountain View, California company founded in 2018 that builds AI-powered ground autonomy — the "Kodiak Driver" — for long-haul freight trucking and for off-road, industrial, and defense ground vehicles. The company sells a turnkey driver-as-a-product to fleet operators rather than a public developer API: its surface is a corporate website, a news/press feed, a safety report, and investor-relations material. Kodiak has run driverless operations for partners including Atlas Energy, Roehl Transport, Martin Brower, Tyson Foods, and West Fraser, and works with Bosch, NVIDIA, and General Dynamics Land Systems on hardware and defense autonomy. It reports more than 2.6 million autonomous miles and 7,000+ delivered loads. No public API, SDK, developer portal, or OpenAPI definition has been found; the company does publish an llms.txt for AI crawlers.

companies.name: Onramp Payments
companies.description: Onramp Payments, Inc. (ONRAMP) is a fintech company building modern payments infrastructure for the commercial trucking and fleet industry. Founded by logistics and payments veterans and backed by Canaan Partners, the company operates an enterprise-grade digital platform that replaces legacy card-based fleet payment systems. For carriers it offers cardless fuel payments at the pump, administrative spend controls, and maintenance payment solutions; for merchants it provides digital payment acceptance, pricing controls, and fraud prevention that work both in-store and at fuel pumps; and for partners it offers API integrations, broker solutions, and Transportation Management System (TMS) connections. The company markets itself as the easiest, most secure payments platform for carriers and merchants and has raised roughly $21M from investors including Canaan Partners, CEAS Investments, Contour Venture Partners, Javelin Venture Partners, and RedBlue Capital. As of this enrichment pass ONRAMP publishes no public developer portal, API reference, SDKs, or OpenAPI, so this profile captures verified company identity and probed domain-security posture only.

companies.name: Stockly
companies.description: Stockly (Stockly SAS, headquartered in Vitry-sur-Seine, France) operates a global inventory network for e-commerce, positioning itself as "the first global inventory for Retail." It connects online retailers that are missing stock (Demanders) with brands and official retailers that hold surplus inventory (Suppliers), detecting out-of-stock variants and filling the gaps in real time so that e-shops never run out of stock. Stockly integrates directly with a retailer's e-commerce infrastructure via API, a CMS, or a marketplace, and is building toward a stock exchange for e-commerce inventory in compliance with brands' distribution policies. The company reports 300+ partnered retailers across Europe and 100M+ available items, and is backed by Techstars. Stockly is primarily a partner-onboarded platform rather than a broad self-serve public developer API.

companies.name: Udaan
companies.description: Udaan is India's largest eB2B trade platform, connecting small businesses - kirana stores, chemists, hotels, restaurants, and offices - with manufacturers, brands, and wholesalers across categories including FMCG, staples, fruits and vegetables, pharma, and general merchandise. The platform combines supply chain and logistics operations with financial services for small businesses through udaanCapital, its working-capital fintech arm. Udaan is backed by Lightspeed Venture Partners and GGV Capital. It publishes no public developer API; buyer and seller experiences are delivered through its web and mobile apps, with api.udaan.com serving as the private app backend.

companies.name: Fazla Gida
companies.description: Fazla (formerly Fazla Gida / Whole Surplus) is a Turkish technology-driven waste management and circular-economy company founded in 2017 in Istanbul. Its digital, decision-support platform helps B2B clients across the supply chain — manufacturers, retailers, e-commerce, distributors, HoReCa, food banks and municipalities — prevent waste at the source and recover value from surplus inventory through a food-recovery hierarchy of secondary-sales marketplace, donation, animal-feed conversion and recycling modules, backed by logistics support, a smart-scale IoT inventory system and an AI analysis tool that reports financial, CO2 and social impact. The company operates the Fazla Iyi surprise-box consumer app, is the first B Corp-certified waste-management organization in Turkey, and is backed by 500 Global among other investors.

companies.name: FlagshipRTL
companies.description: FlagshipRTL (Flagship) is a SaaS company providing AI-powered inventory forecasting and merchandise planning software for retail brands, with a focus on apparel and direct-to-consumer (DTC) businesses. Its platform pairs demand forecasting at size-level granularity with multi-scenario planning, a purchase-order (PO) builder, and real-time inventory alerts to help retailers reduce stockouts and maximize full-price sell-through. Flagship reports optimizing over $2B in GMV for customers such as Bala, Mack Weldon, and Fresh Clean Threads, and integrates with systems including Shopify, NetSuite, Cin7, Snowflake, and Google Sheets. Backed by Insight Partners.

companies.name: Focal Point Procurement Solutions
companies.description: Focal Point is an AI-powered procurement orchestration platform for enterprise procurement teams. Founded in 2020 and headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia, the SaaS platform sits on top of a company's existing S2P and ERP systems to centralize procurement data, intake, and workflows across six core modules: Request Intake Management, Procurement Activity Management, Sourcing Event Management, Supplier Relationship Management, Third-Party Risk Management, and Contract Lifecycle Management. It connects existing systems and data via API integrations, automates tactical no-code workflows, and provides total spend visibility, intelligent intake, and smart routing so procurement teams can focus on strategic work. Focal Point does not currently publish a public developer API, OpenAPI definition, or developer portal; integrations are delivered through the platform. This profile was surfaced as a Techstars portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network.

companies.name: Omnifold
companies.description: Omnifold is an AI supply chain planning platform for physical product companies — CPGs, manufacturers, distributors, and retailers. The company trains a custom AI model for each supply chain to forecast demand, optimize inventory, and surface revenue, margin, and cash that traditional planning systems miss, positioning itself in the Forbes "Purpose-Built AI" tier and competing with Kinaxis, Blue Yonder, and o9. Omnifold was surfaced as a portfolio company of Bloomberg Beta and Lightspeed Venture Partners and added to the API Evangelist network. Omnifold publishes marketing and product content but exposes no public API, developer portal, SDKs, or authentication surface as of this enrichment pass.

companies.name: Open Port Technology
companies.description: Open Port Technology (OpenPort) is a pan-Asian logistics and supply chain technology company that digitizes trucking, freight, and supply chain operations across emerging markets through an open, neutral, AI-based platform. Headquartered in Karachi, Pakistan, its product suite spans transport management (OpenTM), a digital trucking marketplace (OpenMarket), customs clearance (OpenClear), warehouse picking operations (OpenPick), and FBR digital invoicing (Open Invoice). The company reports millions of completed shipments, 1,600+ transport partners, and integrations across 100+ ERP systems, offering ERP integration and custom API development to clients, though it publishes no public developer portal, API reference, or machine readable API specification at this time.

companies.name: Stellapps
companies.description: Stellapps is an end-to-end dairy technology company from Bangalore, India (IIT Madras incubated, founded 2011) that digitizes milk production, milk procurement, and cold-chain management through its SmartMoo full-stack IoT platform. Sensors in milking systems, animal wearables, chilling equipment, and procurement peripherals stream data to the SmartMoo Big Data Cloud for analytics and machine learning serving dairy farmers, cooperatives, and processors, with applications including mooON herd management, smartAMCU and smartCC milk procurement, ConTrak cold-chain monitoring, mooFlow ERP, and mooPay financial services. Stellapps publishes no public developer portal, API documentation, or SDKs; the SmartMoo platform is accessed through hosted applications behind CAS single sign-on.

companies.name: TradeLink
companies.description: TradeLink is a Munich-based logistics SaaS company building the first collaboration platform for supply chain and inbound/outbound logistics. Its cloud software gives warehouses, suppliers, carriers, and dispatchers a shared system for time-slot (dock) booking, dock and yard management, load-carrier and empties management, driver check-in terminals, and analytics insights, replacing phone and email coordination with real-time, transparent workflows. TradeLink integrates with existing ERP and transport-management systems and serves production, retail, and contract-logistics companies across the DACH region and Europe, with customers including MAN, SPAR, Liebherr, and Emons. It is backed by Insight Partners and Point Nine.

companies.name: Venwiz
companies.description: Venwiz is a Bengaluru, India based B2B digital platform for the procurement of industrial and infrastructural project services, covering both CapEx and MRO requirements for the manufacturing sector. Founded in 2020 by Rajesh Reddy and Sandesh Paturi, it operates a marketplace that connects industrial buyers with a verified, pan-India database of service vendors, adding vendor discovery, order expediting, project management tooling and vendor intelligence on top. Backed by Accel and other investors (~$11.4M raised), Venwiz digitises what has traditionally been an offline, relationship-driven industrial services procurement process. No public developer API, OpenAPI/Swagger definition, SDK, or documentation surface is published as of this enrichment pass; the public presence is a marketing/content website plus a login-gated application.

companies.name: Deppon Express
companies.description: Deppon Express (德邦快递), operated by Deppon Logistics Co., Ltd., is a major Chinese express delivery and logistics provider specializing in large-parcel (heavy/bulky) express, less-than-truckload freight, full-truckload, air freight, warehousing, supply chain, and cross-border services. Founded from Cui's Freight Company (1996) and incorporated in 2009, it became part of the JD Logistics group in 2022 and ranks among China's largest express carriers by market share. For developers and enterprise partners, Deppon runs the Deppon Open Platform (德邦开放平台, established 2015) at dpopen.deppon.com, offering system-integration APIs for order creation, standard track/tracking queries, and electronic waybill (面单) printing, with access granted to contracted monthly-settlement customers.

companies.name: Afresh Technologies
companies.description: Afresh Technologies builds an AI platform for grocery retail that helps supermarkets and distributors manage fresh food, reducing shrink, improving in-stock rates, and cutting food waste across store ordering, inventory management, production planning, recipe management, and distribution-center buying. Its machine-learning decision engine forecasts demand for perishable, random-weight, and bulk items where operational data is inherently messy, and is also offered as a backend Replenishment API that plugs Afresh's forecasting and ordering logic into a retailer's existing front-end systems without changing in-store associate workflows. The company is based in San Francisco and is backed by Insight Partners.

companies.name: CargoWise
companies.description: CargoWise is WiseTech Global's logistics execution platform - a single-database ERP for international freight forwarding, customs, warehousing, transport, and landside logistics. Its integration surface is delivered primarily through eAdaptor, which pairs a RESTful XML inbound service (push, query, add, and update records) with a SOAP-based outbound service (a webhook equivalent that emits messages on milestones). Payloads use CargoWise's Universal XML schemas - Universal Shipment (XUS), Universal Event (XUE), and Universal Transaction - or the legacy Native XML format. Newer REST integration (eAdaptor Next / xHub) adds OAuth 2.0 authorization-code access. The integration API is real but heavily gated - the eAdaptor Developers Guide and endpoint details are released only after a customer purchases the eAdaptor modules, and partner access runs through WiseTech accreditation and certification. Endpoints below are modeled from public developer references; the authoritative specification is not publicly published.

companies.name: Reliance Steel & Aluminum
companies.description: Reliance Steel & Aluminum Co. is the largest metals service center in North America, providing value-added metals processing services and distributing a full line of metal products including aluminum, brass, bronze, carbon and alloy steel, copper, titanium, and stainless steel. Operating over 300 service center locations across 40 US states and 13 countries, Reliance serves more than 130,000 customers across aerospace, automotive, defense, energy, electronics, construction, and semiconductor end markets.

companies.name: Icertis
companies.description: Icertis is an AI-native contract intelligence company that turns enterprise contracts into structured, actionable data and measurable business outcomes. Its Contract Intelligence (ICI) platform manages agreements across their full lifecycle — authoring, negotiation, execution, obligation management, and ongoing analytics — spanning sell-side, buy-side, and corporate contracts. The platform pairs a configurable contract data model with AI capabilities (the "Vera" AI assistant and agent-powered drafting, redlining, and negotiation) trained on millions of contracts. Icertis serves large enterprises across manufacturing, life sciences, healthcare, technology, financial services, and the public sector, and integrates with ERP, CRM, CPQ, and procurement systems such as SAP, Salesforce, Microsoft Dynamics, and Coupa. This profile was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of SoftBank Vision Fund and enriched from Icertis' public web presence.

companies.name: Sprouts Farmers Market
companies.description: Sprouts Farmers Market is a specialty grocery retailer focused on fresh, natural, and organic foods at affordable prices. Operating primarily in the western United States, Sprouts integrates with third-party platforms including Instacart, DoorDash, and Uber Eats for online grocery delivery. Sprouts uses EDI-based supply chain integrations and participates in Instacart's AI-powered Cart Assistant program. There is no public developer API; integrations are handled through EDI and third-party delivery platform partnerships.

companies.name: WESCO International
companies.description: WESCO International is a Fortune 500 leading provider of business-to-business distribution, logistics services, and supply chain solutions for electrical, industrial, communications, and utility customers worldwide. WESCO serves over 150,000 customers through a network of branches and distribution centers and provides comprehensive digital integration capabilities including EDI, punchout, cXML, and API connectivity for procurement automation.

companies.name: Covariant
companies.description: Covariant is an Emeryville, California warehouse-robotics AI company founded in 2017 (originally as Embodied Intelligence) by UC Berkeley professor Pieter Abbeel and his former students Peter Chen, Rocky Duan, and Tianhao Zhang. The company builds the Covariant Brain, a universal AI platform that enables industrial picking robots to handle virtually any SKU regardless of shape, size, or packaging, and in March 2024 it introduced RFM-1 (Robotics Foundation Model 1), an 8-billion-parameter multimodal transformer trained on text, images, video, robot actions, and numerical sensor readings to give robots human-like reasoning over the physical world. Covariant ships AI-powered solutions for order picking, sortation, item induction, kitting, depalletization, and goods-to-person workflows, delivered through long-running integration partnerships with KNAPP (Pick-it-Easy Robot, since 2020) and ABB (warehouse robotics, since 2020), as well as deployments with retailers and logistics providers worldwide. In August 2024, Amazon announced a non-exclusive license to Covariant's robotic foundation models and hired its three co-founders along with roughly a quarter of its workforce in a reverse-acquihire arrangement; Covariant continues to operate independently under COO-turned-CEO Ted Stinson and co-founder Tianhao Zhang. The Covariant Brain and RFM-1 are proprietary, deployed on-premise on partner robotics hardware, and the company has no public developer API, SDK, open-source release, or third-party developer program.

companies.name: Craftable
companies.description: Craftable is hospitality's back-office software platform for restaurants, bars, hotels, and resorts, originally known for its Bevager and Foodager products, that connects purchasing, inventory, recipes, and accounts payable with accounting and sales data. Its suite spans Intelligent Ordering (eProcurement), AP Automation with Invoice AI, Inventory and Recipe Management, and Daily Actionable Insights, plus AI features such as Operator AI and the Crafty in-app assistant. Craftable is SOC 2 compliant and SSO-capable, with more than 1,000 POS, EDI, and vendor/API integrations spanning systems such as Toast, Square, Lightspeed, Clover, SpotOn, TouchBistro, Aloha by NCR Voyix, Restaurant365, Sage Intacct, Oracle NetSuite, Acumatica, QuickBooks, and Xero. Craftable does not publish a public self-service developer portal, API documentation, or SDKs; integrations are delivered through its implementation team during onboarding, and API access to a connected platform is provisioned by requesting a scoped API key from that platform's support team.

companies.name: Symbotic
companies.description: Symbotic is an AI-powered warehouse automation company that designs, manufactures, and operates end-to-end robotic distribution and micro-fulfillment systems for food and beverage, retail grocery, healthcare, apparel, retail general merchandise, and consumer packaged goods customers. Its portfolio includes the Symbotic distribution solution for case handling, SymMicro for less-than-case micro-fulfillment, autonomous SymBots mobile robots, warehouse AI software, and Warehouse-as-a-Service offerings. Symbotic operates as a hardware-and-services vendor and does not publish a public developer portal or open APIs.

companies.name: Advantive
companies.description: Advantive is an AI-enabled software company for specialty manufacturing and distribution operations, unifying ERP, MES, quality (SPC/SQC), PLM, WMS, and B2B commerce workflows into industry-specific systems. Built from a portfolio of brands including Advantzware, DDI System, Distribution One, InfinityQS (Enact and ProFicient), Kiwiplan, WinSPC, and VIA, Advantive serves more than 2,500 customers across eight countries in verticals such as food and beverage, packaging (corrugated, folding carton, plastics), automotive, aerospace and defense, electronics, and distribution of fasteners, bearings, HVAC, and janitorial supplies. The company is a private-equity-backed operations software provider; this API Evangelist profile tracks its public digital surface. No public developer API or OpenAPI has been found — integration is delivered through the products' own connectors and the Advantive support portal.

companies.name: Apeel
companies.description: Apeel Sciences is a food technology company headquartered in Santa Barbara, California that develops plant-based protective coatings which extend the shelf life of fresh fruits and vegetables. The company uses food-grade ingredients derived from the peels, pulp, and seeds of plants to create a thin, edible layer that reinforces produce's natural peel, slowing water loss and oxidation. This extends peak taste, juiciness, and nutrient retention while reducing reliance on refrigeration, waxes, pesticides, and plastic packaging across the fresh-produce supply chain. Apeel positions itself as a sustainability and food-waste leader, reporting that since 2021 its technology has prevented millions of pieces of fruit from spoiling, avoided tens of thousands of metric tons of CO2-equivalent emissions, and conserved billions of liters of water. Its products have undergone regulatory review in the United States, European Union, and other markets. Apeel is a portfolio company of Andreessen Horowitz (a16z) and was added to the API Evangelist network as a venture-portfolio lead. It publishes no public developer API, developer portal, or machine-readable API specification as of this profile.

companies.name: autone
companies.description: autone is an AI-powered inventory management platform for retail brands, blending machine-driven recommendations with merchandising expertise and a brand's own data to optimize stock decisions across buying, reordering, replenishment, and rebalancing. Its modules — Buy, Reorder, Replenish, Rebalance, Assortment & Initial Allocation, and Insights — help fashion, beauty, furniture, and sports retailers reduce stockouts and overstock, redistribute inventory across locations, and improve margins. Founded by supply-chain operators from luxury fashion houses (Alexander McQueen, Victoria Beckham, Givenchy), autone is backed by General Catalyst, Seedcamp, and Speedinvest. No public developer API or documentation is published at this time; the platform is delivered as an enterprise SaaS. This profile originated as a VC-portfolio lead and has been enriched with verifiable company identity and domain-security signals.

companies.name: Carahsoft
companies.description: Carahsoft Technology Corp. is a master government IT solutions aggregator and distributor that resells software, cloud, and cybersecurity products from hundreds of technology vendors to U.S. federal, state, local, defense, intelligence, healthcare, and education customers across 220+ government contract vehicles. Carahsoft operates a partner-facing Developer Center that exposes partner integrations for accounts, quotes, orders, invoices, price lists, purchase orders, and resources; the underlying API is gated behind a partner account and is not a public REST API.

companies.name: Dagangan
companies.description: Dagangan is an Indonesian tech-enabled wholesale e-commerce platform serving small and medium retailers (SMEs) in tier 3-4 cities and rural areas. Through a hub-and-spoke network of 50+ micro-warehouses across remote regions, it connects large suppliers to traditional local retailers, giving them affordable mobile access to daily necessities and groceries while reducing delivery costs and supply-chain friction. The company operates a consumer/retailer Android shopping application (Dagangan Mall), is backed by 500 Global, and is recognized as a Rural Digitalization Partner of Indonesia's Ministry of Villages, Disadvantaged Regions, and Transmigration. As of this profile, Dagangan publishes no public developer API or OpenAPI specification.

companies.name: Elevarm
companies.description: Elevarm is an upstream-focused agritech company founded in 2022 and headquartered in Bandung, Indonesia, that elevates smallholder horticulture farmers across West Java, Central Java, and Yogyakarta. It aggregates and supports more than 15,000 farmers with high-quality inputs (premium greenhouse seedlings, bio-based fertilizers, and environmentally friendly pest control via its NextBio line), lab-based soil testing through Klinik Tani, an AI-powered farming productivity app for land monitoring and data-driven agronomy recommendations, pro-farmer financing, and the PasarAgri commodity trading platform that links supply to business buyers. Elevarm is backed by Intudo, Insignia Ventures Partners, and 500 Global.

companies.name: Evigence Sensors
companies.description: Evigence Sensors is a freshness-management technology company for the food industry, combining low-cost physical sensors with data analytics to monitor food quality in real time from production to consumption at the individual item level. Its time-temperature indicator technology powers both digital (QR-scan) and visual freshness indicators applied to retail units, serving food brands, retailers, foodservice operators, cold-chain logistics providers, and consumers across the supply chain. Evigence holds 27 granted patents and its indicators meet WHO time/temperature monitoring standards. The company was surfaced as a portfolio company of Battery Ventures and added to the API Evangelist network. As of this enrichment pass Evigence publishes no public developer portal, API documentation, SDK, or machine-readable API surface; this profile captures its verified public company properties only.

companies.name: Forum Mobility
companies.description: Forum Mobility develops, owns, and operates zero-emission heavy-duty trucking infrastructure, bundling electric Class 8 truck leases with charging subscriptions for a single monthly price so freight carriers of every size can electrify without upfront capital. The company builds and runs a network of charging depots — anchored by its flagship FM Harbor site at the Port of Long Beach (44 ports, 360KW fast chargers, 9MW capacity) — with additional depots in development across California and Nevada. Forum Mobility was surfaced as a portfolio company of obvious-ventures and added to the API Evangelist network. It is a physical-infrastructure operator with no public developer/API surface at this time; this profile captures its identity and domain-security posture.

companies.name: Geek+
companies.description: Geek+ (Geekplus, HKEX: 2590) is a global leader in AI-driven autonomous mobile robot (AMR) solutions for warehouse and logistics automation. Founded in 2015, it delivers end-to-end smart-warehouse systems spanning shelf-to-person (PopPick), tote-to-person (RoboShuttle), pallet-to-person (Skycube) storage and retrieval, robot-arm picking, sorting, and intralogistics transport. Its All-in-One Software Suite (Robot Management System, Warehouse Execution System, Intelligent Warehouse Management System, data and simulation platforms) exposes open REST APIs and SDKs so customers and partners can integrate robot fleets with major WMS, ERP, and MES platforms including SAP, Oracle, Microsoft Dynamics, Manhattan Associates, and Blue Yonder. Geek+ serves 3PL, retail, e-commerce, apparel, grocery, healthcare and pharma, manufacturing, automotive, electronics, and cold-chain logistics across 40+ countries, with 950+ deployed warehouses. In 2025 it became the world's first publicly listed AMR warehouse robotics company on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange.

companies.name: iMile
companies.description: iMile is a technology-driven last-mile delivery and e-commerce logistics company founded in 2017 and headquartered in Dubai, United Arab Emirates. Led by founder and CEO Rita Huang, iMile provides express parcel delivery, cash-on-delivery (COD), domestic and international express, dropshipping, order fulfillment, warehousing, storage, and reverse logistics / return management across more than 30 countries spanning the Middle East, China, Latin America, Africa, Europe, and Australia. The company operates its own routing, tracking, and delivery technology and employs over 20,000 people. iMile assigns each shipment a 13-digit tracking number; parcel tracking is available on imile.com and through major third-party tracking aggregators. iMile does not currently publish a first-party public developer API or open platform, so this profile captures its identity and domain-security posture.

companies.name: Keychain
companies.description: Keychain is an AI-powered operating system and network for the consumer packaged goods (CPG) industry, connecting brands and retailers with the contract manufacturers, co-packers, and suppliers that make their products. The platform lets CPG brands discover and match with vetted manufacturing partners, manage sourcing and production relationships, and streamline the supplier-discovery workflow that has traditionally been manual and relationship-driven. Backed by Andreessen Horowitz (a16z), Keychain was added to the API Evangelist network as a company profile surfaced from the a16z venture portfolio. As of this enrichment pass Keychain publishes a marketing and product web presence at keychain.com but does not expose a public developer program, API reference, or machine-readable API discovery surface (no developer/API subdomain, no /.well-known catalog, no llms.txt).

companies.name: Kodiak Robotics
companies.description: Kodiak Robotics, which now operates publicly as Kodiak AI, is an autonomous vehicle company founded in April 2018 by CEO Don Burnette and headquartered in California with a Texas operations center. Its flagship product is the Kodiak Driver, an AI-driven autonomy system that pairs onboard artificial intelligence with modular, swappable sensor hardware and offboard services so that a single driverless stack can be carried across different vehicle platforms. The company sells into three markets — long-haul trucking, defense, and industrial ground transportation — and positions driverless operation as a safety improvement, citing that more than 85% of U.S. truck crashes are caused by human error. Kodiak reports more than 2.6 million autonomous miles driven and over 7,000 loads delivered. Kodiak publishes no public developer API, API documentation, developer portal, or SDKs; enrichment probes of kodiak.ai found no /.well-known/ discovery documents and no api/docs/developer subdomains. It does publish an llms.txt, an RSS news feed, and a corporate safety report, so this profile is maintained as a company record rather than an API producer profile.

companies.name: KokkanLogis Co.,Ltd.
companies.description: KokkanLogis Co.,Ltd. (주식회사 곳간, branded KOKKAN / 도심창고 곳간) is a South Korean urban self-storage and logistics operator headquartered in Gangnam-gu, Seoul. It rents managed storage units in five sizes (S, M, L, XL, XXL, from 1.0m cubes up to 2.0 x 2.0 x 2.0m) across 22 branches in Seoul, Busan, Incheon, Gyeonggi and Chungbuk, serving households storing seasonal appliances, clothing, bedding and baby goods as well as businesses storing samples, inventory, documents and office equipment. Customers select a branch, choose a unit size, pay and manage their contract through the KOKKAN mobile apps for iOS and Android, with recurring monthly card billing through a Korean payment gateway, long-term and promotional discounting, an address-rental (주소지 임대) product, and an optional pickup service for moving stored goods. The company also runs a franchise and partnership program for operators who want to open a KOKKAN branch. It was surfaced through the 500 Global portfolio. As of this profile KokkanLogis publishes no public API, developer portal, SDK or technical documentation — the product surface is a consumer website plus native mobile apps.

companies.name: Mercanis
companies.description: Mercanis is an AI-powered procurement platform that automates the end-to-end source-to-contract lifecycle for enterprise procurement teams. It combines structured intake, connected sourcing (RFx and supplier comparison), supplier relationship management, contract lifecycle management, and risk, compliance and spend analytics, coordinated by a large fleet of autonomous AI agents. Mercanis serves sectors including energy and utilities, pharma and chemicals, automotive, consumer goods, manufacturing, and construction, and integrates with ERP systems such as SAP and NetSuite alongside procurement networks like Unite. The company is headquartered in Germany with SOC-certified, GDPR-compliant infrastructure. No public developer API, documentation, or /.well-known discovery surface has been identified as of this enrichment pass.

companies.name: Revlon
companies.description: Revlon is a global beauty company whose portfolio spans color cosmetics, fragrance, skin care, hair color, hair care, beauty tools, and antiperspirants / deodorants. The company markets Revlon, Elizabeth Arden, Almay, Mitchum, Cutex, Charlie, SinfulColors, and Ultima II, along with a portfolio of licensed prestige and celebrity fragrance brands. Revlon Consumer Products Corporation filed for Chapter 11 bankruptcy protection in the Southern District of New York on June 15, 2022 and emerged on May 2, 2023 as a privately held company controlled by its former lenders (including BrandCo noteholders such as King Street Capital, Glendon Capital, and Angelo Gordon), having cut roughly $2.7 billion of debt from its balance sheet. Today Revlon operates as a private company with reduced leverage, selling through mass-market retail and prestige channels worldwide. Revlon does not publish a public developer API; supplier, retailer, and partner integrations occur through private commercial channels (e-commerce platform integrations, EDI / GDSN feeds for retailers, and the corporate procurement portal).

companies.name: Robust.AI
companies.description: Robust.AI is a robotics company building Carter, an AI-powered collaborative mobile robot for warehouse fulfillment and manufacturing environments. Founded by Rodney Brooks (co-founder of iRobot and Rethink Robotics) and colleagues, the company designs human-centered autonomous material-handling robots that work alongside people with minimal infrastructure change, no capital expenditure, and rapid ROI. Robust.AI is backed by Playground Global and was recognized among Fast Company's World's Most Innovative Companies of 2026. This is a physical-robotics company; as of this enrichment pass it publishes no public developer portal, API, SDK, or GitHub surface.

companies.name: Salasa
companies.description: Salasa is an end-to-end eCommerce logistics provider based in Saudi Arabia, offering 3PL fulfillment (warehouse storage, automated pick/pack/ship), hyperlocal dark stores with 2-hour delivery in Riyadh, domestic on-demand and scheduled shipping, cross-border shipping with customs clearance, and reverse logistics / return management. Its Operations Management System (OMS) provides real-time tracking, inventory management, and analytics, and it connects to major eCommerce platforms (Salla, Zid, Shopify, WooCommerce, Magento, Amazon, Trendyol) and offers custom API integrations for merchants automating fulfillment and order synchronization.

companies.name: sherpa
companies.description: sherpa is an AI operating system for External Workforce Management (EWM) that runs an enterprise's contingent-labor program end to end with autonomous agents, replacing the work traditionally done by a VMS (Vendor Management System) and MSP (Managed Service Provider). Its agents cover every phase of an external engagement: autonomous intake and classification from Slack, email, Teams or voice; collaborative scope, role and budget drafting; autonomous sourcing with market-benchmarked rates and ranked candidates and suppliers; coordinated screening interviews scored against a weighted rubric; autonomous hiring and onboarding (documents, background and compliance checks, contracts, provisioning, hardware and badges); and active management and payment with a dedicated PM agent, live spend visibility and flexible payouts once outcomes are verified. One platform spans every worker type — contingent labor, freelancers / independent contractors (with a built-in Agent of Record), SOW / services engagements, and, coming soon, AI agents as a managed worker type — with rate intelligence, compliance management and analytics built in. sherpa launched out of stealth with a $2.2M pre-seed round and is backed by Seedcamp and Y Combinator.

companies.name: Shopeando
companies.description: Shopeando is a Mexican technology and logistics startup that manages the full international shipping process, enabling businesses and individuals to import and export merchandise between China, Europe, the United States and Mexico. Through its platform it coordinates cross-border logistics, customs handling and last-mile delivery, and provides dedicated import, export and e-commerce fulfillment services for online stores. Shopeando is backed by 500 Global.

companies.name: Silo
companies.description: Silo is a cloud-based ERP platform built specifically for the fresh-produce supply chain, serving growers, packers, shippers, and distributors. The platform unifies produce operations across five modules - a diversified produce ERP, labor and asset management, payments and financial operations, EDI and traceability, and analytics and intelligence - to improve operational efficiency and financial visibility for small to midsize produce businesses. Silo is backed by a16z and Initialized Capital. As of this profile the company publishes no public developer API, SDK, or API documentation.

companies.name: Viewlocity
companies.description: Viewlocity Technologies Pty Ltd is a supply chain management software company that provides supply chain visibility, control tower, and execution solutions for global manufacturers, distributors, and logistics providers. Its solution set spans supply chain design, inventory and asset management, supply chain management, logistics and transportation, planning and production, order lifecycle management, and supplier management, delivered as SaaS and managed services to industries including aerospace and defense, automotive and industrial, consumer goods, high tech and electronics, manufacturing, retail, and third-party logistics. Viewlocity publishes a corporate marketing and resource website but does not expose a public developer portal, API documentation, or machine-readable API specifications.

companies.name: Freshop
companies.description: Freshop is an eCommerce platform purpose-built for grocery and specialty retail, now part of NCR Voyix. It powers branded online storefronts, mobile shopping, order fulfillment, pickup, and delivery for independent and regional grocers, and integrates third-party services for loyalty, coupons, email, SMS, and fulfillment. Freshop exposes a live REST API at api.freshop.com that serves store and product data to Freshop-powered storefronts and apps, authenticated with an application key (app_key) query-string parameter and versioned by a numeric path segment.

companies.name: Reliance, Inc.
companies.description: Reliance, Inc. (NYSE: RS) is the largest metals service center operator in North America, distributing approximately 100,000 metal products across aluminum, brass, alloy, copper, carbon steel, stainless steel, titanium, and specialty metals to over 125,000 customers including fabricators and manufacturers. Operating under more than 75 distinct brands across 300+ locations in the US, Canada, and internationally, Reliance provides value-added processing services including cutting, shearing, sawing, leveling, stamping, and just-in-time delivery for aerospace, automotive, construction, defense, energy, electronics, and semiconductor end markets.

companies.name: Elektrik App
companies.description: Elektrik is a medium voltage (MV) equipment procurement platform for electrical distributors, contractors, and Engineering, Procurement & Construction (EPC) firms. Founded in 2020 by Mario Dealba out of the Techstars Alabama EnergyTech Accelerator, the company streamlines sourcing of medium- to high-voltage supplies (roughly 5kV-35kV / 600V-69kV) including MV cable, terminations, splices, deadbreak and loadbreak connectors, and transformers. Buyers build part lists and specifications in the web app and Elektrik surfaces matching products across leading manufacturers such as TE Connectivity, BURNDY, Richards Manufacturing, and PFISTERER, compressing a traditionally slow, quote-driven procurement cycle. Backed by Techstars and growth capital, Elektrik is added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment; the company does not currently publish a public API, developer portal, or OpenAPI.

companies.name: KWI
companies.description: KWI is a retail technology company founded in 1985 and headquartered in Melville, New York, that delivers a cloud-based, unified commerce platform for specialty and department retailers. The platform combines an iOS mobile point-of-sale, merchandising and inventory optimization, order management with buy-anywhere / fulfill-from-anywhere fulfillment, CRM, clienteling and loyalty, the Snapshot real-time sales analytics application, and AI product image search, all operated as a SaaS managed service with helpdesk, hardware, and payments support. KWI describes an API layer in its platform architecture used to export data to third-party systems and channels --- CRMs, ERPs, SRPs, and supply chains --- alongside packaged connectors such as Shopify Connect and a Klaviyo connector. As of this profile KWI publishes no public developer portal, API reference, machine-readable specification, or SDKs; integration is delivered through its professional-services organization under customer contract.

companies.name: Sales Patriot
companies.description: SalesPatriot deploys artificial intelligence into enterprise supply chain operations, embedding engineers onsite to build custom AI solutions that integrate fragmented business systems (ERP, CRM, email, spreadsheets, and supplier portals) and automate routine workflows. The platform aggregates data from scattered sources into a unified, searchable system, automates tasks such as quoting, sourcing, and data entry, and visualizes real-time operational metrics for executives. It serves defense contracting and procurement, complex multi-source procurement operations, and high-volume distribution. SalesPatriot is a portfolio company of CRV. This profile was added to the API Evangelist network and enriched by the pipeline; the company publishes no public developer or API surface at this time.

companies.name: Alta Resource Technologies
companies.description: Alta Resource Technologies is a Colorado-based deep-tech company reinventing how critical minerals are sourced. It uses advanced biochemistry — customizable, engineered proteins licensed from Lawrence Livermore National Laboratory and co-developed with researchers at Pennsylvania State University — to selectively separate high-purity rare earth elements and other strategic metals from low-grade ores, mining tailings, and electronic-waste streams such as end-of-life hard disk drives. The protein-based platform binds target elements out of complex, low-concentration solutions with high selectivity while dramatically reducing the environmental footprint of conventional mining and refining, strengthening U.S. and allied critical-mineral supply chains. Alta emerged from stealth in January 2025 and expanded its Series Seed to $10M, backed by DCVC, Voyager Ventures, In-Q-Tel, and Orion Industrial Ventures. As a materials-science and biochemistry company, Alta does not publish a public developer API, SDKs, or a developer portal; this API Evangelist profile carries its identity and website properties only.

companies.name: Collectiv Food
companies.description: Collectiv Food is a next-generation B2B food wholesaler serving professional kitchens across the UK and France. Launched in London in 2022, it combines collective buying power, consolidated deliveries, and direct sourcing through a shortened, patented supply-chain model to supply restaurants, hotels, and caterers with meat, fish, plant-based proteins, dairy, produce, dry and frozen goods, and prepared items. The company emphasizes traceability, responsible sourcing, and sustainability, and is B-Corp certified with an EcoVadis Gold rating. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Partech and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment; no public API or developer portal is currently published.

companies.name: Cosmart
companies.description: Cosmart is an Indonesian membership-only B2B e-commerce and procurement platform, founded in 2021 by Alvin Kumarga and Robert Tan, where members (individuals and SMEs) purchase their recurring daily and business needs in larger quantities at competitive prices. The platform lists over 100,000 products across categories including office supplies, electronics, household items, automotive parts, industrial equipment, furniture, and services, with nationwide delivery, flexible payment terms, and dedicated relationship managers for corporate clients. Backed by Lightspeed Venture Partners and Lightspeed India Partners. Cosmart does not publish a public developer program, API, or SDKs; this profile captures its identity and public web properties for the API Evangelist network.

companies.name: J&T Express
companies.description: J&T Express (J&T Global Express Ltd, HKEX: 1519) is a global logistics service operator whose core business is express parcel delivery and international logistics. Founded in Indonesia in 2015, it operates express delivery networks across 13 countries including Indonesia, Vietnam, Malaysia, the Philippines, Thailand, Cambodia, Singapore, China, Saudi Arabia, the UAE, Mexico, Brazil, and Egypt, with international freight services reaching Asia, Europe, Africa, the Americas, and Oceania. The company serves e-commerce sellers and consumers with parcel pickup, sorting, line-haul, last-mile delivery, and track-and-trace. As of this profile J&T Express publishes a public track-and-trace web experience and regional merchant onboarding, but no public developer portal, API documentation, or OpenAPI definition was found during enrichment; this profile captures the company identity and probed domain security.

companies.name: Koobz
companies.description: Koobz is a Ventura, California additive-manufacturing company rebuilding the footwear supply chain around on-demand 3D printing. Its "gigafactory" prints circular-ready, mono-material foamed-TPU shoes to order, so brands carry zero inventory and face no minimum order quantities: a consumer buys on the brand's own storefront, the order and personalization specs sync to the Koobz factory, the shoe is printed in Ventura and dropshipped direct to the customer in days. The company markets 10x faster concept-to-market cycles (4-6 weeks, no tooling), custom cushioning and foot-scanning personalization, and a KoobzWeave toolpath-as-textile upper pattern engine. Its mono-material architecture is positioned for Extended Producer Responsibility regimes such as California SB 707, since a single-polymer shoe yields premium TPU on take-back rather than mixed waste. Koobz has raised $7.2M and is backed by Uncork Capital.
