It describes its factory as API-driven and its order intake as an API sync from brand storefronts, but as of this profile it publishes no public developer portal, API documentation, or machine-readable API definition; integration appears to run through its partner ("Partner With Us") channel.

companies.name: Reibus
companies.description: Reibus is a technology-enabled B2B platform for the industrial metals industry, originally a digital marketplace for buying and selling steel and other metals and now focused on open-deck freight logistics for shipping steel and industrial metals. Operating as Reibus Logistics, the company connects shippers with a vast network of international and domestic carriers across flatbed, dry van, and drayage modes, offering instant quoting, shipment visibility, and cross-border logistics in the US, Canada, and Mexico. Founded by CEO John Blount, Reibus operates in 7 countries, does business in 25+ countries, and is backed by Canaan Partners, Initialized Capital, and the SoftBank Vision Fund. As of this profile the company publishes no public developer API, SDK, or developer portal.

companies.name: Savi Technology
companies.description: Savi Technology provides Internet of Things (IoT) and active RFID (aRFID) solutions for real-time supply chain visibility, asset tracking, and cargo security. Combining active RFID tags, environmental condition sensors, and machine intelligence, Savi delivers location, condition, and estimated-time- of-arrival data for cargo and high-value assets across government, military (including U.S. Department of Defense in-transit visibility), and commercial supply chains. The company is headquartered in Wilmington, North Carolina. As of this enrichment pass, Savi Technology exposes no public developer portal, OpenAPI/Swagger definition, SDKs, or documented web API; its only authenticated surface is the aRFID-VI customer catalog (savirfidcatalog.net).

companies.name: Scalera
companies.description: Scalera AG is a Swiss construction-technology company building an AI platform that automates the tender and quotation process for the construction industry across the DACH region (Germany, Austria, Switzerland). Its product-matching engine extracts positions from tender documents (PDF, GAEB, Excel/CSV, XML, email) and matches them against supplier product catalogs, while its supplier-matching tools help contractors identify relevant manufacturers and send structured inquiries. Scalera integrates with ERP, CRM, and PIM systems and serves 200+ manufacturers, processors, and traders. Backed by Speedinvest, it positions itself as one of Europe's most funded construction-tech startups. This profile documents the company's public web surface; no public developer API is currently published.

companies.name: Snowman
companies.description: Snowman Logistics is an Indian integrated cold-chain and temperature-controlled logistics company headquartered in Bengaluru, providing refrigerated (frozen and chilled) warehousing, cold storage, and distribution services across India. It serves frozen and chilled foods, dairy, seafood, quick-service restaurants, pharmaceuticals, and other perishables through a national network of temperature-controlled warehouses and a refrigerated transportation fleet. The company is publicly listed on Indian exchanges and was surfaced as a portfolio company of Norwest Venture Partners. This profile was enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline; the enrichment pass confirmed the company publishes a marketing/corporate website (snowman.in) but exposes no public developer, API, or well-known discovery surface.

companies.name: Carnot Fleet
companies.description: Carnot Fleet (Carnotfleet) is a Seoul-based cold-chain technology company that converts non-refrigerated vehicles into temperature-controlled units in under 30 minutes using modular insulation panels and proprietary solid-state thermoelectric heat pumps, spanning frozen, chilled, and ambient ranges with humidity control. Its Adaptive Thermal Control System (ATCS) is an AI-based autonomous control platform delivering cloud-connected temperature monitoring at 10-second intervals. Carnot Fleet surfaces its capabilities through the CF Mobile Application, the CF Portal, and CF APIs that let customers integrate the ATCS into existing logistics solutions to detect, analyze, prevent, and discover cold-chain data points and reduce post-harvest to pre-retail loss across the supply chain.

companies.name: Colgate-Palmolive
companies.description: Colgate-Palmolive Company is a global consumer-products manufacturer operating in oral care, personal care, home care, and pet nutrition through brands such as Colgate, Palmolive, Hill's Pet Nutrition, Speed Stick, Ajax, and Softsoap. Colgate-Palmolive does not publish a general-purpose public developer REST API. Its B2B integration footprint is centered on EDI exchanges with retail trading partners (X12 messages, AS2, VAN), supplier integrations through SAP Ariba, and internal corporate systems. There is also a corporate sustainability and ESG reporting surface, but it is not exposed as a developer API.

companies.name: Kakehashi
companies.description: Kakehashi is a Japanese healthcare technology company digitally transforming the country's roughly 60,000 community pharmacies, a traditionally paper-based sector. Its flagship cloud platform Musubi provides electronic medication history, automated dispensing records, and personalized patient guidance, and is used by more than 14,000 pharmacies across Japan. The product suite extends to Musubi Insight (pharmacy management analytics), Pocket Musubi (patient follow-up app), Musubi AI Stock Management (machine-learning demand forecasting and inventory optimization), and Pharmarket. Kakehashi is backed by investors including 500 Global and Goldman Sachs. No public developer API or platform is currently published.

companies.name: Sirius
companies.description: beSirius is an Amsterdam-based AI platform for the critical minerals and metals value chain. It builds a continuously verified digital Twin of every supplier, mapping each company's data to the frameworks, questionnaires, and regulations its buyers, auditors, and regulators require - including CSDDD, CMRT/EMRT/AMRT conflict-minerals reporting, EcoVadis, CDP, S&P CSA, UN Global Compact, LME Passport, and the Consolidated Mining Standard Initiative (CMSI). The platform automates supplier due diligence, sustainability and ESG data collection and verification, certification readiness, customer KYC, and ratings improvement across mining, processing, and trading supply chains, reducing manual audit and disclosure effort. beSirius is backed by Techstars and other investors.

companies.name: CoPlane
companies.description: CoPlane is a San Francisco-based enterprise software company building an AI-native intelligent operations layer for the back office of essential enterprises. The platform combines AI agents with deterministic business rules on a durable workflow engine to automate high-friction, exception-heavy processes across finance, procurement, and operations — including invoice intake, PO matching, vendor onboarding, cash application, billing, collections, bank and account reconciliation, close processes, and variance analysis. CoPlane runs inside the customer's own cloud environment and interoperates with existing enterprise systems (SAP, Workday, Coupa) across Source-to-Pay, Quote-to-Cash, and Record-to-Report workflows without a rip-and-replace migration. Founded in 2024, the company raised a $14M seed round in November 2025 led by Ribbit Capital with participation from Stripe, Optum Ventures, and Terrain. This profile was surfaced as a Ribbit Capital portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment; CoPlane does not currently publish a public developer API, OpenAPI, or developer portal.

companies.name: Kaizntree Inc.
companies.description: Kaizntree is a New York-based operations platform for growth-stage consumer packaged goods (CPG) brands, giving multi-channel manufacturers and sellers a single system to run purchasing, inventory, sales, fulfillment, production, and lot-level traceability. Its two products are Kaizntree OS, a cloud ERP that centralizes stock across raw materials, intermediate goods, packaging, finished and bundled products with COGS, margin, multi-location, batch/expiry and audit-ready records, and JP, an ERP-agnostic AI operations assistant that automates high-volume workflows such as purchase-order processing, reporting, data synchronization, and OTIF tracking. Kaizntree integrates with sales channels (including Shopify), accounting, WMS, and fulfillment platforms. Backed by 500 Global (seed, 2022), it operates on usage-based pricing. This profile was surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio company; Kaizntree publishes no public developer API, OpenAPI, or SDK surface at this time.

companies.name: Normative
companies.description: Normative is a Stockholm, Sweden-based carbon accounting and ESG reporting software company helping enterprises measure, report, and reduce their greenhouse gas emissions across scopes 1, 2, and 3. Its platform combines a library of more than 349,000 region- and sector-specific emission factors with workflows for product carbon footprint (PCF), supply chain engagement, Science Based Targets initiative (SBTi) target setting, Corporate Sustainability Reporting Directive (CSRD) disclosure, and Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism (CBAM) reporting. Calculations are built to the GHG Protocol and independently verified by TÜV SÜD against ISO/IEC 25051. Customers include Vodafone, Hertz, Hitachi Rail, and Flying Tiger Copenhagen, and every account is paired with a named, GHG Protocol-certified Climate Strategy Advisor rather than a traditional support helpdesk. The company's revenue model is enterprise SaaS subscriptions plus advisory services; Normative does not publish a public developer API, SDK, or open-source release, and its GitHub organization (normative-io) currently exposes no public repositories.

companies.name: Terrascope
companies.description: Terrascope is a Singapore-headquartered climate-tech and sustainability software company building an enterprise carbon measurement, management, and decarbonization platform. Launched in 2022 after being incubated and spun out of Olam Group (a Temasek-linked Singapore agribusiness), and led by former Google and AWS executive Felipe Daguila, Terrascope serves large food, agriculture, retail, and manufacturing enterprises that need to quantify Scope 1, 2, and 3 emissions across their operations, products, and supply chains. The platform centers on four core modules: Corporate Carbon Footprint (CCF) for organization-level inventories, Product Carbon Footprint (PCF) for product-level lifecycle emissions, Supplier Engagement for Scope 3 primary-data collection, and Climate Reporting for audit-ready disclosure. Terrascope's differentiator is its AI-assisted data ingestion layer (built on Amazon Bedrock) that reduces measurement cycles by roughly 80% versus manual baselines, intelligent emissions factor matching with FLAG (Forestry, Land, and Agriculture) breakdowns, data gap-filling claiming 92% accuracy versus supplier data, and a curated library of over 20,000 decarbonization best practices used to power what-if scenario modeling and ROI-ranked recommendations. The platform supports the GHG Protocol (including Land Sector and Removals guidance), SBTi FLAG, CDP (Terrascope is a CDP Gold Accredited software provider), TCFD, California SB253, and Australia's S2 climate disclosure regimes. Notable customers include Kellanova, Princes Group, iNova Pharmaceuticals, Mandai Wildlife Group, Olam Food Ingredients, Tetra Pak, Mitsubishi, Japan Tobacco, and Kagome. Investors include Olam Group and Plug and Play Tech Center. Terrascope is delivered as a closed enterprise SaaS — there is no publicly documented developer API, OpenAPI specification, SDK, CLI, or open-source release. The github.com/terrascope organization exists but has no public repositories, and docs.terrascope.com is not publicly resolvable. Integration with customer ERP, procurement, and energy systems is handled through bespoke implementation engagements rather than self-serve developer onboarding.

companies.name: FarMart
companies.description: FarMart is an AI-powered food sourcing and procurement platform that connects suppliers, food manufacturers, processors, and logistics providers across the global food and energy supply chain. It provides end-to-end procurement infrastructure including verified supplier discovery, five-minute AI-powered KYC verification, compliance management, market-to-factory batch traceability, automated invoicing and e-way bill generation, and real-time payment settlement in one to four hours. FarMart serves food companies, HoReCa (hospitality) buyers, and bio-fuel supply chains, with a network spanning 100+ premium buyers, 50+ food categories, and 10,000+ suppliers.

companies.name: Via Global Health
companies.description: Via Global Health (VIA Global Health) is a medical equipment and pharmaceutical supplier serving distributors, healthcare providers, and NGOs across Africa, Asia, and Latin America. The company sources quality diagnostic equipment, surgical instruments, maternal and reproductive health devices, infection control and sterilization equipment, cold chain and laboratory supplies, and pharmaceutical-grade consumables from vetted manufacturers, and handles logistics, compliance, and last-mile delivery for low-resource health settings. Buyers request USD-priced quotes on any product page and receive a response within 24 hours, guided by an AI assistant named Amara. It is a quote-and-fulfillment marketplace with no publicly documented developer API surface; a private, robots-disallowed /api/* backs the storefront only. Backed by 500 Global.

companies.name: Arzana
companies.description: Arzana is an AI-powered Office Execution System for US manufacturers and distributors, founded in 2025 in San Francisco and backed by Y Combinator (Spring 2026). Arzana trains custom models on a factory's historical data and deploys agents that automate back-office work — quoting, estimating, order entry, purchasing, prospecting, outreach, CRM, AP 3-way match, AR tracking, and customer service — alongside a customizable ERP/CRM/MES with every agent pre-installed. Forward-deployed engineers configure each agent per operation; Arzana reports going live in 120 days with 99%+ accuracy. Arzana currently exposes no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface; it does publish a /llms.txt for agent discovery.

companies.name: Chiquita Brands International
companies.description: Chiquita Brands International is a leading global producer, marketer, and distributor of bananas and other fresh produce, recognized worldwide by the iconic Blue Sticker on its bananas. Founded in 1899 as the United Fruit Company and rebranded as Chiquita in 1990, the company is headquartered in Etoy, Switzerland (with significant operations in Fort Lauderdale, Florida) and sources fruit from plantations across Latin America (Honduras, Guatemala, Costa Rica, Panama, Colombia, and Ecuador) for distribution in the United States, Europe, and other markets. Beyond core Cavendish bananas, Chiquita markets specialty banana varieties (organic, Reds, Manzanos, Minis), plantains, pineapples (including the Sunburst Gold variety), and partners with retailers worldwide. Chiquita does not currently publish a consumer-facing developer API; supplier, retailer, and grower integrations are managed through internal portals and bilateral EDI systems, and consumer-facing digital experiences focus on recipes, sticker collection campaigns, and retail merchandising.

companies.name: Cleveland-Cliffs
companies.description: Cleveland-Cliffs is North America's largest flat-rolled steel producer and supplier of iron ore pellets, operating an integrated business spanning mining, steelmaking, and downstream finishing for the automotive, infrastructure, and manufacturing markets. Cleveland-Cliffs does not publish a public developer portal or general-purpose REST API surface. Programmatic interaction with the company is limited to investor and customer touchpoints (corporate website, investor relations, customer service, EDI for trading partners).

companies.name: Coty
companies.description: Coty Inc. is one of the world's largest beauty companies with an iconic portfolio of brands across fragrance, color cosmetics, skin and body care. The company operates two divisions: Prestige (premium fragrance, cosmetics, and skincare brands such as Gucci, Burberry, Calvin Klein, Hugo Boss, Marc Jacobs, Tiffany, Chloe, Davidoff, Lancaster, philosophy, and Kylie Cosmetics) and Consumer Beauty (mass-market color cosmetics, hair care, and body care brands such as CoverGirl, Rimmel, Max Factor, Sally Hansen, Bourjois, and Adidas). Coty does not publish a public developer API; supplier and partner integrations occur through the Coty Supplier Portal and B2B / EDI channels.

companies.name: Gather AI
companies.description: Gather AI is a Physical AI platform for logistics that gives warehouses dock-to-dock inventory visibility. Cameras mounted on autonomous drones and forklifts capture inventory, and computer vision extracts structured data (LPNs, UPCs, lot codes, and free text) from the imagery. Its Sage AI engine analyzes operations and surfaces prioritized actions before each shift, while automated Workflows route tasks to the right personnel across integrated systems. The plug-and-play solution deploys in hours alongside existing warehouse management systems, serving manufacturing, healthcare, food & beverage, retail, and 3PL operations. Surfaced as a portfolio company of bain-capital-ventures and bloomberg-beta.

companies.name: Grubmarket
companies.description: GrubMarket is a food technology company founded in 2014 that digitally transforms the American food supply chain across the U.S. and Canada. It operates a B2B wholesale eCommerce marketplace connecting buyers to thousands of food products, an AI-powered ERP and warehouse-management software suite (WholesaleWare) for food distributors and growers, and a direct-to-consumer farm-fresh food delivery service. Backed by Battery Ventures, GGV Capital, and Y Combinator, GrubMarket was surfaced as a portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network. As of this enrichment pass GrubMarket publishes no public developer API, API documentation, or developer portal; this profile captures its public web and domain-security posture.

companies.name: Shiplyst
companies.description: Shiplyst is an India-based ocean freight procurement marketplace and supply-chain technology platform that lets exporters and importers search and compare container shipping rates from 50+ ocean carriers in real time, generate instant quotes, book containers with transparent pricing, and track cargo from pickup to delivery. The platform automates Bill of Lading and invoice generation and offers real-time tracking with exception alerts across its web and mobile apps. Shiplyst is backed by 500 Global. No public developer API or documentation surface was found during enrichment.

companies.name: Suplari
companies.description: Suplari is an enterprise procurement intelligence platform that goes beyond spend analytics, using AI to clean, classify, and unify fragmented spend data across ERP, P2P, and spreadsheet sources. It delivers spend analytics, value orchestration, savings tracking, contract intelligence, and ESG intelligence, alongside procurement-specific AI agents (Suplari Worker, Assistant, and AI Studio) that integrate with SAP, Oracle, Workday, Coupa, Databricks, Snowflake, and Microsoft. Suplari was acquired by Microsoft in 2021. As of this enrichment pass the company publishes no public developer API, developer portal, or API documentation surface.

companies.name: Burt
companies.description: Burt builds AI teammates (AI coworkers) for logistics, aimed at freight brokers and forwarders. Its agents automate the repetitive, manual work of daily freight operations — track and trace, quoting, scheduling, carrier booking, document processing, proof-of-delivery chasing, and invoice and data entry — so human operators can focus on customer relationships and growing the business. Burt gives full visibility into every AI action with human oversight and approval workflows, rolls out autonomy gradually, and learns from operator corrections and exceptions to build institutional knowledge over time. Burt is a Y Combinator (Winter 2026) company. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of Y Combinator and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline; Burt does not currently publish a public developer/API surface.

companies.name: Core & Main
companies.description: Core & Main is a leading specialty distributor of water, wastewater, storm drainage, and fire protection products and related services to municipalities, contractors, and engineers across the United States. As a Fortune 500 company, Core & Main operates more than 320 branch locations and provides products and services for water infrastructure, geosynthetics, fusible HDPE pipe, smart metering, fire protection, and erosion control.

companies.name: MWI Veterinary Supply
companies.description: MWI Veterinary Supply, a subsidiary of AmerisourceBergen, is a leading distributor of animal health products to veterinarians across the United States and the United Kingdom, providing pharmaceuticals, vaccines, supplies, diagnostics, and practice management software to veterinary practices.

companies.name: Ordermark
companies.description: Ordermark is a restaurant technology company that consolidates online food delivery and takeout orders from third-party channels such as DoorDash, Uber Eats, Grubhub, and Postmates into a single dashboard and printer, with menu synchronization, order management, and analytics across delivery partners and 250+ POS systems. Ordermark was acquired by and now operates under UrbanPiper; the ordermark.com property is maintained by UrbanPiper. As of this enrichment pass Ordermark publishes no public developer API, developer portal, API documentation, or SDKs on its own surface. It was surfaced to the API Evangelist network as a Techstars portfolio company lead.

companies.name: Plus
companies.description: Plus (PlusAI) develops AI-based autonomous driving technology for commercial trucks. Its flagship SuperDrive is an AI-powered Level 4 autonomous driving system, and HyperFoundry is an integrated development platform for Physical AI. Plus works through partnerships with truck OEMs including TRATON GROUP, Hyundai, and IVECO rather than shipping a public developer API. Backed by GGV Capital, the company was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio lead; this enrichment pass confirmed it exposes no public API, SDK, or developer portal surface, and captured its domain-security posture.

companies.name: Rainmarket
companies.description: Rainmarket is the flagship intelligence platform of Digital Media Nusantara (DMN), built to map and illuminate cross-border trade flows between ASEAN and Hong Kong's Greater Bay Area. It combines three integrated engines — Supply Chain Intelligence, a Tariff Tracker, and a Trade Flows Mapping engine — to turn roughly USD100 billion in previously unmapped or mispriced regional trade activity into investible, financeable, and transparently governed flows. The platform is architected for sovereign-grade deployment, targeting the security, compliance, and resiliency thresholds required by central banks, financial regulators, and national-level intelligence environments, and serves institutional investors, financial institutions, market regulators, and enterprise treasury and supply-chain teams. Rainmarket was surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and profiled in the API Evangelist network. As of this pass the company publishes no public API, developer portal, or machine-readable service surface.

companies.name: Reibus International
companies.description: Reibus International is an Atlanta, Georgia headquartered technology company operating a digital marketplace and open-deck freight logistics platform for the industrial metals industry. Reibus connects buyers and sellers of steel and other industrial metals with a curated network of international and domestic carriers, offering instant freight quotes, automated carrier assignment, and real-time shipment visibility tracking. The Reibus Logistics platform specializes in flatbed, dry van, and dray transportation across the contiguous United States, Canada, and Mexico, plus specialized services including oversized loads, team drivers, expedited shipping, cross-border logistics, high-value freight, and warehousing. Founded by CEO John Blount, Reibus operates across seven countries with business relationships spanning more than 25 nations and is backed by Battery Ventures. Reibus does not currently publish a public developer API, OpenAPI specification, or developer portal; customer-facing tools (instant quote, shipment visibility dashboard) are delivered through the app.reibus.com web application.

companies.name: Thirdwave
companies.description: Thirdwave (Third Wave Automation) builds autonomous material-handling systems for warehouses and distribution centers, led by its shared-autonomy forklift platform where one human operator can supervise a fleet of self-driving forklifts that operate independently and hand control back to a person when needed. Its ArmadaFMS (Armada Fleet Management System) software coordinates the robotic fleet across facilities. The company is a venture-backed logistics-robotics provider (backed by Homebrew and Norwest Venture Partners). As of this enrichment pass Third Wave publishes no public developer API, SDK, developer portal, or machine-readable API surface; this profile captures its identity and public web properties.

companies.name: Trace
companies.description: Trace (tracehq.com) is a workforce planning, headcount management, and procurement platform where companies plan and manage headcount as their most important investment, offering instant workforce analytics and headcount planning. Trace was backed by 500 Global and Uncork Capital, was acquired by Paylocity (now branded "TraceHQ, A Paylocity Company"), and the standalone Trace app is being sunset in early 2026 as the product folds into Paylocity for Finance headcount planning. Trace publishes no public developer portal, API documentation, or SDKs.

companies.name: Universal Corporation
companies.description: Universal Corporation is a global leaf tobacco merchant and processor that selects, buys, processes, packs, stores, ships, and finances leaf tobacco for sale to manufacturers of consumer tobacco products. Operating in approximately 30 countries, Universal Corporation is the world's leading supplier of leaf tobacco, providing supply chain management, processing, and blending services. The company has developed digital platforms including MobiLeaf, a tablet-based grower management system for tobacco farmer support and crop tracking.

companies.name: Veluga
companies.description: Veluga (Veluga Brewery Inc.) is a South Korean B2B alcohol wholesale distribution platform that connects hospitality business owners with liquor suppliers. Operating from Mapo, Seoul, the company runs a wholesale marketplace offering real-time wholesale pricing quotes for spirits and craft beverages, product recommendations for business owners, wholesale order facilitation, and partnership programs for distributors and catering services. Veluga positions itself as a transaction and information intermediary rather than a direct seller. The company began as a craft-beer and snack subscription service and is backed by 500 Global, Kakao Ventures, SparkLabs, HL Holdings, and Sema Investment. No public developer API, SDK, or developer portal is currently published; this profile captures the company identity for the API Evangelist network.

companies.name: Wheelocity
companies.description: Wheelocity (Wheelocity Fresh Private Limited) is a Bangalore, India based logistics and supply-chain company building daily fresh-produce and grocery delivery networks for underserved rural markets across India, which it frames as "the access rails for Bharat commerce." Its phygital (online plus offline) model combines location intelligence, IoT hardware, cold-chain and predictive demand forecasting with an electric-vehicle first-mile and last-mile fleet and a consumer app branded WoW. The company reports serving more than one million households, running over 100,000 km of EV movement daily and avoiding tens of thousands of kilograms of produce waste each day. Wheelocity is a venture-backed operating company (Lightspeed Venture Partners portfolio) and, as of this profile, publishes no public developer portal, API documentation, or SDKs.

companies.name: Whitespace
companies.description: Whitespace is an AI operating system for wholesale distributors, based in London and part of Y Combinator's Summer 2026 batch. The platform connects to a distributor's existing business systems (ERPs such as SAP, NetSuite, Epicor, Infor, Microsoft Dynamics and Sage, plus Salesforce, HubSpot, QuickBooks, Gmail and Outlook) to build a model of operations, then deploys self-improving AI agents that automate demand forecasting, inventory replenishment, order entry, quote generation, customer query responses, and accounts payable and receivable. It targets sectors including industrial supplies, electrical, plumbing, HVAC, building materials, foodservice, consumer goods and textiles. Founded by Alex Tung and Leon Yao. As an early-stage company it currently ships a product but publishes no public API, developer documentation or SDK.

companies.name: COSCO Shipping
companies.description: A Chinese state-owned multinational shipping and logistics conglomerate and the world's largest container shipping fleet by capacity. Operates container shipping, port terminals, bulk cargo services, and digital supply chain platforms (Syncon Hub, My Reefer, Hi-Dolphin) across global trade routes.

companies.name: Watsco
companies.description: Watsco, Inc. is the world's largest distributor of air conditioning, heating, and refrigeration (HVAC/R) equipment and related products. Operating through subsidiaries including Carrier Enterprise, Baker Distributing, Gemaire Distributors, and East Coast Metal Distributors, Watsco serves contractors and dealers across more than 670 locations in the US, Canada, Mexico, and the Caribbean. The company has undergone significant digital transformation, running a unified B2B e-commerce platform powered by Magento Commerce and a centralized PIM system covering approximately 900,000 SKUs.

companies.name: Logixboard
companies.description: Logixboard provides a unified, white-labeled customer experience platform for freight forwarders and logistics service providers, letting their customers book, track, quote, and manage shipments across ocean, air, FTL/LTL, customs, and warehousing from a single branded portal. It ingests and normalizes shipment data from TMS and WMS systems (CargoWise, Descartes, homegrown systems) via private API, file drop (FTP/SFTP), and database sync, so providers can differentiate on digital visibility. Logixboard exposes no public developer API; integrations are delivered as bespoke, provider-scoped data connections. Added to the API Evangelist network from the venture portfolios of Insight Partners, Redpoint Ventures, and Techstars.

companies.name: Nomagic
companies.description: Nomagic builds Physical AI for end-to-end warehouse automation, using AI-powered robotic arms and computer vision to automate picking, packing, sorting and other fulfillment tasks across e-commerce, fashion, pharmaceutical and third-party logistics warehouses. Nomagic exposes a standard Station API for systems integrators, WCS/WMS providers and customers to control its robots, and a Grip AI API that adds an intelligence layer to third-party robot hardware; all robot actions are recorded to the Nomagic Cloud to continually improve its models. The company is backed by Khosla Ventures. Public developer documentation for these APIs is not published; integration is arranged directly with Nomagic.

companies.name: Pickle Robot
companies.description: Pickle Robot builds Physical AI systems for supply chain automation, best known for autonomous truck- and container-unloading robots that handle non-palletized, floor-loaded freight. Its Dill Autonomy Engine (DAE) pairs classical optimal control with generative AI and foundation models, driving an industrial arm with vision, LiDAR, and an air-suction gripper to unload 400-1,500 cases per hour. Founded in 2018 and headquartered in the Boston, Massachusetts area, the company deploys into existing warehouses in days with no WMS integration and counts UPS among its customers. Pickle Robot exposes no public developer API; this profile captures its identity, domain-security posture, and public web properties in the API Evangelist network.

companies.name: Sereact
companies.description: Sereact GmbH is a Stuttgart, Germany based physical-AI company building intelligent robotic systems for warehouse and fulfillment automation. Its "Cortex" platform pairs a Vision Language Action Model (VLAM) with robot control so robots can pick, place, sort, induct, and inspect diverse items in production without task-specific retraining, running across 50+ deployments in Europe and the US. Products include Pick-and-Place, Putwall, Induction, Bin Handling, Returns Handling, and the Lens perception system. Backed by Creandum and Point Nine; announced a $110M Series B. Sereact does not currently publish a public developer API, OpenAPI, or documentation surface — an internal api.sereact.ai host exists but is a placeholder. This profile captures the company identity and public web/GitHub surface.

companies.name: SilverRail
companies.description: SilverRail Technologies is a rail technology company that powers global rail ecommerce and distribution. Its platform spans journey planning, ticketing, and onboard information, aiming to transform the rail experience for travelers while making rail retail easier and more profitable for operators, travel agencies, and distributors. SilverRail connects rail carriers and sellers so rail inventory can be searched, booked, and ticketed across markets. The company was surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of Accel and Canaan Partners. As of this enrichment pass SilverRail runs a corporate marketing site (Next.js) but publishes no public developer portal, API reference, OpenAPI specification, SDKs, or /.well-known discovery documents; its API and distribution capabilities appear to be delivered through partner/enterprise integration rather than a self-serve public API.

companies.name: Zauber
companies.description: Zauber is an AI agent platform purpose-built for sea and air freight forwarding operations. Freight forwarders describe their processes in plain language and Zauber's AI agents execute them consistently across global operations, automating rate and booking workflows with exception handling, deploying global workflows with local execution, and giving operators real-time operational visibility into conversion rates, response times, and exception patterns. The platform integrates with existing systems including Office 365, CargoWise One, carrier portals, and proprietary tooling. Zauber is a portfolio company of Point Nine. No public API, developer portal, or developer documentation is currently published; this profile captures the company's identity and security posture.

companies.name: APX
companies.description: APX (APX Logistics Solutions) is a Southeast Asian less-than-truckload (LTL) digital logistics platform headquartered in Bangkok, with operations in Thailand, Malaysia, and Singapore. It positions itself as the region's first LTL digital logistics provider, offering domestic and cross-border shipping, international sea and air freight, customs brokerage, warehousing and distribution, project logistics, and heavy-lift/breakbulk services. Its proprietary technology platform provides online shipment booking, real-time tracking with ETA notifications, digital proof-of-delivery, AI-assisted route optimization, a driver app, and analytics dashboards including CO2/ESG reporting. APX is a portfolio company of 500 Global and was added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment. As of this enrichment pass APX publishes no first-party public developer API, SDKs, or developer portal; shipment tracking is currently integrable only via third-party aggregators.

companies.name: Dexory
companies.description: Dexory is a UK-based warehouse intelligence and robotics company whose DexoryView platform pairs fleets of autonomous mobile scanning robots with physical AI to deliver real-time "ground truth" visibility across warehouses and distribution centers. The robots autonomously scan more than 10,000 pallet locations per hour and up to 18 meters of racking height, building a live digital twin that feeds AI-driven analytics for inventory accuracy, space and slotting optimization, damage/compliance detection, and operational performance. DexoryView is organized into modules (Integrity for stock accuracy and automated cycle counts, Optimise for space and productivity analytics, and Adapt for real-time operational response) and connects into existing warehouse and ERP systems such as SAP EWM, Manhattan, Blue Yonder, and Körber through pre-built connectors. Dexory serves 3PL logistics, manufacturing, food & beverage, retail, pharma, and air cargo operators. Added to the API Evangelist network from Atomico's portfolio and enriched via the pipeline; Dexory does not currently publish a public developer portal or OpenAPI.

companies.name: Transfix
companies.description: Transfix is a New York-based freight technology company that, since divesting its brokerage operation to NFI Industries in June 2024, operates as a SaaS and data company providing AI-powered Transportation Management System (TMS) software to freight brokers, third-party logistics providers (3PLs), shippers, and carriers across the United States. The Transfix TMS unifies pricing, planning, execution, and billing in a single platform, with feature areas covering Smart Pricing and Quoting, RFP Management and Collaboration, Coverage and Carrier Management, Streamlined Scheduling, Operations and Automation, Invoicing and Payments, and Reporting and Insights. Core AI capabilities include the Custom Rate Prediction Suite for spot and contract pricing across Dry Van, Reefer, and Flatbed equipment, and the RFP Workflow with a Smart Upload feature that structures bid data from heterogeneous file formats. Transfix markets integrations with existing TMS, carrier networks, and data sources, and references freight API integrations in marketing material, but does not publish a public developer portal, API reference, OpenAPI specification, SDKs, or open-source repositories. NFI Industries is the platform's anchor third-party customer following the brokerage divestiture.

companies.name: Werner Enterprises
companies.description: Werner Enterprises is a leading transportation and logistics company providing truckload transportation services, logistics solutions, and supply chain management throughout North America. Founded in 1956 and headquartered in Omaha, Nebraska, Werner operates one of the largest fleets in the United States and offers freight brokerage, dedicated carriage, intermodal, and final-mile delivery services through its Werner Bridge℠ digital freight platform.

companies.name: Whole Surplus
companies.description: Whole Surplus (now operating as Fazla) is a Turkish technology-based waste management and circular-economy company backed by Techstars. It prevents waste at its source and recovers surplus products back into the circular economy with maximum environmental, social, and economic benefit across the entire supply chain from producers to consumers. Its platform combines an AI-powered analysis tool that identifies the optimal recovery path for each product with services including Fazla Market (discounted resale), donations to food banks, animal-feed conversion, recycling, a smart-scale detection system, and sustainability consultancy. Fazla is the first B Corp certified waste-management company in Turkey and is supported by the UN Development Programme (UNDP). The company operates a customer web application (app.fazla.com) but publishes no public API, developer portal, SDKs, or machine-readable specification at this time.

companies.name: Canadian National Railway
companies.description: Canadian National Railway (CN) is the largest railway network in Canada and one of the largest in North America spanning over 20,000 route miles. CN transports goods across an integrated network linking the Atlantic and Pacific coasts with the Gulf of Mexico. CN offers shipper APIs, EDI integration, the eBusiness portal, and the CN ONE mobile app for shipment tracking, ordering, billing, and rate management.

companies.name: DealerSocket
companies.description: DealerSocket is an automotive dealership CRM and Dealer Management System (DMS) software platform for franchise and independent auto dealers, covering customer relationship management, inventory management, websites, digital marketing, and desking/deals. DealerSocket is a Solera company (acquired 2021; part of Solera's Vehicle Solutions line of business). DealerSocket exposes a set of inbound and outbound integration APIs - lead forwarding, deal push to the DMS, customer updates, activity and CTI/call logging - but access is not self-serve. It is delivered through DealerSocket's Certified Partners program (launched 2013, 500-plus integration points) and is application-, contract-, and certification-gated. There is no public developer portal, no published authentication reference, and no public endpoint or base-URL documentation; the logical APIs below are modeled from DealerSocket's public integrations page rather than a self-serve API reference.

companies.name: Fetch Robotics
companies.description: Fetch Robotics is a provider of autonomous mobile robots (AMRs) for the manufacturing, distribution, and fulfillment industries, enabling customers to optimize warehouse and material-handling workflows through robotic automation. Its Fetch and Freight robots are programmed through a ROS (Robot Operating System) interface — standard ROS topics, services, and actions conforming to ROS Enhancement Proposals (REPs) — rather than an HTTP/REST API, and the first-party client, driver, and simulation libraries are published as open source in the fetchrobotics GitHub organization. Fetch Robotics was acquired by Zebra Technologies in August 2021 for approximately $290M; fetchrobotics.com now redirects to Zebra and the autonomous-mobile-robot product line is being wound down (2025-2026), though the open-source ROS packages remain available.

companies.name: ISAAC Instruments
companies.description: ISAAC Instruments is a Canadian provider of in-cab technology and fleet management for the trucking industry - electronic logging devices (ELD), telematics, hours-of-service (HOS) compliance, driver workflow, messaging, and fuel/performance analytics, delivered as a fully managed hardware-plus-software platform. ISAAC runs an "Open Platform" with a documented API that lets fleets and 80+ integration partners (TMS/dispatch, maintenance, fuel tax, visibility, safety/compliance) share ISAAC data with their chosen vendors. API access is partner-gated - vendors apply through the ISAAC partner program and the full API Guide and reference live behind the ISAAC InRealTime portal and Client Center rather than on a public developer site. The API surface documented here is modeled from ISAAC's public platform and partner materials; exact endpoints, base URLs, and authentication are provisioned to approved partners.

companies.name: Captain's Eye
companies.description: Captain's Eye is a Haifa, Israel-based maritime AI company (founded 2020 by Uri Ben Dor and Doron Oizerovich, backed by Techstars) that delivers real-time video analytics software for maritime and industrial safety. Its SaaS platform connects to existing CCTV cameras, radar, and thermal sensors aboard merchant vessels, yachts, cruise ships, ports, and on-land petrochemical and energy sites, applying custom neural networks and commercial AI models to detect fires, smoke, leaks, sea pollution, missing protective gear, unauthorized access, and equipment failures. It provides real-time alerts, remote monitoring, incident documentation, and operational data collection, monitoring 5,000+ cameras and having detected 100,000+ events. Access is delivered through a private web application and mobile apps rather than a public developer API.

companies.name: Jeh Aerospace
companies.description: Jeh Aerospace is a precision aerospace manufacturing company building "future factories" across the US-India corridor to supply aerostructures and aero-engine components for the commercial aerospace supply chain. From certified facilities in India spanning more than 160,000 square feet, Jeh delivers machining, sheet metal, tubes and pipes, surface treatment, structural assembly, and engineering services on time and at scale. The company is fully compliant with AS9100, ISO 9001, OEM requirements, and export regulations, and weaves a digital thread across its supplier networks for radical transparency. Jeh operates from both the US and India and is backed by General Catalyst and IndiGo Ventures.

companies.name: payflows
companies.description: Payflows is an AI-native financial operations platform that unifies procurement, treasury, and accounting into one agentic workspace for finance teams. Its product suites span Apollo (procurement from purchase request to receipt), Vera (vendor and contract management), Athena (accounting and AP automation from AP to tax reporting), and Metis (treasury from payment to bank reconciliation), with spend analytics, cashflow forecasting, global payments, and risk management. Payflows integrates with major ERP, banking, payment, and expense systems. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Balderton Capital and Ribbit Capital and added to the API Evangelist network.

companies.name: AI Fleet
companies.description: Aifleet (aifleet.com) is a technology-driven, full-stack trucking carrier founded in 2020 and headquartered in Austin, Texas. The company describes itself as the first full-stack, AI-driven carrier, pairing company drivers with proprietary AI algorithms and its own Transportation Management System (TMS) to optimize truck utilization, routing, load matching, fuel usage, and scheduling across the roughly $400B U.S. freight sector. Aifleet emphasizes a driver-centric model — better pay, predictable schedules, and reduced wait times — alongside shipper-facing services with proactive tracking updates and predictive ETAs. It has raised roughly $50M since founding (Series A 2021, venture round 2023, Series B 2024) from investors including Obvious Ventures, Ibex Investors, Volvo Group Venture Capital, Compound, and Heron Rock. Aifleet is a logistics service provider rather than a developer-facing API platform; as of this profile it publishes no public API, developer portal, SDKs, or OpenAPI definition.

companies.name: Aiperia
companies.description: Aiperia (formerly PlanerAI) is a German AI company whose SaaS platform automates demand forecasting and fresh-food supply-chain planning from production through to the end consumer. Its machine-learning models predict fresh-food demand up to 21 days ahead using around 150 external factors, then generate automated order and production suggestions for bakeries and self-service stations, food manufacturers, and supermarkets to reduce food waste and overproduction. Aiperia is a portfolio company of Earlybird Venture Capital.

companies.name: Aruna
companies.description: Aruna is Indonesia's largest integrated fisheries commerce platform, on a mission to make the sea a better livelihood for all by building a fair and sustainable fisheries ecosystem. Aruna connects more than 40,000 small-scale fishermen to domestic and global markets using technology, a network of processing partners, and 177+ distribution hubs (Aruna Hubs) across the Indonesian archipelago, trading 23+ seafood commodity types into 31+ countries. The company pairs commerce with sustainability work, including fisherman education, fish-population tracking, and coastal-community empowerment. Aruna is a portfolio company of Prosus Ventures and was added to the API Evangelist network as a company lead; it publishes no public API, developer portal, or machine-readable API surface at this time.

companies.name: Bizongo
companies.description: Bizongo is a Mumbai-based B2B commerce and supply-chain platform founded in 2015 that digitizes procurement, vendor management, and supply-chain financing for enterprises across India, with a focus on packaging, raw materials, and made-to-order goods. It operates a SaaS-led vendor digitization stack plus an embedded-finance offering, connecting large buyers with a network of manufacturing partners. Bizongo is backed by Accel, Chiratae Ventures, B Capital, and others. It was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio-lead stub; as of this enrichment pass Bizongo publishes no public developer portal, API reference, OpenAPI definition, or /.well-known discovery surface — third-party logistics integration is offered only through carrier aggregators such as ClickPost, so most API-artifact scoring dimensions are not applicable.

companies.name: Dryft
companies.description: Dryft, Inc. is a Palo Alto, California startup building an AI operating system for manufacturing operations. The platform pairs context-aware, agent-based intelligence with mathematical optimization to mimic, optimize, and automate complex human decisions across the shop floor and supply chain. Dryft reads operational data from existing ERPs and inventory systems, identifies issues such as late items or stockouts, and autonomously recommends and executes actions like adjusting order quantities and safety stocks or following up with suppliers. The company frames this as a shift from static Enterprise Resource Planning to Enterprise Resource Automation, freeing planners to focus on strategy over administrative work. Founded in 2024 by CEO Anna-Julia Storch and CTO Leonie Freisinger, Dryft raised a $5M round led by General Catalyst with participation from Neo and Sandberg Bernthal Venture Partners. Dryft does not currently publish a public developer API, SDKs, or documentation; this profile captures its company identity in the API Evangelist network.

companies.name: Fernride
companies.description: FERNRIDE (FERNRIDE GmbH) is a Munich, Germany based ground-autonomy company delivering human-assisted autonomous driving for logistics. Its platform automates electric and diesel trucks and terminal tractors across container terminals, yard operations, manufacturing supply, defence logistics, and open-road trucking, pairing on-vehicle autonomy with remote human oversight (teleoperation) for reliability at scale. A centralized Management Suite lets fleet managers monitor and control the autonomous fleet and integrates with existing terminal operating systems (TOS) and yard management systems (YMS). Customers and partners have included DB Schenker, Volkswagen, HHLA, and NVIDIA. FERNRIDE was acquired by Quantum Systems in December 2025. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of Speedinvest; the company exposes no public developer portal, API, or documentation surface at the time of enrichment.

companies.name: McKesson
companies.description: McKesson is a Fortune 500 healthcare company providing wholesale medical supplies and equipment, pharmaceutical distribution, and healthcare technology solutions. No public developer APIs are currently documented.

companies.name: Ofbusiness
companies.description: OfBusiness is one of India's largest B2B raw-materials procurement and credit platforms, serving more than two million SMEs and corporates. It operates as an aggregator, manufacturer, and importer/exporter across supply chains including steel, aluminium, chemicals, polymers, and agriculture, pairing live commodity pricing, quotations, and order tracking with working-capital credit through its NBFC arm Oxyzo. Related brands include BidAssist (government tender and procurement intelligence), SMEAssist, and Ved AI. The company is backed by Norwest Venture Partners and the SoftBank Vision Fund. OfBusiness reaches customers primarily through its website and iOS/Android mobile apps; no public developer API or API documentation was found during enrichment.

companies.name: PitchMe
companies.description: PitchMe is a recruitment data intelligence platform that enriches, verifies, and deduplicates candidate records to turn an existing ATS or CRM database into an activated talent pool. It cleans and appends verified contact details, employment history, and skills data, then surfaces career-intelligence signals that power AI-driven sourcing and outreach. PitchMe connects to applicant tracking systems such as Bullhorn, Greenhouse, Salesforce, Lever, JobDiva, Vincere, Avionte, Jobvite, and Ashby via native and certified integrations, plus a custom API for connecting any ATS or recruitment platform. Backed by Techstars.

companies.name: TruckLabs
companies.description: TruckLabs built TruckWings, an automated tractor-mounted aerodynamic device that closes the gap between the tractor and trailer to reduce aerodynamic drag, cutting fuel consumption by a proven 3-6% and eliminating roughly 7-10 metric tons of CO2 per truck each year with an 18-24 month payback. The device deploys automatically at highway speed and retracts below it, reduces buffeting and trailer sway in crosswinds, and installs on both new builds and retrofits in about two hours. TruckLabs was acquired by ConMet, and trucklabs.com now redirects to the ConMet TruckWings product line. As a hardware fuel-efficiency company, TruckLabs exposes no public developer API, SDK, or well-known discovery surface; this profile captures its identity and probed domain-security posture. Backed by Uncork Capital.

companies.name: Wise Systems
companies.description: Wise Systems provides autonomous routing and last-mile delivery optimization software powered by machine learning. Its platform helps fleet operators plan strategy, optimize and dynamically re-route deliveries, dispatch in real time, track driver performance, and improve last-mile efficiency across industries including auto parts, beverage, building materials, container management, field service, food service, healthcare, linen services, parcel/courier, and retail. Wise Systems exposes an internal "Engine API" during customer implementations to connect data inputs and outputs, but publishes no public developer portal, API reference, or SDKs. Backed by Techstars and headquartered in Cambridge, Massachusetts.

companies.name: Torchdental
companies.description: Torchdental (Torch Dental) is a B2B dental-supply procurement platform for independent dental practices and dental groups. It runs a web application at app.torchdental.com that lets practices order dental supplies and equipment from multiple vendors in one place, compare prices, manage recurring ordering and budgets, and streamline back-office purchasing. The company is venture backed and was surfaced as a portfolio company of Felicis. As of this enrichment pass Torchdental exposes no public developer/API surface: no api/docs/developer subdomains resolve, and the application host publishes no /.well-known/ discovery documents. This profile therefore captures company identity and probed domain-security posture only.

companies.name: BuyBuddy
companies.description: BuyBuddy is an AI-powered retail merchandising platform positioned as an "AI Merchandiser that tracks, thinks & acts for you." It automates in-store operations for retailers and brands, including planogram compliance and shelf monitoring via computer vision, stockout prevention, product placement optimization, dynamic pricing and promotions, demand forecasting, store transfers, and shopper-behavior analysis through smart tags. BuyBuddy is a portfolio company of 500 Global. This profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network; at time of enrichment BuyBuddy publishes no public developer API, documentation, SDK, or specification surface, so this remains a company-level profile.

companies.name: Warehousing1
companies.description: Warehousing1 is a Berlin-based LogTech company, founded in 2018 by Nico Szeli, Nils Aschmann and Fabian Sedlmayr, that operates a digital fulfillment and warehousing marketplace connecting brands and e-commerce merchants to an independent network of more than 1,000 logistics locations across Germany, Europe and the US. Its cloud platform and customer portal centralize warehousing, order picking, packing and shipping, and integrate with common ERP systems, online shops and marketplaces so companies can scale contract logistics, distribution and e-commerce fulfillment. The company has served 500+ customers and is backed by HV Capital, Schenker Ventures, Aster Capital and Wille Finance. Warehousing1 does not publish a public developer API; integration is delivered through managed ERP/shop connectors and its customer portal.

companies.name: DNOW
companies.description: DNOW Inc. (NYSE: DNOW), formerly NOW Inc. and operating as DistributionNOW, is a Houston-headquartered Fortune 1000 distributor of pipe, valves, fittings (PVF), pumps and packaged, engineered process and production equipment serving the upstream, midstream, downstream energy, and industrial sectors. Spun off from National Oilwell Varco in 2014 and built on a heritage that spans more than 160 years, DNOW combines a global network of distribution branches and engineering facilities with the DigitalNOW platform — shop.dnow.com B2B eCommerce, cXML/OCI ERP punchout integrations, the eSpec product configurator, the AccessNOW automated inventory control system, and a library of customer-facing mobile applications. DNOW does not publish a public developer portal, OpenAPI specifications, or a self-serve API program; customer integrations are delivered through configured cXML/OCI punchout sessions tied to enterprise ERP systems. In June 2025 DNOW announced a definitive merger agreement to acquire MRC Global in an all-stock transaction valued at approximately $1.5 billion.

companies.name: Flycrates
companies.description: Flycrates is an international shipping service, founded in 2015 and headquartered in San Francisco, that lets shoppers outside the United States buy US Amazon.com Prime items and have them delivered worldwide. Instead of filling an Amazon cart, customers fill a fixed-size crate (small, medium, or large); Flycrates then purchases the items, consolidates them, clears customs, and pays import duty and tax on the buyer's behalf before shipping via DHL, FedEx, or UPS to more than 117 countries. It also offers a Chrome browser extension that adds "Add to Flycrates" buttons directly onto Amazon product pages. Flycrates raised a seed round led by 500 Global. As of this enrichment pass the company operates a consumer web application only and exposes no public API, developer portal, or partner integration program.

companies.name: MSC Industrial Direct
companies.description: MSC Industrial Direct is one of the largest industrial product distributors in North America, providing metalworking, maintenance, repair, and operations products and services to manufacturers.

companies.name: Pax
companies.description: Pax (Pax AI) is a San Francisco-based artificial intelligence company that automates U.S. duty drawback claims, letting importers, retailers, and manufacturers reclaim overpaid tariffs and import duties. Branding itself the "AI Broker for Tariff Refunds" and "TurboTax for import duty rebate," Pax uses proprietary AI to automate data extraction, validation, transaction matching, refund calculation, and electronic claim submission to U.S. Customs and Border Protection with minimal manual effort. Founded by former duty-drawback experts and engineers from Charter Brokerage, MIT, Amazon, Flexport, and Brex, Pax is backed by Y Combinator, Initialized Capital, General Catalyst, Flexport, Soma Capital, Basis Set Ventures, and others. This profile was enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline.

companies.name: Procuri
companies.description: Procuri (procuri.ai) presents itself as an AI-powered procurement automation platform that uses specialized AI agents to discover and vet suppliers, optimize contract negotiation and pricing, monitor policy and regulatory compliance, and assess supplier and market risk for enterprise procurement teams. It was surfaced as a portfolio-lead stub of insight-partners and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment; as of this pass the public site publishes no developer/API surface (no docs, developer, API-reference, or OpenAPI pages resolve).

companies.name: sento
companies.description: sento is a Munich-based B2B software company (sento GmbH) building a cloud-based EDI (Electronic Data Interchange) platform that automates complex business-partner processes, letting companies replace slow, manual partner-integration workflows with automated document and data exchange. Founded by Nimar Blume and Felix Krauth and backed by Insight Partners, sento raised a EUR 9 million seed round to expand its partner-onboarding and document-automation product. As of this profile sento does not publish a public developer API, developer portal, or API documentation - only its corporate marketing site and legal pages are publicly available.

companies.name: Shippio
companies.description: Shippio is a Japanese logistics-technology company positioning itself as "Japan's first digital forwarder." It provides cloud-based SaaS for visualizing and streamlining international trade and freight-forwarding operations, combining domain expertise with AI-era digital technology. Its product line includes Shippio Forwarding (a digital forwarding service), Shippio Cargo (trade-management SaaS for shippers/importers-exporters), and Shippio Works (trade-management SaaS for logistics operators), delivered through a multi-sided platform that connects shippers and operators. The company is backed by 500 Global. As of this enrichment pass Shippio publishes no public developer portal, API documentation, SDKs, or pricing; its APIs are internal platform APIs referenced only in engineering job postings, so this profile is identity-only with no public API surface.

companies.name: yesmro
companies.description: YESMRO (易买工品), operated by Shanghai Sheti Information Technology Co., Ltd. and founded in April 2016, is a self-operated Chinese B2B e-commerce platform for MRO (maintenance, repair and operations) and factory-automation parts. It carries millions of SKUs across mechanical components, industrial control (PLCs, HMIs, servos, drives), sensors, low-voltage electrical, pneumatics, tools, safety and factory consumables from 800+ brands, targeting the small and medium-sized end factories that make up the long tail of industrial demand. The company runs automated (AGV) warehouses in Shanghai, Hefei and Dongguan and 10+ regional offices, and in 2020 launched an open platform for upstream suppliers. It is backed by Qiming Venture Partners, Matrix Partners China and Sequoia Capital China. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of Qiming; no public developer API, open-platform docs, or specification surface was found during enrichment.

companies.name: Ratify
companies.description: Ratify is a CNCF Sandbox open-source verification framework for container images and other supply chain artifacts in Kubernetes environments. It enables policy-driven artifact ratification by coordinating any number of pluggable verifiers (signatures, SBOMs, scan results, attestations) against a given policy, integrating with Kubernetes admission webhooks via the Gatekeeper policy engine. Ratify is developed by the ratify-project GitHub organization (originally a Microsoft open-source project), written in Go, and distributed as a CLI tool, Go library, and Kubernetes admission webhook server. It supports OCI-compliant artifact stores including Azure Container Registry, Amazon ECR, and Docker Hub. Ratify exposes an internal HTTP verification API (v2alpha1) consumed by its webhook server but does not publish a public-facing REST API or OpenAPI specification.

companies.name: CarbonChain
companies.description: CarbonChain is a London- and New York-based carbon accounting platform founded in 2019 that is purpose-built for the highest-emitting, hardest-to- track commodity supply chains — metals and mining, energy, manufacturing, and agriculture. Its AI-assisted platform builds asset- and transaction- level emissions pictures using activity-based emission factors, and packages those calculations into modules for supply-chain emissions, corporate carbon footprints (Scope 1, 2, 3), product carbon footprints, scenario analysis, and regulatory compliance. The flagship CarbonChain Comply release ships a Carbon Reporting Hub aligned with EU CSRD, UK SECR, US SEC, and CDP, along with EU/UK CBAM declaration validation, automated CBAM XML generation, and a Supplier Engagement Module for collecting and validating supplier emissions data. CarbonChain Connect links producers and importers through shared installation-level CBAM infrastructure. The company is a CDP Accredited Provider (2024), is ISO 27001 certified, and is backed by Y Combinator, Union Square Ventures, Voyager VC, and Aera VC, with $10M Series A funding (2023). CarbonChain serves manufacturers, commodity traders, banks, and procurement teams, and offers system-to-system API integration for delivering activity data in and pulling gold-standard emissions calculations out — but it does not publish a public developer portal, OpenAPI specification, SDK, or open-source client library. API access is offered as part of customer integration projects rather than as a self-serve developer surface.

companies.name: Haladir
companies.description: Haladir is a Y Combinator-backed startup building a decisional AI platform for logistics operations. Describing itself as "the decisional AI layer for logistics," Haladir unifies fragmented operational data from existing warehouse management (WMS), transportation management (TMS), and order management (OMS) systems into a single operational graph, then applies constraint-optimization solvers and machine-learning models to automate supply chain decisions across routing, picking, labor allocation, and inventory. Its approach treats large language models as formalization tools that translate messy operational rules into precise constraints for traditional solvers, rather than as decision-makers. Target customers include third-party logistics providers (3PLs), contract logistics providers, distributors, and shippers managing global supply chains. The company has raised $4.3M in seed funding led by BoxGroup and Susa Ventures. This profile currently exposes no public API or developer documentation; it is tracked in the API Evangelist network as a company profile.

companies.name: JD Logistics
companies.description: JD Logistics (Hong Kong listed as 2618.HK) is a technology-driven supply chain and logistics service provider spun out of JD.com and backed by the SoftBank Vision Fund. It operates one of China's largest integrated logistics networks, offering express and freight delivery, integrated warehouse-and-fulfillment, cold-chain and pharmaceutical logistics, cross-border shipping, oversized-item handling, and smart supply-chain technology. Through its JD Logistics Open Platform (open.jdl.com) it exposes enterprise integration services for order fulfillment, warehousing, waybill/shipment creation, tracking, and reconciliation to merchants and partners. This profile tracks the company's public developer and open-platform surface in the API Evangelist network.

companies.name: Manufactured
companies.description: Manufactured is a supply-chain and production platform for hardware and consumer-product brands, backed by Bullpen Capital. Its web application (app.manufactured.com) helps teams run overseas production end to end — issuing sourcing requests to vendors, managing supplier and vendor profiles, negotiating order estimates and contracts under master procurement agreements, tracking production timelines and calendars, and financing purchase orders through production and repayment terms. The product also embeds an AI assistant built on LangChain. At the time of enrichment the public marketing site and the api/docs/developer subdomains were unreachable, and the GraphQL, Lambda and bot backends are private and authentication-gated (introspection blocked), so no public API specification, developer portal, or documentation could be harvested. This profile captures the real, observable surface only.

companies.name: Quickshipper
companies.description: QuickShipper is a last-mile delivery and fleet management SaaS platform that helps businesses manage order fulfillment and deliveries. It provides route optimization, order batching, automated or manual dispatching, a courier mobile app, real-time tracking, branded customer notifications, and business analytics. Companies can operate their own fleet or connect with third-party courier providers, and can sync orders automatically through API integration and WooCommerce/WordPress plugins. Surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and added to the API Evangelist network.

companies.name: Alchemize
companies.description: Alchemize is an AI-enabled customs brokerage that automates import compliance workflows for importers. The Y Combinator (Spring 2026) company pairs licensed customs expertise with artificial intelligence to answer regulatory and tariff questions in minutes rather than days, reduce manual data-entry errors before shipments reach the port, and give importers a single view of every shipment, status, and communication via API, EDI, or web portal. Founded by Robert Hou (previously Confido, YC) and Samuel Fu (previously Netflix), Alchemize targets inefficiency in the $30B+ customs brokerage industry with an AI-native compliance and trade-operations platform.

companies.name: ElasticRun
companies.description: ElasticRun (legally NTEx Transportation Services Pvt Ltd) is a Pune, India based B2B e-commerce and rural logistics platform founded in 2016 by Sandeep Deshmukh, Saurabh Nigam and Shitiz Bansal. It operates an aggregated, variable-capacity transportation network that stitches together idle logistics capacity to connect FMCG brands and manufacturers to the mom-and-pop kirana stores of rural and semi-urban India. The platform blends mobile technology with local entrepreneurs to run an assisted-commerce model spanning 125,000+ kiranas and 80,000+ villages across 26 states, offering last-mile delivery, B2B distribution and supply-chain services. ElasticRun is backed by Prosus Ventures and SoftBank Vision Fund. This profile is a network stub: no public developer API, documentation or SDKs were found during enrichment.

companies.name: Inventa
companies.description: Inventa is a Brazilian B2B commerce platform — a "B2B commerce cloud" — that integrates technology, credit, and logistics on a single platform so brands and distributors can scale wholesale sales in Brazil. Its products include a sales platform that syncs catalogs, orders, inventory, and prices across B2B e-commerce sites and marketplaces via ERP integrations; a field-sales mobile app for sellers; automated credit analysis and approval; shared distribution-center logistics (OMS/WMS/TMS) with fulfillment and 72-hour delivery in the São Paulo region; multichannel customer support; and business-intelligence dashboards. Solution packages span Fulfillment, Response, FullService, and a pay-per-use OnDemand model. The company is headquartered in São Paulo. Inventa configures the API and connector integrations for its customers rather than publishing a public developer portal, so it has no public API artifacts as of this enrichment pass.

companies.name: Nimble Robotics
companies.description: Nimble Robotics (Nimble) is an autonomous robotic third-party logistics (3PL) company building AI-powered robots that pick, pack, and fulfill ecommerce orders with minimal human intervention. Founded by Simon Kalouche, the company operates fully autonomous robotic fulfillment centers and is training general-purpose robot AI to power fast, economical commerce. Backed by Accel and partnered with FedEx, Nimble raised a $106M Series C at a $1B valuation, with board member Marc Raibert (Boston Dynamics founder). Nimble is a physical robotics and logistics operator and does not currently publish a public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface.

companies.name: Seedsight
companies.description: Seedsight is a Porto, Portugal and Delaware, USA based agri-food technology company applying artificial intelligence and optical sensing to the cereal and grain value chain. Its platform helps farmers, traders, millers, and food processors make smarter, faster, and safer decisions through contaminant and safety screening, biological-fingerprinting traceability for origin and variety identification, Flour Extraction Rate yield prediction, and Flour Rheology quality prediction. Backed by Techstars, Seedsight raised roughly EUR 1.78M to reduce agri-food waste. At present the company exposes no public developer API, SDK, or developer portal; this profile tracks its identity and domain security posture in the API Evangelist network.

companies.name: Waabi
companies.description: Waabi is a Toronto-based artificial intelligence company founded in 2021 by Raquel Urtasun, pioneering Physical AI for autonomous driving and starting with self-driving trucks. Its flagship product, the Waabi Driver, pairs a generative-AI, end-to-end interpretable and verifiable autonomy stack with sensors and compute, trained and validated in Waabi World, a high-fidelity neural closed-loop simulator, and designed for factory-level OEM integration and large-scale commercialization. Waabi is a product/technology company: as of this enrichment pass it publishes no public developer API, SDK, MCP server, or developer portal, so this profile carries identity and domain-security signal rather than API artifacts.

companies.name: Hapag-Lloyd
companies.description: A German multinational container shipping company and one of the world's largest liner shipping companies. Operates a fleet of over 250 vessels serving approximately 600 ports across 130 countries with a focus on quality and reliability. Provides a public API portal (api-portal.hlag.com) exposing container tracking, schedule, and booking APIs to customers, partners, and logistics platforms.

companies.name: Ocean Network Express
companies.description: Ocean Network Express (ONE) is a Singapore-headquartered global container liner shipping company formed in 2017 through the integration of the container shipping businesses of three Japanese carriers — Nippon Yusen Kaisha (NYK), Mitsui O.S.K. Lines (MOL), and Kawasaki Kisen Kaisha (K-Line) — with commercial operations launching on 1 April 2018. Operating under the magenta "ONE" brand and the Standard Carrier Alpha Code ONEY, the company runs a fleet exceeding 2,200,000 TEU across 165+ weekly service loops calling at 244+ ports worldwide, making it one of the largest ocean container carriers globally. ONE participates in THE Alliance vessel sharing agreement and offers reefer, dangerous goods, out-of-gauge, and project cargo services alongside standard dry container moves. Its customer-facing digital surface centers on the ONE eCommerce platform (ecomm.one-line.com), which provides cargo tracking, instant quotation via ONE QUOTE (powered by Descartes Kontainers), spot booking, shipping instructions, electronic bill of lading, ePayment, and demurrage/detention inquiry. A partner-facing developer portal exists at developers.one-line.com alongside EDI integration channels, but ONE does not publish a fully open, self-service OpenAPI specification, public SDK, or open-source code at either the github.com/ocean-network-express or github.com/OceanNetworkExpress organizations (both exist with zero public repositories). Tracking, booking, and schedule integrations are most commonly accessed by shippers and BCOs through third-party aggregators (Vizion, Portcast, JSONCargo, Terminal49, Tradlinx) or via DCSA-conformant carrier APIs delivered under commercial agreement.

companies.name: Vendease
companies.description: Vendease is a Nigerian B2B food procurement platform (founded 2020, Y Combinator W21, backed by Partech Africa and TLcom) that helps restaurants, hotels, and other food businesses buy fresh and processed food supplies, offering Buy Now, Pay Later financing, supplier consolidation, cold-chain logistics, and 24-hour delivery in Lagos. Vendease publishes no public developer API or SDKs; its procurement, payments, inventory, and tenant management service APIs are internal-only, though its engineering handover documentation is publicly available on GitHub.

companies.name: Andustry
companies.description: Andustry is an AI-native industrial equipment broker that streamlines sourcing and procurement for manufacturers. The platform combines AI-powered supplier discovery with manual qualification and commercial negotiation to source industrial machines (CNC mills, lathes, press brakes, laser cutters, robotic cells), machined/forged/cast parts, and robotics and electronics across Europe, China, India, and the United States. Clients hand off a sourcing need and Andustry returns a verified supplier shortlist within 24-48 hours, delivering an average of roughly 30% cost savings and 2x faster sourcing timelines on a commission-only basis with no subscription. Founded in 2026 (Y Combinator Spring 2026 batch) by Het Dave and Johann Stuerken and operated as Andustry GmbH.

companies.name: Core-Mark Holding
companies.description: Core-Mark Holding Company, a subsidiary of Performance Food Group, is one of the largest broad-line, full-service marketers and distributors of packaged consumer products to the convenience retail industry in North America. The company serves more than 41,000 retail locations across the United States and Canada, supplying tobacco, candy, snacks, beverages, foodservice, and other fast-moving consumer goods. Core-Mark provides retailer technology platforms including Core-Source Portal, Retailer Analytics, Core-Mark Ordering, and Core-Mark Intellisite.

companies.name: Costco Wholesale
companies.description: Costco Wholesale Corporation is a Fortune 500 American multinational membership-only big-box retail chain that operates warehouse clubs offering a wide selection of merchandise at discounted prices. Costco does not publish a public developer API; supplier and trading partner integrations are conducted through EDI and B2B channels using ANSI X12 transactions and the Costco Supplier Portal. Costco operates an e-commerce site, the Costco Travel and Costco Pharmacy properties, and the Costco Photo Center.

companies.name: Seafair
