companies.description: Seafair is an AI-native ERP platform for maritime operations, unifying crew management, HSQE and regulatory compliance, technical maintenance (planned maintenance systems and defect tracking), and accounting into a single system for shipping companies and ship managers. Its AI compliance engine performs document search and framework reviews (such as DryBMS and TMSA) and embeds AI assistance directly into operational workflows. Seafair markets itself as API-first with fast ERP integrations, but does not currently publish a public developer portal, API reference, SDKs, or OpenAPI definition. Seafair is a portfolio company of Speedinvest and is tracked in the API Evangelist network.

companies.name: SupplyHog
companies.description: SupplyHog is an ecommerce platform built specifically for hardware and building-materials retailers, giving independent hardware and building-supply stores a branded online storefront to sell their products. The platform provides co-op and custom product catalogs, flexible fulfillment (in-store pickup, ship-to-store, local delivery, and ship-to-home with Shippo shipping labels), Stripe-powered payments, TaxJar tax calculation, real-time ERP inventory and pricing synchronization, custom branding and domains, location-aware search, and admin tools for order fulfillment and abandoned-cart recovery. Founded in 2010 as the Nopone.com reverse-auction marketplace, SupplyHog went through the DreamIt and 500 Startups accelerators, pivoted to full ecommerce services, and was acquired by construction-supply retailer R.P. Lumber in 2016. It does not publish a public developer API surface; it acts as a consumer of Stripe, TaxJar, and Shippo.

companies.name: Notch
companies.description: Notch (formerly OrderEZE/ChefHero) brings the restaurant supply chain online, digitizing the paper-driven process of wholesale food ordering and order taking between restaurants and their distributors. Founded in 2015 and headquartered in Toronto, the platform spans four product surfaces — Order Manager and Invoice Manager for buyers, AP Manager for restaurant accounts payable, and AR Manager for distributor accounts receivable — handling order placement, invoice management, reconciliation, payment collection, and payment processing for food and beverage suppliers and buyers. Notch keeps ordering and finance workflows in sync through one-way and two-way connectors to accounting and ERP systems including QuickBooks Online, QuickBooks Desktop, NetSuite, Xero, and Microsoft Dynamics 365, plus CSV import/export. Notch does not publish a public developer API or developer portal; its accounting/ERP connectivity is delivered through its own connectors and the third-party Rutter unified accounting API, so Notch operates as an API consumer rather than an API provider. (This profile covers Notch the restaurant-to-supplier ordering and AR/AP automation company at notch.financial, and is unrelated to "Notch Pay," the African payments company at developer.notchpay.co.)

companies.name: EQUIPTAL HOLDING LTD
companies.description: EQUIPTAL HOLDING LTD operates Moedatech (معداتك), Saudi Arabia's first digital procurement and rental marketplace for heavy construction equipment, connecting contractors with verified suppliers of excavators, cranes, and trucks through RFQs, real-time bidding, and audit-ready digital contracts. Founded in Riyadh in 2020 by Ali Merie and Mansour Hmaid, the company pairs the marketplace with a telematics/fleet layer (built on Traccar GPS tracking) so equipment owners can monitor real-time asset performance. The product ships as iOS and Android apps plus a web app; there is no publicly documented developer API at this time. The company is backed by 500 Global and Plug and Play Middle East. This profile was surfaced from the 500 Global portfolio and enriched from the company's public web, brand (moedatech.net), and GitHub presence.

companies.name: Locusrobotics
companies.description: Locus Robotics is a warehouse automation company that builds autonomous mobile robots (AMRs) and the LocusONE platform, a data-science-driven system for enterprise-wide AMR deployments and warehouse performance management. Its fleet (Locus Array, Origin, and Vector robots) plus integrated software supports robots-to-goods and autonomous fulfillment across 3PL, retail, healthcare, and industrial operations. LocusONE integrates with leading WMS platforms through the LocusConnect middleware, a REST API secured with OAuth 2.0 and documented as OpenAPI 2.0 via SwaggerUI; API access is provisioned per customer rather than published as an open developer program. Locus Robotics is backed by Bond Capital and maintains an active open-source presence in the ROS (Robot Operating System) ecosystem on GitHub.

companies.name: Gallatin AI
companies.description: Gallatin AI builds AI-powered software for defense logistics, giving military planners and logisticians decision advantage across the tactical, operational, and strategic levels of the supply chain. Its products include Navigator, an AI decision-support "S4" that aggregates and analyzes brigade-level logistics reports in real time to streamline resupply planning; Burrow, a DoD-compliant third-party logistics (3PL) solution managing vendor qualification, transportation, inventory, storage, and fulfillment for domestic and international operations; and Phalanx, an automated asset and in-transit visibility system combining traditional reporting with hardware sensors and computer vision. Founded by veterans of Scale AI, Palantir, Amazon Prime Air, and the DoD, the company emerged from stealth in 2025 and is backed by 8VC, Silent Ventures, Timeless, Moonshots Capital, and Banter Capital.

companies.name: Kiva Systems (Amazon Robotics since 2012)
companies.description: Kiva Systems was a warehouse robotics company founded in 2003 that pioneered the goods-to-person mobile fulfillment model, in which fleets of low-profile drive units lift and carry mobile storage pods to human pick stations instead of moving workers to static shelving. Amazon acquired Kiva Systems in March 2012 for approximately US$775 million and renamed it Amazon Robotics in 2015. Since the acquisition the technology has been developed exclusively for Amazon's own fulfillment and sortation network and is no longer sold to third parties. Amazon Robotics publishes no public API, developer portal or SDKs; amazonrobotics.com now redirects to Amazon's internal identity provider and kivasystems.com no longer resolves. This profile is retained as a historical and acquisition record in the physical-AI and warehouse-robotics space rather than as an integratable API provider. Not to be confused with AWS RoboMaker or AWS IoT RoboRunner, which are AWS product APIs.

companies.name: American Tire Distributors Holdings
companies.description: American Tire Distributors (ATD) is one of the largest independent suppliers of replacement tires in North America, distributing passenger, light truck, medium truck, and specialty tires from more than 110 distribution centers. ATD delivers over 30.5 million tire units annually to more than 85,000 delivery points across the United States and Canada, serving independent tire dealers, automotive service centers, and retailers.

companies.name: CSX Corporation
companies.description: CSX Corporation is a Class I freight railroad operating one of the largest rail networks in the eastern United States, serving 23 states with roughly 20,000 route miles of track. CSX moves bulk commodities, intermodal shipments, and merchandise for industrial customers and operates the ShipCSX customer portal for shipment management, EDI integration, and freight tracking.

companies.name: JD Business
companies.description: JD Business is the enterprise-facing arm of JD.com (Jingdong), one of China's largest technology and retail companies, offering B2B procurement, supply-chain, and corporate purchasing services to businesses. JD.com operates across retail, logistics, technology, health, and industrials, and runs the JD Open Platform (JOS / "Zeus" Developer Center) at jos.jd.com, where third-party merchants and partners integrate with JD's e-commerce, order, product, and logistics systems. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio-linked company and is being enriched from JD's public surface; JD's developer platform and enterprise services are primarily China-market and Chinese-language.

companies.name: MSC Mediterranean Shipping Company
companies.description: MSC (Mediterranean Shipping Company) is a privately-held, family-owned global container shipping and logistics group headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland, founded in 1970 by Gianluigi Aponte and now led by CEO Soren Toft under the Aponte-Diamant family. MSC is the world's largest container shipping line by fleet size and capacity, operating roughly 900 cargo vessels with a combined intake of about 7 million TEU and controlling more than a fifth of global container capacity as of late 2025. The carrier offers a portfolio of digital shipment-management products through its myMSC e-business platform — including Instant Quote for online rate generation, online booking, electronic Bill of Lading and Sea Waybill issuance via eDocs, container Track & Trace, and the myMSC mobile app — and exposes a Direct Integrations program for shippers, freight forwarders, and NVOCCs that combines REST APIs and EDI message exchange. The MSC Developer Portal (developerportal.msc.com), hosted on Microsoft Azure API Management, publishes documentation and EDI message implementation guides for products such as the DCSA-aligned Track & Trace API (v1.2 and v2.2), Booking, Booking Confirmation (X12 301 / EDIFACT IFTMIN), and Shipping Instructions, alongside ANSI X12 and EDIFACT IFTMIN / IFTMBC / COPRAR reference documents. MSC also runs direct-integration partnerships with INTTRA, Infor Nexus, and CargoSmart. API and EDI access is not self-service: prospective integrators must submit a Direct Integration request, and fees may apply.

companies.name: Vend
companies.description: Vend was a cloud-based retail point-of-sale and inventory management software company founded in Auckland, New Zealand, backed by investors including Point Nine. Lightspeed announced its acquisition of Vend in March 2021 for approximately US$350 million, and the product lives on as Lightspeed Retail (X-Series). vendhq.com redirects to lightspeedhq.com/vend/, and the former Vend API is documented today at x-series-api.lightspeedhq.com. The X-Series API surface is profiled in the API Evangelist network under the Lightspeed provider, so this profile records the acquired Vend brand rather than duplicating that API.

companies.name: ZIM Integrated Shipping Services
companies.description: ZIM Integrated Shipping Services Ltd. (NYSE: ZIM) is a global container liner shipping company founded in 1945 and headquartered in Haifa, Israel. ZIM operates in more than 90 countries, serving over 30,000 customers across more than 300 ports worldwide with a differentiated global-niche strategy focused on agile fleet management and select trade lanes. The company is publicly traded on the New York Stock Exchange and, as of 2026, is the subject of a pending acquisition by Hapag-Lloyd at approximately $35.00 per share. ZIM's digital surface includes the myZIM customer area, ZIMonitor cargo visibility, an electronic Bill of Lading (eB/L) service, a Draft B/L tool, EDI integrations for booking and shipping instructions, a mobile application, and a developer API portal at api.zim.com hosted on Microsoft Azure API Management. Access to the ZIM API requires registering through ZIM API Support and obtaining a security token; rate limits are set per organization at registration. No public OpenAPI specification, SDKs, or GitHub organization are published, so ZIM is profiled here as a Tier-3 catalog entry pending spec disclosure or partner access.

companies.name: Blackcart
companies.description: Blackcart is a Try Before You Buy (TBYB) platform for ecommerce merchants that lets online shoppers order products, receive them at home, and pay only for what they keep during a trial window. The platform pairs a proprietary fraud and AI order-decisioning engine with storefront integrations for Shopify, Magento, WooCommerce, BigCommerce, Salesforce Commerce Cloud, WordPress, and custom storefronts, and charges merchants a revenue share on kept items rather than upfront or integration fees. Founded circa 2019 and backed by a 2021 US$8.8M Series A (investors include 500 Global), Blackcart exposed a Beta REST API (order cancellation, refunds, product/store endpoints) documented on Stoplight. As of this enrichment pass its primary domains (blackcart.com and its *.blackcart.com subdomains) return Fastly "unknown domain" errors and blackcart.co serves only a JavaScript redirect shell, indicating the public product and developer surface is offline or the company has wound down.

companies.name: Sanderson Farms
companies.description: Sanderson Farms was the third-largest poultry producer in the United States, producing over 13 million chickens per week before being acquired by a joint venture of Cargill and Continental Grain in 2022 to form Wayne-Sanderson Farms. Headquartered in Laurel, Mississippi, the company operated processing facilities across the southeastern United States and was a Fortune 1000 company. As a large-scale agricultural and food production enterprise, Sanderson Farms does not offer public developer APIs. The company focused on poultry processing, supply chain management, and food safety operations.

companies.name: 360 Commerce
companies.description: 360 Commerce is a New Zealand and Australia B2B ecommerce platform that helps wholesalers, distributors and manufacturers bring customer ordering, account self-service and ERP-connected workflows online. More than a standard ecommerce website, it gives customers a secure ordering portal for contract and customer-specific pricing, ERP stock visibility, repeat ordering, quotes, approvals, invoices, credit notes and aged balances. The platform (built on its EcomCore product) integrates with leading ERP, accounting, inventory and CRM systems including Odoo, MYOB Advanced and NetSuite so online ordering reflects the way a business actually trades.

companies.name: AliciaBots
companies.description: AliciaBots is a maritime robotics company, backed by Techstars, that builds autonomous robot teams for cleaning and inspecting ship hulls. Its flagship Roverclean robot operates independently to remove marine growth and monitor hull condition in real time without interrupting a vessel's voyage, using self-learning adaptive systems, precision cleaning, and remote monitoring and control to improve fuel efficiency and help operators meet IMO regulatory standards. AliciaBots does not currently publish a public API or developer program; this profile tracks the company as a network lead.

companies.name: ATMI Sales
companies.description: ATMI Sales (Advanced Technical Marketing Inc.) is a manufacturers' representative and technical sales firm serving the electronics and semiconductor industry across the Pacific Northwest and Western Canada. The company connects customers with component suppliers through a research, development, and build model — identifying suitable technology solutions, building supplier relationships, and ensuring component availability and supply-chain sourcing in the regions where products are manufactured. ATMI maintains a line card of partner technologies and works with distributors to fulfill orders. This is a non-developer B2B sales and distribution company; it publishes no public API, SDK, or developer program. Surfaced as a portfolio company of sierra-ventures and profiled in the API Evangelist network.

companies.name: AutoStore
companies.description: AutoStore is a global warehouse robotics and technology company headquartered in Nedre Vats, Norway, that pioneered the cube storage automated storage and retrieval system (AS/RS). Its goods-to-person solution combines autonomous robots, an aluminum storage grid of stacked bins, workstation ports, and controlling software (marketed as CubeVerse, spanning design, simulation, operations, and predictive diagnostics) to fulfill orders in a fraction of the floor space of conventional warehouses. With more than 1,950 systems deployed across nearly 65 countries, AutoStore serves retail, grocery, 3PL, healthcare, and industrial customers. Systems are distributed, designed, installed, and serviced through a global network of qualified system integrators rather than a public developer/API program. AutoStore was surfaced as a portfolio company of SoftBank Vision Fund and added to the API Evangelist network.

companies.name: BlackBuck
companies.description: BlackBuck, operated by Zinka Logistics Solutions and incorporated in 2015, runs India's largest digital trucking platform, digitizing the truck-operator lifecycle for roughly a million truck operators (about 28% of India's truckers) across 100,000+ villages. Its super-app spans a loads marketplace, FASTag toll payments, fuel, GPS/telematics, vehicle and working-capital financing, and a used-trucks marketplace. Listed on the NSE as BLACKBUCK since November 2024, the company was surfaced as a portfolio company of Accel and added to the API Evangelist network. No public developer program, API documentation, or OpenAPI surface was found during enrichment; this profile carries the company identity plus a probed domain-security posture.

companies.name: Cheetah
companies.description: Cheetah (Cheetah Technologies, with its software platform also marketed as Kimelo) is an AI-enabled, app-based restaurant supply and wholesale ordering marketplace launched in 2015 to bridge the digital gap in foodservice. Its eCommerce platform gives small to medium-sized food distributors and restaurants tools for online ordering, process automation, delivery route optimization, supply chain management, and customer retention, with next-day delivery of daily supplies. In June 2024 the company divested its physical distribution business (Pleasanton, CA) to Palo Alto Foods to focus on commercializing its software platform nationwide. The platform provides digital product catalogs, personalized purchasing insights, integrated payment processing, routing management, and automated inventory tracking, and lets distributors integrate directly with their ERP or inventory management and point-of-sale systems to automate order placement. Cheetah does not appear to publish a public developer API or developer portal; integration is offered through direct ERP, inventory, and POS system connections arranged with the company rather than self-service documented endpoints.

companies.name: COSY
companies.description: COSY (CosyRobo) is a retail-technology robotics company that builds autonomous inventory robots for physical stores. Its flagship robot, SCOUT, roams store aisles using AI and machine vision to scan shelves, map products, audit stock levels, and check planogram compliance, feeding the results into a cloud-based management system so retailers can reduce out-of-stocks and improve on-shelf availability. Backed by 500 Global, the company was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio lead; it publishes a marketing website but does not currently expose a public developer API, documentation, or SDKs.

companies.name: Owens & Minor
companies.description: Owens & Minor is a global Fortune 500 healthcare solutions company providing essential products and services to healthcare providers and manufacturers across the continuum of care, including medical and surgical supplies distribution, home healthcare equipment (Apria, Byram Healthcare), and outsourced logistics. No public APIs or developer portal have been identified at this time.

companies.name: Plexus
companies.description: Plexus is a global manufacturing and product development company that helps customers in highly regulated industries (Aerospace/Defense, Healthcare/Life Sciences, Industrial, and Semiconductor Capital Equipment) design, manufacture, and service their products. Plexus does not currently publish a public developer API; this index tracks customer/supplier portals and corporate web properties.

companies.name: Slip Robotics
companies.description: Slip Robotics is an Atlanta, Georgia-based robotics company that builds SlipBots, autonomous omnidirectional Automated Loading Robots (ALRs) that load and unload any truck trailer in about five minutes without a forklift ever entering the trailer. Each SlipBot carries up to eight pallets and roughly six tons, cutting driver dwell time from around ninety minutes to five while reducing material-handling damage and loading-dock accidents. The company also offers SlipLift, a platform that extends autonomous trailer loading and unloading to heavier freight and regional and last-mile routes. Slip Robotics markets its robots-as-a-service offering as requiring no IT integration, is backed by DCVC, and won Best New Innovation in supply chain technology at MODEX 2024. It is tracked in the API Evangelist network as a company profile; no public developer API surface was found during enrichment.

companies.name: Sweep
companies.description: Sweep is an enterprise carbon and ESG data management platform helping large organizations measure, manage, report, and reduce their carbon emissions and broader sustainability performance across Scope 1, 2, and 3 following the GHG Protocol. Its platform centralizes sustainability data across an organization and its value chain to produce audit-ready data from a single source, covering carbon accounting, ESG disclosure, value-chain engagement with supplier portals and automated data collection, audit and assurance trails, and business intelligence with dashboards and scenario modeling. Sweep supports compliance with the CSRD, ISSB, GRI, CDP, SFDR, TCFD, UK SRS, the GHG Protocol, and US state regulation including California SB 253 and SB 261, with vertical solutions for asset managers, asset owners, private markets, banks, healthcare, manufacturing, retail, energy, and consumer goods. Sweep was named a Leader in the IDC MarketScape 2026 for Carbon Management and recognized in the Verdantix 2026 Green Quadrant. The platform exposes data ingestion via API and SFTP and integrates with ERP, procurement, and HRMS systems, but Sweep does not publish a public developer portal, OpenAPI specification, SDKs, or open-source repos — API access is delivered through customer engagements rather than a self-serve developer surface.

companies.name: Tile
companies.description: Tile is a consumer-electronics company known for its Bluetooth tracker devices, used to locate everyday items such as keys, wallets, bags, and phones through a companion mobile app and a crowd-sourced Find network. Tile was acquired by Life360 in 2021; its former site thetileapp.com now 301-redirects to life360.com. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Bessemer Venture Partners, Tile publishes no public developer API — this profile captures its security posture (security.txt, a HackerOne responsible-disclosure program, and probed domain security).

companies.name: TruKKer
companies.description: TruKKer is a tech-enabled logistics and transportation company serving businesses across the EMEA region. Its platform uses AI-driven freight matching and smart route visibility to connect shippers with carriers for land freight, cross-border transport, rent-by-trip, and home and office moving, alongside services such as ProcureCo and TruKKer Safe. TruKKer was surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and added to the API Evangelist network. During enrichment no public developer API, API documentation, SDK, CLI, MCP server, or /.well-known discovery surface was found on trukker.com; this profile captures the company's public web identity and a domain-security probe.

companies.name: Avery Dennison
companies.description: Avery Dennison is a global materials science and manufacturing company specializing in the design and manufacture of labeling and functional materials, packaging, and intelligent labels.

companies.name: Avnet
companies.description: Avnet is a global technology distributor and solutions provider that delivers electronic components, embedded solutions, and design and supply chain services to industrial and commercial customers.

companies.name: Trella
companies.description: Trella is a Cairo-headquartered B2B trucking marketplace and digital freight platform that connects shippers with carriers across the Middle East, North Africa, and Pakistan (MENA-P). Founded in 2019 by Omar Hagrass, Ali El Atrash, and Pierre Saad and backed by Y Combinator, Trella runs a digital load marketplace, a carrier mobile app, and a shipper web dashboard that together replace the traditional broker-driven, paper-based long-haul trucking workflow. Core platform services include load posting and carrier matching, instant quoting, GPS tracking and live shipment visibility, electronic proof of delivery (ePODs), load insurance, a control-tower operations layer for carrier quality and performance, and integrated payments and invoicing between shippers and carriers. The network spans 30,000+ carriers and operates from major freight hubs including Cairo, Alexandria, Port Said, Damietta, Sokhna, Jeddah, Dammam, Riyadh, and Dubai, serving industries such as FMCG, construction, manufacturing, agriculture, mining, e-commerce, retail, electronics, ceramics, and freight forwarding. Trella's revenue model is marketplace take-rate and value-added logistics services; there is no public developer API, SDK, OpenAPI specification, webhooks catalog, or open-source platform release for the Trella marketplace.

companies.name: TTM Technologies
companies.description: TTM Technologies, Inc. (NASDAQ: TTMI) is a leading global manufacturer of technology products, including mission systems, radio frequency components, RF microwave and microelectronic assemblies, and technologically advanced printed circuit boards (PCBs). TTM serves aerospace and defense, data center computing, medical, industrial and instrumentation, automotive, and networking and communications markets. The company reported approximately $2.9B in FY2025 revenue, operates 24 specialized facilities across North America and Asia Pacific, and employs more than 18,000 people. TTM expanded its defense electronics footprint with the 2022 acquisition of Telephonics from Griffon Corporation.

companies.name: Cabinet Health
companies.description: Cabinet Health is an end-to-end supply chain platform for private-label over-the-counter (OTC) medicines. The company develops, sources, manufactures, and delivers OTC products across 70+ active ingredients in tablet, softgel, capsule, liquid, powder, gummy, and chewable formats to retailers, wholesalers, and online marketplaces, emphasizing sustainable, refillable packaging and quality assurance at scale. Cabinet also produces its own certified B Corp consumer brand sold on Amazon and Target. It was surfaced as a Techstars portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network; no public developer or API surface has been found for this provider.

companies.name: Cencora
companies.description: Cencora (formerly AmerisourceBergen, renamed August 2023) is a leading global pharmaceutical solutions organization that connects manufacturers, providers, pharmacies, and patients across the healthcare supply chain. Cencora operates an Axway-based central EDI platform exchanging over 800,000 EDI messages daily with more than 23,000 trading partners and a Cell and Gene Therapy (CGT) Integration Hub for real-time data exchange with biopharma and provider platforms. No public developer API portal has been identified.

companies.name: Collaborative Robotics
companies.description: Collaborative Robotics (Cobot) is a Physical AI company founded by Brad Porter building AI-powered collaborative robots that work safely alongside people. Its flagship robot, Proxie, is a human-capable mobile manipulator designed to address labor shortages across warehousing, manufacturing, logistics, and healthcare. The company uses ScoutMap to analyze facility operations and identify automation opportunities, then deploys robots that learn real-world workflow patterns. Backed by General Catalyst, Collaborative Robotics is added to the API Evangelist network as a company profile; it is a hardware / Physical AI provider with no public developer API surface at this time.

companies.name: firstgrid
companies.description: The domain firstgrid.cn resolves to Shanghai Shouige Network Technology Co., Ltd. (上海首格网络科技有限公司 / "Shouige Network"), a Chinese software and logistics-services provider focused on the medical-device industry. Its products include the Medical Jiecloud Platform (医捷云), a bidirectional logistics intelligence and supply-chain management system, a public database platform, and third-party warehousing/distribution services for medical-device producers, distributors, and 3PLs, with offices in Shanghai and an R&D center in Hangzhou. The company was surfaced as a portfolio lead of the venture firm qiming and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub. As of this enrichment pass the public site is a Chinese-language corporate marketing site and exposes no public API, developer portal, OpenAPI, SDKs, or documentation surface, so no API artifacts could be harvested. Note: the recorded English name "firstgrid" is the pinyin of 首格 (Shǒugé) and the domain/company identity should be verified against the intended qiming portfolio company.

companies.name: innostic
companies.description: Innostic is a China-based medical-device distribution and healthcare supply-chain company, established in 2015 and originally profiled as a portfolio company of Qiming Venture Partners. Its public web presence at www.innostic.com now resolves to the Shanghai Jianfa Zhixin Medical Technology group, which operates across medical-device distribution, in-vitro diagnostics (IVD), hospital supply-chain management (SPD and centralized distribution), and consumer healthcare supply-chain services for manufacturers, distributors, and hospitals. The company is a B2B healthcare logistics and distribution firm; its only online systems are internal, login-gated operational platforms (Zhixin, U9, OA). As of this enrichment pass it publishes no public developer portal, API documentation, OpenAPI/AsyncAPI specification, SDK, MCP server, or /.well-known discovery surface. This profile records verified company identity and a domain-security probe; there is no public API surface to catalog.

companies.name: Lumere
companies.description: Lumere was a Chicago-based healthcare technology company providing evidence-based analytics on medical devices, drugs, and clinical supplies to help hospitals and health systems reduce cost and variation in supply and utilization decisions. Backed by Bessemer Venture Partners, Lumere was acquired by GHX (Global Healthcare Exchange) in 2019 and its capabilities now ship as part of the GHX Clinical Integration / Value Analysis product line; lumere.com redirects to ghx.com. No independent Lumere developer portal, API documentation, or public API surface exists — this profile is retained as a network lead.

companies.name: Thalamed
companies.description: Thalamed is a Berlin-based medical device procurement marketplace, founded in 2014, that connects healthcare providers such as clinics, private practices, and outpatient care facilities with suppliers of medical equipment including ultrasound and x-ray devices, sterilization and disinfection systems, and medical lasers. Customers describe the device they need and Thalamed's team evaluates the request and contacts the most suitable providers to deliver matching quotes, simplifying comparison and purchasing. The company is a Point Nine and RTAventures portfolio company. No public developer API, documentation, or integration surface is published as of this enrichment pass.

companies.name: Torch Dental
companies.description: Torch Dental is a New York-based vertical-software company that builds a procurement and practice-management platform for dental practices and dental service organizations (DSOs). The platform lets dental offices order supplies across multiple vendors from a single catalog, compare prices, manage budgets and approvals, track orders and invoices, and streamline back-office purchasing. Torch Dental is backed by Bessemer Venture Partners and was surfaced through that portfolio and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment. As of this pass the company exposes no public developer API, developer portal, documentation, or SDKs; its web presence sits behind a bot-challenge wall and there is no reachable api./developers./docs. subdomain, so this profile captures identity and domain-security posture only.

companies.name: Amca
companies.description: Amca (Advanced Manufacturing Company of America) is an El Segundo, California aerospace and defense manufacturer rebuilding America's industrial base by acquiring specialized component suppliers and expanding competition and capacity for critical parts — actuators, switches, hydraulics, pressure sensors, power electronics, and flight-control electronics. Founded in 2024 by Eli Giovanetti and Jai Malik, Amca combines design, testing, and production into a single RAPID platform across a network of AS9100D-certified factories (Electro-Mech Components, Electrocube, Aerospace Control Products, Payne Magnetics, Cal-Draulics, BC Power Systems), and serves nearly every major aerospace and defense prime and Tier 1 supplier — Boeing, Lockheed Martin, Airbus, GE Aerospace, Honeywell, Textron, BAE Systems, and the Defense Logistics Agency. It is a hardware manufacturing company with no public developer API surface.

companies.name: Autobia
companies.description: Autobia is a B2B e-commerce marketplace for the automotive aftermarket in Saudi Arabia, connecting auto-parts retailers, workshops, and service centers with wholesalers and dealers. The platform offers real-time pricing and instant ordering across more than 20,000 spare parts from multiple brands, centralizing sourcing to streamline procurement and improve supply-chain efficiency for the automotive sector. Backed by Techstars, Autobia operates via a web platform and native iOS and Android apps. No public developer API, documentation, or SDK is currently published.

companies.name: Boxbot
companies.description: Boxbot builds next-generation supply chain automation, making logistics operations more productive, intelligent, and resilient through automated, high-density dynamic storage that unlocks new AI-driven capabilities. Its platform is designed for mission-control fulfillment facilities: real-time space allocation packs variable-sized items densely, hands-free load/unload moves items onto and off proprietary storage trays linked to standard conveyors with no pick or load stations, and a modular, gantry-based architecture delivers a robust, fault-tolerant design with no single point of failure. Boxbot is a hardware/robotics company backed by Playground Global; it publishes a marketing presence but no public developer API surface at this time.

companies.name: Captain Fresh
companies.description: Captain Fresh is a Bangalore, India based B2B technology company building sustainable seafood and animal-protein supply chains worldwide, connecting fishermen, farmers, processors and retailers through a technology-enabled sourcing, cold-chain and distribution marketplace. Backed by Accel and Prosus Ventures, the company operates across India and international markets. It is tracked in the API Evangelist network as a consumer / supply-chain company profile; no public developer API, documentation, or developer portal was found during enrichment (a marketing website only).

companies.name: Otrafy
companies.description: Otrafy is an AI-powered supplier management platform that automates regulatory compliance, supplier data collection, and supply chain risk assessment for QA, R&D, Regulatory, and Procurement teams at enterprise clients. The platform uses natural language processing to automate supplier data collection (citing high supplier response rates), monitors suppliers in real time against regulatory standards such as FDA, EU MRLs, California Prop 65, and PFAS, and applies AI-driven risk scoring to suppliers and facilities to streamline buyer-supplier collaboration. Otrafy is a Techstars portfolio company. As of this enrichment pass the company publishes a marketing website and product/contact pages but no public developer portal, API documentation, or machine-readable API surface.

companies.name: 6river
companies.description: 6 River Systems (6RS) is a warehouse fulfillment automation company founded in 2015 in Waltham, Massachusetts. Its flagship product is "Chuck," a collaborative autonomous mobile robot (AMR) that works alongside human associates to guide and optimize picking, sorting, and replenishment in distribution centers. The platform is WMS-agnostic and integrates with existing warehouse-management systems as an intelligent execution layer via a private/partner REST API for host data exchange; it does not publish a public developer portal, API documentation, or consumer SDKs. Norwest Venture Partners was an early investor; the company was acquired by Shopify in 2019 and by Ocado Group in 2023. The public marketing site at 6river.com currently serves a parked lander stub.

bands.label: Not Yet Rated
bands.blurb: Providers we have not scored yet — unknown, not zero.
